jobs.title: Senior Autonomy Stack Integration Engineer - Land Domain (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join Quantum Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As a Senior Autonomy Stack Integration Engineer in the Land Domain, you will ensure proper end-to-end functionality of our products across the whole autonomy stack. You will have a unique overview and understanding of details of all interacting components and work with the teams to make sure that component integration, tooling, and verification are innate to our development processes and that broader stack changes are exercised swiftly and with minimal friction.

You will work at the intersection of the autonomy software stack, vehicle manufacturers, and our SW Factory, making sure our vehicle controls are robust, safe, and reliably deployable.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead by example with excellent engineering practices within your team as well as all other land domain teams

  • Ensure that component teams can integrate their components safely and easily as much as possible and enable component team ownership after integration.

  • Set priorities, ensure delivery of high-quality engineer, and establish best practices for specification, development, testing, and review for both your team and the component teams you work with.

  • Be responsible for the end-to-end integration of the autonomy stack on our ground vehicle platforms, from individual software components to a functioning autonomous system.

  • Establish and maintain a deep understanding of the interfaces, dependencies, timing, data flows, and failure modes across the autonomy stack.

  • Own system-level troubleshooting and triaging, identify issues across component boundaries, and work with the responsible teams to drive them to resolution.

  • Build and maintain the tooling required to inspect, diagnose, reproduce, and understand system behavior across the complete autonomy stack.

  • Define and maintain representative integration environments, configurations, datasets, scenarios, and system-level tests.

  • Ensure integration on the vehicles and drive issues to resolution: strong troubleshooting, triaging, and integration discipline.

  • Apply robust software development practices across all parts of the stack the team is responsible for.

  • Build and run VnV setups for any changes your team exposes on the autonomy stack, from bench and rig testing to vehicle-level testing.

  • Establish automated testing and deployment in strong alignment with the SW Factory (target CI).

  • Treat safety and security as first-class requirements throughout development and integration.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Perception, Motion Planning & Control, Pilot, vehicle platform, SW Factory, Verification & Validation, and ground operations teams.

  • Establish clear interfaces and integration contracts between teams and identify integration risks early.

  • Coordinate broader autonomy stack changes involving multiple teams and ensure that they are validated end-to-end.What you bring to the team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field.

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, robotics, autonomous systems, embedded systems, or comparable complex software-intensive systems.

  • Strong experience integrating complex distributed software systems involving software, compute hardware, sensors, networks, and physical platforms.

  • Broad understanding of autonomous robotics stacks, including perception, localization, planning, controls, vehicle interfaces, and operator-facing systems.

  • Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with the ability to understand and debug unfamiliar components across a large software stack.

  • Hands-on experience with Linux-based robotic or embedded systems, networking, middleware such as ROS 2 or comparable technologies, and deployment on target hardware.

  • Strong understanding of software interfaces, distributed system behavior, timing, synchronization, observability, and failure analysis.

  • Experience with simulation, SIL, HIL, system integration rigs, and vehicle- or robot-level testing.

  • Proven track record in robust software development practices including automated testing, CI/CD, reproducible deployments, and system-level verification.

  • Outstanding troubleshooting and triaging skills, particularly for problems spanning multiple components or engineering disciplines.

  • Strong technical communication: you can distill crisp action items from complex discussions and translate them into team priorities and plans.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Player-coach mindset: high ownership, pragmatic, and comfortable working across organizational and technical boundaries in a fast-paced environment.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement (Stage)
jobs.description:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

Le rôle

Au sein de notre équipe Alternative Finance Sales, vous contribuerez à renforcer l’efficacité des activités commerciales, de la préparation des campagnes de prospection à la structuration des données et des outils Sales.

Ce stage vous permettra de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement commercial de Lemonway, en participant à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités, au mapping de comptes stratégiques et à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées.

Vous découvrirez progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vente, avec l’opportunité de participer aux rendez-vous commerciaux et de contribuer concrètement aux différentes étapes du développement de nos activités.

Vos missions

  • Rechercher et cartographier des comptes stratégiques, leurs activités et leurs décideurs.

  • Identifier les interlocuteurs pertinents et enrichir les bases de prospects.

  • Participer à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées.

  • Contribuer à la rédaction de messages et de séquences d’e-mails.

  • Mettre à jour et fiabiliser les données dans Salesforce.

  • Réaliser des recherches de marché et une veille concurrentielle sur les paiements et la FinTech.

  • Identifier des opportunités d’automatisation et contribuer à la création d’outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle.

  • Préparer des supports commerciaux et participer ponctuellement à des rendez-vous.

Ce que vous apprendrez

  • Les fondamentaux du Business Development et de la prospection B2B.

  • Les méthodes de recherche, de mapping et d’analyse de comptes.

  • La construction de campagnes commerciales ciblées.

  • L’utilisation d’un CRM et d’outils de prospection.

  • Les enjeux du marché des paiements et de la finance alternative.

  • Les applications concrètes de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle dans les activités commerciales.


Vous êtes en dernière année d’école de commerce, d’université ou d’une formation en commerce, marketing, finance, stratégie, data ou technologie, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Curieuse, volontaire et désireuse d’apprendre.

  • Intéressée par la vente B2B, la FinTech, les paiements et les nouvelles technologies.

  • À l’aise avec la recherche d’informations, l’analyse et la structuration de données.

  • Rigoureuse, organisée et attentive à la qualité des informations collectées.

  • Autonome, impliquée et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle.

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une réelle envie de contribuer.

Une appétence pour les outils et les environnements techniques sera un réel atout. Une première expérience avec un CRM, des outils de prospection ou de data enrichment, des solutions d’automatisation, du scraping, des outils no-code, de l’analyse de données ou de l’intelligence artificielle sera particulièrement appréciée. La maîtrise de ces outils n’est toutefois pas indispensable.

La maîtrise professionnelle complète du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable. La maîtrise de l’espagnol constitue un atout important.

Le processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien d’introduction avec Sabina, Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Entretien des compétences techniques avec Maximilien, Senior Account Executive

  3. Echange avec Clémentine, Inside Sales

Les entretiens permettront notamment d’évaluer votre curiosité, votre capacité d’apprentissage, votre rigueur, vos compétences relationnelles et votre adéquation avec les missions du stage.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team

#LI-DNI

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry.   • Orakl-hosted events. Create and run Orakl's own event formats, from intimate scientific dinners and executive roundtables to webinars and partner gatherings, designed to strengthen relationships and generate meaningful conversations.

  • Measurement and priorities. Define how communications and events success is measured, focusing on quality of visibility, audience relevance, reputation, strategic relationships and contribution to company objectives.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in communications, PR, brand or a related role, ideally within life sciences, biotech, healthtech or B2B technology.

  • Strong strategic communications skills, with experience developing corporate narratives, positioning and communications plans that support business objectives.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling ability, from short-form social content and executive ghostwriting to press releases, long-form editorial, website copy and event communications.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. jobs.title: City Launcher, Groningen
jobs.description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.


About the role

Over the last few years, Monumental has gone from developing a product that works and delivering our first pilots to building at scale - a fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 90+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls.

We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US.

As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you.

We're hiring versatile operators who want to run a deployment as if it were their own business. Behind every one of these projects is a Deployment Manager who owns it end to end. In practice this is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time - in construction, one of the most chaotic industries there is. Your goal will be to run multiple deployments in parallel, overseeing complex and high stakes projects.

One day you're up at dawn, travelling to site, cutting bricks, running the schedule, working with the general contractor and watching your build plan go up brick by brick. The next you'll be at our facility analysing your deployment's P&L and building the systems that improve your margin on the next deployment. You’ll own delivery and translating friction you observe on-site to our R&D team.

This is hard, on-site operations, and some of the most rewarding work you'll find. Robots break, weather turns, the contractor changes the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving.
You'll have an extraordinary amount of autonomy. It's an excellent fit if you've founded a company before, or if you're looking for an entrepreneurial role where you can make outsized impact.

What you’ll do

  • Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and make both a day-to-day operational plan while also thinking about the bigger picture and how your decisions impact our unit economics.

  • Spend time on the construction site, overseeing, managing, and motivating the team; liaising with the general contractors and other stakeholders; and generally representing the company and selling our story. You’re comfortable speaking with the guys building scaffolds, the CEOs of the biggest general contractors, and our engineers, all on the same day.

  • Build the operational systems that make each deployment run better than the last - spotting inefficiencies, fixing processes, improving margin

  • Work with our existing customer base and drive growth of new construction projects and, in the future, adjacent product lines beyond bricklaying.

  • Own the P&L of your deployment and propose ways to continuously improve our unit economics.

  • Support hiring and interviewing additional robot and deployment operators.

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in management as a startup founder, GM, in operations, strategy, business development or a similar area.

  • Given the local nature of the construction industry, this role requires you to be a native Dutch speaker.

  • You generally need to be an excellent communicator and be comfortable speaking with a broad range of personas.

  • You don’t mind getting your hands (literally) dirty to get the job done.

  • A strong bias-to-action and getting-shit-done mentality with the required tenacity and speed. The emphasis of this role is execution, not analysis.

  • You’re comfortable in a high-stress environment. Things constantly go wrong at construction sites, the stakes are high, and we’re introducing new technology with novel failure modes.

  • Raw intellectual horsepower and eagerness to learn. We expect this role to have a steep learning curve whatever your background, and this role might in practice feel like a completely new job every 3-6 months. You’ll learn a lot about construction, robotics, and being part of a high-growth, hard-tech company.

  • Experience and ability to manage, lead, and motivate a (small) team.

  • Strong operational and analytical skills. You can build a spreadsheet with a clear operational plan, or present a P&L and model various scenarios and drivers. You’re a strong project manager.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. jobs.title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

This is a hands-on execution role. You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager, who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead, who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team.

What you'll be doing

Core Responsibilities

  • Assemble quantum chips into their packaging, working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB.

  • Make the electrical connections, wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering.

  • Measure and test your work, performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on.

  • Finish and close the package, including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location.

  • Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured, mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields.

  • Safeguard quality, handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip.

Supporting Responsibilities

  • Flag deviations early, stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix.

  • Help improve how we work, giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing.

  • Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace, applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready.

Your Profile

  • MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count.

  • Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems.

  • Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together.

  • Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems.

  • Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did.

  • Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift.

  • A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right.

  • Good command of technical English.

Bonus if you also bring:

  • Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly.

  • Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting.

  • Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment.

  • Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines.

  • Familiarity with cryogenics or vacuum systems.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs.title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
  • Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Requirements

Indispensable

  • Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
  • Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

  • Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

  • Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
  • Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
  • Expérience en pression ou température.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié.
  • Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés.
  • Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise.

Conditions

Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement
Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Recruiting & HR Operations Manager to help us attract, hire, and support exceptional talent as we grow. This role will primarily focus on full-cycle recruiting, partnering closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand business needs, build talent pipelines, and deliver an efficient, high-quality candidate experience.

While recruiting will be the priority, this role will support onboarding, employee lifecycle administration, and day-to-day HR operations for our Swiss-based team when time allows. Reporting to the Fractional HR leader based in the US, you will help build scalable, consistent people practices while providing responsive support to employees and managers.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys quick execution to make an impact, owning the details, building relationships, and balancing multiple priorities in a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for positions across the organization, from intake meetings and sourcing through interviews, offers, and closing candidates.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, develop recruiting strategies, and establish clear selection criteria.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.

  • Coordinate interview processes, ensuring timely communication, structured evaluations, and a positive candidate experience.

  • Manage offer processes, including compensation coordination, offer approvals, and preparation of employment contracts in partnership with HR and leadership.

  • Track recruiting metrics, pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other key indicators to identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness.

  • Maintain accurate applicant tracking system records and recruiting documentation.

  • Support the development of consistent recruiting practices across locations while accounting for local market expectations.

HR Operations

  • Coordinate preboarding and onboarding activities, including background checks, system entry, equipment, relocation coordination, and orientation.

  • Partner with hiring managers and cross-functional teams to ensure new employees have a smooth, engaging start.

  • Support new-hire check-ins and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.

  • Support employee lifecycle processes, including new hires, employment changes, internal transfers, and departures.

  • Assist with HR reporting, audits, and other operational projects as needed.

  • Coordinate with external payroll providers, benefits partners, and local HR or employment advisors as needed.

  • Support compliance with applicable Swiss employment requirements and internal policies in partnership with the Fractional HR leader and relevant local experts.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with the Fractional HR leader to prioritize recruiting and people initiatives aligned with business objectives.

  • Build trusted relationships with employees, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners.

  • Handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion and sound judgment.

  • Contribute to the development of consistent, scalable HR processes in a growing organization while recognizing the need for locally appropriate practices.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, and/or HR operations, ideally in a growing technology, energy, engineering, or other technical organization.

  • Demonstrated success managing multiple open requisitions and delivering a strong candidate experience.

  • Experience recruiting for technical, commercial, operational, or corporate roles; experience in engineering or energy-related hiring is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Swiss employment practices and HR administration, or experience supporting employees in Switzerland.

  • Fluency in English; professional proficiency in French is strongly preferred given the location in Nyon and the potential need to support local employees and external partners.

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems (Ashby preferred), HRIS platforms (HiBob), and standard productivity tools.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Switchboard
Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Technisch Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren?

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen

  • Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen.

  • Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen.

  • Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren.

  • Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht.

Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken

  • Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen.

  • Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies.

  • Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren.

Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken.

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken.

  • Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan.

  • Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn.

  • Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar.

Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact.

  • Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen.

  • Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • 27 vakantiedagen.

  • Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR).

  • Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken.

  • De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen.

  • En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren.

Zin om mee te bouwen?

Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je.

Compensation: €3K – €4K per month

jobs.title: Financial Director
jobs.description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Met een flinke groeispurt in het aantal aanvragen, een groeiende operatie in Nederland en onze eerste stappen in Duitsland breekt een nieuwe fase aan. Daarom zoeken we een Financial Director die onderdeel wordt van ons Management Team en de volledige verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor Finance.

Je wordt ons vierde MT-lid en werkt nauw samen met onze CEO, COO en People Director aan de verdere groei van DeWarmte.

Je begint niet vanaf nul. Onze founders hebben een sterke financiële basis neergezet, met een geïntegreerd financieel model dat zich al tijdens meerdere financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten heeft bewezen. Nu zoeken we iemand die daarop voortbouwt en Finance naar een volgend niveau brengt.

En daar krijg je alle ruimte voor.

Je ontwikkelt je eigen visie op de financiële organisatie, stelt een financiële roadmap op en bouwt een schaalbaar team. Je vertaalt cijfers naar betere beslissingen, daagt bestaande aannames uit en helpt ons de juiste keuzes te maken terwijl we groeien.

We zoeken iemand die strategisch denkt, maar ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt. Die het grotere plaatje ziet, maar net zo makkelijk de diepte ingaat om een financieel vraagstuk op te lossen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Financial Director ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor Finance én denk je als MT-lid mee over de koers van DeWarmte. Je bouwt voort op een sterke financiële basis en zorgt dat onze financiële organisatie klaar is voor de volgende groeifase.

Financiële strategie en business performance

  • Je ontwikkelt de financiële strategie en roadmap en vertaalt onze groeiambities naar concrete plannen en doelstellingen.

  • Je bent een strategische sparringpartner voor de founders en het MT. Je daagt aannames uit, beoordeelt kansen en helpt bij belangrijke investerings- en bedrijfsbeslissingen.

  • Je vertaalt financiële en operationele data naar inzichten die onze prestaties, winstgevendheid en besluitvorming verbeteren.

Financiële planning, control en financiering

  • Je neemt het eigenaarschap over ons geïntegreerde financiële model en bent verantwoordelijk voor budgettering, forecasting, scenarioanalyses en managementrapportages.

  • Je stuurt op cashflow, liquiditeit en werkkapitaal en zorgt dat we onze groei financieel kunnen blijven ondersteunen.

  • Je leidt de financiële voorbereiding van financieringsrondes en due diligence-trajecten en verzorgt de rapportages aan aandeelhouders.

  • Je waarborgt betrouwbare financiële administratie, rapportages en compliance, inclusief de verdere inrichting van onze Duitse activiteiten.

Bouwen aan een schaalbare finance-organisatie

  • Je ontwikkelt en leidt ons Finance-team, te beginnen met een Financial Controller, en stuurt onze externe financiële partners aan.

  • Je verbetert processen en systemen en benut automatisering en AI om Finance slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.

  • Je zorgt voor heldere financiële verantwoordelijkheden en controles, zonder onnodige bureaucratie.

Je combineert dus strategie met uitvoering. De ene dag bespreek je met het MT de langetermijnstrategie, de andere dag duik je zelf in een forecast, werk je aan een financieringsvraagstuk of verbeter je een proces. Je voelt je comfortabel op beide niveaus.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een Financial Director die financiële expertise combineert met ondernemerschap, leiderschap en een sterk gevoel voor de business.

Wat je meebrengt:

  • Ruime ervaring in senior financiële functies, bij voorkeur binnen een snelgroeiend bedrijf of een scale-up.

  • Een sterke achtergrond in zowel financial control als financial planning & analysis (FP&A).

  • Ervaring met het vertalen van bedrijfsstrategie naar financiële plannen en concrete resultaten.

  • Sterke financiële modelleervaardigheden en een goed begrip van P&L, balans, cashflow en de operationele factoren die deze beïnvloeden.

  • Ervaring in een hardware-, productie-, energie-, logistieke of andere werkkapitaalintensieve omgeving is een groot voordeel.

  • Ervaring met financiering, fundraising, kredietfaciliteiten of due diligence is een plus.

  • Het vermogen om een financiële functie en team op te bouwen, zonder zelf de aansluiting met de dagelijkse praktijk te verliezen.

  • Affiniteit met technologie, automatisering en AI.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels op professioneel niveau.

Minstens zo belangrijk vinden we hoe je werkt:

  • Je denkt als ondernemer. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers en begrijpt hoe Finance bijdraagt aan het succes van het hele bedrijf.

  • Je hebt een eigen visie. Je brengt ideeën mee, daagt de status quo uit en durft de founders en andere MT-leden kritisch tegen te spreken.

  • Je bouwt voort op wat goed werkt. Je neemt de tijd om de business en bestaande processen te begrijpen, voordat je bepaalt wat beter kan.

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap. Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren, maar ziet kansen, stelt prioriteiten en komt in actie.

  • Je combineert strategie met executie. Je krijgt energie van richting bepalen, maar net zo goed van zelf dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

  • Je voelt je thuis in een scale-up. Je houdt van snelheid, kunt omgaan met verandering en onzekerheid en hebt geen volledig uitgewerkt plan nodig om vooruitgang te boeken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €7.500 en €9.000 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

  • Een sleutelrol binnen ons Management Team, met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe invloed op de toekomst van DeWarmte.

  • De ruimte om je eigen visie te realiseren en een financiële organisatie op te bouwen die met ons meegroeit.

  • Deelname aan ons SAR-programma, waarmee je financieel meeprofiteert van de groei en het succes van DeWarmte.

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • Iedere dag een gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor.

  • Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport.

  • Een informele, ondernemende werkomgeving met korte lijnen, ambitieuze collega's en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Een echte plek aan tafel. Als vierde lid van ons Management Team heb je directe invloed op onze strategie, prioriteiten en toekomst.

De kans om iets op te bouwen. Er ligt een sterke financiële basis, maar jij krijgt de ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om de financiële organisatie, het team en de roadmap voor de komende jaren vorm te geven.

Een bedrijf midden in een belangrijke groeifase. In een fase van groeiende activiteiten en internationale ambities stap je in op een moment waarop sterk financieel leiderschap echt het verschil kan maken.

Een ondernemende, hands-on cultuur. We nemen snel beslissingen, geven mensen veel verantwoordelijkheid en zoeken continu naar manieren om beter te worden. We waarderen mensen die kritisch meedenken, elkaar helpen en plannen omzetten in actie.

Een missie die ertoe doet. We bouwen technologie die de energietransitie versnelt. Met jouw werk help je duurzame verwarming voor steeds meer huishoudens bereikbaar te maken.

Klaar om mee te bouwen?

We zoeken iemand die meer wil dan verantwoordelijk zijn voor de cijfers. Iemand die wil meebouwen aan een bedrijf, richting wil geven en blijvende impact wil maken.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
jobs.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

  • Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

  • Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

  • Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

  • Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us:

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

  • An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

  • Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

  • Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

  • A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

  • A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.


What you bring along:

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

  • 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

  • Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

  • UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

  • Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

  • Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to have:

  • Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

  • Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

  • Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

Our Development department is responsible for the technical design of new features, owns the architecture, and does technical operation. We are organised in agile end-to-end teams, working with well-defined and transparent processes. Our tech stack is centred around Microsoft .NET on Azure.

To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking to bring an Engineering Manager to the team.

The job 

The Engineering Managers (internally referred to as Heads of Engineering) are responsible for the performance of our development teams and the quality of our platform. You will be responsible for line managing the engineers of up to three development teams, ensuring they have the right direction, skills, and support to deliver high-quality results. Besides this, you will contribute to improving our agile way of working and strengthening engineering practices throughout the Development department.

Key result areas include:

  • Leadership and accountability: You are the hierarchical manager of the engineers in your teams and are accountable for growing those teams to become autonomous and highly performing. You set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and are accountable for individual and team performance. You actively identify and address performance issues and skill gaps, coaching and developing engineers to become more self-sufficient and effective.

  • Delivery and execution: You take responsibility for ensuring your teams deliver high-quality software in a predictable and efficient manner. You proactively manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, taking action when delivery or quality is at risk and driving improvements where needed.

  • Technical quality: You use your technical background to assess and challenge engineering decisions, ensuring that software solutions meet the required standards for quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You work closely with engineers and technical leads to promote sound technical decisions and address technical debt

  • Continuous improvement: You drive improvements in engineering processes, ways of working, and the adoption of modern technologies, practices, and tools. You identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve delivery performance, and strengthen engineering quality across teams.

  • Team development: You build and maintain high-performing teams by ensuring the right balance of skills, experience, and perspectives. You proactively identify development needs, support professional growth, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Quality and documentation: You promote strong engineering standards, effective quality control, and clear technical documentation to support the long-term stability and maintainability of our platform.

  • Strategic contribution: You contribute to setting the strategic direction of the Development department, translating broader objectives into concrete improvements and actions within your teams.


Requirements

We are looking for a strong and accountable engineering leader who combines a people-oriented approach with a clear focus on delivery, technical quality, and results. You empower your teams and create an environment where people take ownership of their work. You have a strong agile mindset without being dogmatic about tools and frameworks, and you know when to coach, challenge, or take decisive action to improve performance.
