  • 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, preferably in a tech scale-up or SaaS environment.

  • A solid background in software engineering, with the technical expertise to evaluate engineering decisions and assess software quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Proven experience in leading engineering teams, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and addressing skill gaps through coaching, feedback, and development.

  • A strong focus on delivery and execution, with the ability to take ownership of results, proactively manage risks, and drive improvements.

  • Extensive knowledge of software development processes, modern engineering practices, and agile ways of working.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions, provide constructive feedback, and collaborate with different stakeholder groups.

  • The ability to think and act strategically while also translating plans into concrete actions and measurable improvements.

  • Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus.

  • A drive for continuous learning and self-improvement.

  • A sustainable mindset!

Our offer

Working at GreenFlux means working in a dynamic, innovative, and informal organization, where new ideas and developments move quickly, and each day brings new opportunities and challenges. At one of the most inspiring locations in Amsterdam, you will have the chance to actively contribute to a sustainable future!

We are striving towards an international and inclusive team, so we also offer Visa sponsorship and relocation compensation to expats.

Join our revolution in mobility and energy!

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team.

Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.

Our stack:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

  • Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

  • DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required:

  • Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

  • Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

  • Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics.

  • Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

  • Cloud & data: You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

  • Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

  • Languages: English. German is a big plus.

  • Hybrid setting: You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

  • Availability: 100%, as soon as possible.

  • Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred:

  • Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

  • Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools.

  • Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset:

  • Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

  • Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

  • Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

  • About you: A short description of yourself.

  • Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

  • Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

  • Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

  • Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.

Senior Product Manager - Business Banking

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As Senior Product Manager, you'll own a significant part of our Business Banking product, one of the newest and most ambitious areas we're building at Mollie.

This is a build from scratch opportunity. Mollie's position here is rare: we're a payment service provider with a large, established customer base that is now building a full banking proposition on top of it. That means you get the ambition and pace of building something new, combined with the resources, customers, and best practices of a scaled business. You'll work alongside experienced, passionate product leaders who've done this before.

You'll lead a cross-functional team across design, product, and data analytics. There are no direct reports in this role, but you'll own the team's day to day performance and make sure things ship on time.

What you'll ship

  • Net-new propositions, not incremental iteration. You're building experiences that don't exist yet.

  • Customer-facing product and APIs across the Mollie app (web and native mobile) for business banking customers.

  • A banking proposition layered on Mollie's existing payments infrastructure, reaching customers who are already active and engaged.

What you'll bring

  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team in an everyday, hands-on capacity

  • Comfort with the full product lifecycle, including early-stage building and scaling

  • Ability to operate in a high-ambition, high-resource environment alongside experienced and passionate product leaders from across the industry

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: SAP Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

jobs.title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

  • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

  • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

  • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

  • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

  • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

  • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities

1. Storytelling That Converts

  • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

  • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

  • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

  • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

  • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

  • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

  • Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

  • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

  • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

  • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

  • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

  • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

  • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

  • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

  • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

  • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

  • Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

  • Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

  • CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

  • Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

  • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations

  • Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

  • Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

  • Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers?

  • Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

  • Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

  • Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

  • 25 days paid vacation per year.

  • Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

  • Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

What if the busy work just got out of the way?

Behind every great employee experience is a quiet system: the onboarding that feels effortless, the leave handled with care, the paycheck that's right the first time. It's craft most people never see, and we think it deserves the same care we put into the product. We want People Ops that feels like a great mechanical watch: you never think about it, and it's never wrong.

Imagine the first day at a company where every laptop, login, and handshake worked on the first try. That's the bar.

We're looking for a Head of People Operations to lead that work. You'll shape the strategy across People Operations and Total Rewards operations, making everyday work simpler, more reliable, and increasingly agent-enabled.

 - Lead a team that wears many hats. You'll coach, set the roadmap, and still get your hands dirty. No boredom guaranteed.

 - Work across the whole company. Partner with People, Finance, Payroll, Legal, IT, and BizTech to make handoffs smooth and change stick.

 - Measure what matters. Use service, quality, and adoption data to keep improving, with data integrity and audit readiness built in.

 - Make change stick. Align partners across the company and drive adoption.

 - You've built People programs and operational processes from the ground up.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life's work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down
   
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â 

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

  • High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients
  • Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better
  • Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential
  • High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected
  • Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â  politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â 

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â 

This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â 

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations ManagementÂ 

  • Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly.
  • Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â 
  • Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â 
  • Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â 
  • Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â 
  • Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ 

  • Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time.
  • Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â 
  • Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â 
  • Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â 
  • Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â 
  • Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â 
  • Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â 

Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ 

  • Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â 
  • Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â 
  • Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â 
  • Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â 
  • Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â 
  • Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â 
  • Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â 
  • Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â 
  • Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances.
  • Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â 

Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ 

  • Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â 
  • Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â 
  • Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â 
  • Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â 

Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ 

  • Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â 
  • Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â 
  • Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â 
  • Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â 
  • Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â 
  • Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â 

Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ 

  • Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â 
  • Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â 
  • Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â 
  • Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â 
  • Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â 
  • Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows.
  • Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows.
  • Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â 
  • Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â 

Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ 

  • Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â 
  • Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â 
  • Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â 
  • Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â 
  • Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â 
  • Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â 
Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required QualificationsÂ 

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â 
  • Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â 
  • Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â 
  • Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â 
  • Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools.
  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required.
  • Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â 
  • Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â 
  • Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â 
  • High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment.

Â Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 
  • 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â 
  • Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred.
  • Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â 
  • Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â 
  • Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â 
  • Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â 
  • Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â 
  • Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â 
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â 
What We Offer

This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

How to Apply

Your application won't be considered without a cover letter. Your cover letter should explain why you're uniquely qualified for this particular position, and why you would be a great fit for our law firm. Generic, copy/paste cover letters will be discarded.

Upload your cover letter and resume, in PDF format, through the software program where you're viewing this announcement.

Please do not call or email us about this opening.

jobs.title: Accounting Operations
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

  • Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

  • Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

  • Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

  • Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

  • Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

  • Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

  • Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates residing in Australia or Singapore only. You can work from anywhere within those countries. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through a variety of communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

 - Deliver high-touch Enterprise support at scale, navigating complex account needs alongside Customer Success and Sales

Requirements

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Currently based in Australia or Singapore.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the default tool of choice for high-performance teams to build their products. A fully remote company from the start, our team is distributed across the US, Latin America, and Europe. No matter where we come from, we are makers at our core. We love new challenges and care deeply about the quality of our work.

Role summary

We're looking for a Creative Producer to help bring Linear's creative work to life. You'll work closely with Linear's internal creative studio, the Magic team, to manage projects across brand, marketing, and product launches.

In this role, you'll help keep our creative team focused and moving forward. From managing incoming requests and coordinating projects to tracking timelines and aligning stakeholders, you'll make sure great ideas turn into great work that ship on time.

What you’ll do

 - Manage creative projects from initial brief through production and delivery, keeping timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders aligned

 - Own the intake and coordination of creative requests across teams, helping prioritize work and allocate resources effectively

 - Work closely with the Creative Director to plan projects, manage priorities, and keep the team's workload organized

 - Coordinate designers, engineers, copywriters, and external collaborators to ensure projects move forward smoothly

 - Work closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, and other teams to align on project goals, priorities, timelines, and deliverables

 - Maintain clear project documentation, timelines, and status updates, ensuring everyone has visibility into ongoing work

 - Identify potential blockers early, resolve dependencies, and continuously improve how the creative team operates

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of experience in creative production, project management, or a similar role at a tech company or creative agency or in-house studio

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities

 - Excellent communication skills and confidence working with creative teams and cross-functional stakeholders

 - A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership and attention to detail

 - Good creative judgment and an appreciation for high-quality design and craftsmanship

 - Experience working with designers, developers, and other creative disciplines

 - Bonus: A background in design or hands-on experience with creative tools and workflows

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work-life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (early exercise, extended exercise)

 - Stipend to set up your home office

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Role Overview

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

Ecosystem Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Run growth experiments for Notion’s Startups and SMB programs. You’ll turn promising ideas into measurable customer and revenue growth, moving from a signal in the data to a live experiment and a clear readout. Unlike a narrowly scoped growth role, you’ll work across acquisition, product experiences, AI-enabled systems, and operations—partnering with Ecosystem Growth, Storytelling, Product, and Engineering. On a typical week, you might query behavior data, prototype an in-product flow, launch a campaign workflow, and decide whether the signal is strong enough to scale.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Establish Startups and SMBs as a proving ground for growth ideas that can expand Notion’s acquisition, activation, and revenue.

 - By your 90th day, map the relevant funnel, data sources, and existing growth bets with partners, then ship and evaluate your first experiment from hypothesis to customer-facing launch.

 - By your 90th day, use AI as a practical collaborator by building an AI-assisted workflow for audience research, campaign iteration, quality checks, or analysis—with clear human judgment and data guardrails.

 - By the end of your first year, build and iterate a portfolio of growth programs, using SQL and customer research to identify overlooked opportunities and decide where to invest next.

 - By the end of your first year, turn the strongest experiments into reusable programs, playbooks, and measurement systems that other teams can run—and raise the bar for how Notion evaluates growth opportunities.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - A track record of shipping growth or operations projects, with a clear account of what you personally built and what changed as a result. This matters because the role owns the path from idea to measurable outcome.

 - Strong SQL and analytical judgment: you can work through messy data, test assumptions, and distinguish a promising signal from a misleading result.

 - Hands-on experience building campaigns or automated workflows in tools such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.

 - The ability to turn an ambiguous goal into a practical plan, unblock yourself where possible, and communicate clearly when you need help from another team.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including a willingness to use AI as a real collaborator and to build better workflows as you learn what works.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $180,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

   - Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.

   - Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

   - Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.
   
   - Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.
   
   - Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.

 - Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.

 - Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.

jobs.title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja teollisuuteen, Tampere
jobs.description: KOKENUT SÄHKÖAUTOMAATIOASENTAJA – VAKITUINEN PÄIVÄTYÖ TAMPEREELLAEtsimme kokenutta sähköautomaatioasentajaa teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävään Tampereelle.Jos sähkö- ja automaatioasennukset ovat sinulle tuttua työtä ja pystyt tarttumaan tehtäviin itsenäisesti, tässä voi olla hyvä seuraava työpaikka.Työskentelet teollisuuden ympäristössä osana asiantuntevaa kunnossapidon kokonaisuutta. Pääset tekemään käytännön työtä, jossa oma osaamisesi näkyy konkreettisesti tuotannon ja valmistuksen sujuvuudessa.MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?Tehtävässä työskentelet monipuolisten teollisuuden sähkö- ja automaatioasennusten sekä kunnossapitotehtävien parissa.Edustat tehtävässä asiakasyritystämme, joka toimii teollisuuden alihankkijana ja pitkäaikaisena yhteistyökumppanina omille asiakkailleen. Työskentelet osana asiakaskohteen tuotanto- ja kunnossapitoympäristöä ja olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että työt tehdään laadukkaasti, turvallisesti ja sovitusti.Työpäivä on pääsääntöisesti maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00–15.30.Työssä ei ole reissutyötä tai vaihtuvia työmaita, vaan työpisteesi sijaitsee Tampereella Myllypurossa.MIKÄ TEKEE TÄSTÄ TYÖSTÄ KIINNOSTAVAN?Työskentelet merkittävän teollisuusalan toimijan tuotanto- ja kunnossapitoympäristössä osana heidän pitkäaikaista alihankinta- ja yhteistyöverkostoaan.Pääset siis näkemään läheltä modernia teollisuusympäristöä ja tekemään sähkö-, automaatio- ja kunnossapitotöitä, joilla on konkreettinen vaikutus tuotannon sujuvuuteen ja toimintavarmuuteen.Työympäristö on nykyaikainen, siisti ja erittäin hyvätasoinen. Tässä työssä oma kädenjälkesi näkyy konkreettisesti: onnistunut kunnossapito ja toimivat sähkö- ja automaatioratkaisut vaikuttavat suoraan siihen, että tuotanto pysyy sujuvana ja turvallisena.ETSIMME SINUA, JOS * olet koulutukseltasi sähköautomaatioasentaja * sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta sähkö- tai automaatioasennuksista * sinulla on kokemusta teollisuudesta tai kiinteistöpuolen asennuksista * pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti * olet oma-aloitteinen ja yhteistyökykyinen * ymmärrät, että teollisuusympäristössä työturvallisuus on aina etusijalla * sinulla on riittävä suomen kielen taitoTässä tehtävässä aikaisempi käytännön kokemus on tärkeää. Etsimmekin kokenutta asentajaa, joka pystyy ottamaan työn haltuun ja työskentelemään itsenäisesti.KORTIT KUNNOSSA?Työturvallisuus-, tulityö- ja EA1-kortit katsotaan eduksi.Jos kaikki kortit eivät ole vielä voimassa, se ei välttämättä ole este – tarvittavat kortit on mahdollista suorittaa.MITÄ SAAT MEILTÄ? * Kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn * säännöllisen päivätyön klo 7.00–15.30 * siistin, nykyaikaisen ja hyvän työympäristön * pysyvän työpisteen Tampereella – ei reissutyötä * mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi teollisuuden parissa * työn, jossa näet konkreettisesti oman kätesi jäljen tuotannon sujuvuudessa * mahdollisuuden siirtyä myöhemmin asiakkaan omille kirjoille.Työsuhde alkaa henkilöstövuokrauksen kautta. Tavoitteena on, että työntekijä voi halutessaan siirtyä kuuden kuukauden jälkeen asiakkaan palvelukseen.PALKKAPalkkaus on 15–19 €/h, riippuen osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta, Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.TYÖPAIKKA Tampere, MyllypuroTyöpaikalle pääsee hyvin myös julkisilla, ja bussipysäkki sijaitsee kävelymatkan päässä.KIINNOSTUITKO?Jos olet kokenut sähköautomaatioasentaja ja etsit vakituista päivätyötä siistissä ja nykyaikaisessa teollisuusympäristössä, jätä hakemuksesi.Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta hr@worknow.fi [hr@worknow.fi] tai puhelimitse numerosta 0401603159. Puhelimitse tavoitat meidät parhaiten arkisin klo 14–16.Worknow Oy työnantajana * Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi * Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan * Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen * Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaanMeille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja onnistut.

jobs.title: Purchasing and Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description: We are looking for a Purchasing and Logistics Coordinator for a permanent position in Oulu. We are seeking a proactive and organised person who keeps day-to-day practical matters running smoothly and enjoys working with laboratory staff and external partners.The main focus of the role is purchasing and logistics. You will make sure our laboratories have the materials they need, handle day-to-day purchasing, negotiate agreements and maintain contact with suppliers. You will coordinate incoming deliveries and outgoing shipments. You will be responsible for inventory management and support the development of purchasing and storage practices, as well as related software solutions and processes. Through your work, you will help our laboratories run smoothly every day.The role also includes responsibility for our laboratory facilities. This is a smaller but important part of the role, and repair and maintenance needs may occasionally increase the workload. You will be responsible for the safety and upkeep of the premises, including key management, safety equipment, cleanliness, and the proper functioning of fume hoods, ventilation, cooling and pressure differentials. You will coordinate actions with service providers and the landlord and respond to alarms in exceptional situations. You have a good understanding of building services (heating, plumbing, ventilation and electrical systems). You will handle troubleshooting, work orders and supply purchases, and carry out minor repairs yourself when needed.You have a relevant vocational qualification, good IT skills, and good spoken and written Finnish and English for daily work. The role requires the ability to prioritise, respond to changing situations and work with a wide range of people. You communicate clearly and in a timely manner, both internally and with external partners. Knowledge of chemicals and experience with laboratory facilities and operations are considered an advantage.We offer a varied role in a growing company, a friendly work community and colleagues across our international organisation. Your workplace will be in Oulu, and the role requires you to work on site. This permanent position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

jobs.title: Analyst, KONE, Espoo
jobs.description: About the roleIn this role, your primary focus will be on hands-on project management, ensuring clear communication regarding project schedules and structures across various teams. You will analyze vast datasets and additionally, you will play an active role for an external project tool, taking strong ownership of system processes. This is an exceptionally dynamic and flexible position, where responsibilities might expand as the project progresses.This role is mainly based on-site at the office in Espoo, with some scope for flexibility.This is a fixed-term role until the end of June 2027.Work tasks- Driving overall project progress, tracking timelines and communicating structures across teams- Analyzing large transactional datasets- Taking ownership of system processes and data management- Adapting flexibly to shifting project priorities and taking on new responsibilities when neededWe are looking for- 2-3 years of experience in consulting, MBB preferred, or Private Equity or Venture Capital analyst roles, or Business Controller / Financial Controller roles- Problem solving and logical analyses skills, experience in structuring and breaking down complex business issues- Suitable educational background- Fluent English- Excellent MS Office skills (especially advanced Excel)We are looking for an outgoing, self-driven, and adaptable person who thrives in a constantly changing environment. You possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, strong decision-making capabilities, and high resilience under pressure. A flexible mindset and a proactive approach to work are key to succeeding in this role.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description: Ammattiopisto Spesia on valtakunnallinen ammatillinen erityisoppilaitos, jossa uskomme jokaisen ihmisen mahdollisuuksiin oppia, kasvaa ja loistaa omalla tavallaan. Meille merkityksellinen työ tarkoittaa arkea, jossa opiskelijoita kohdataan yksilöinä, heidän vahvuuksiaan vaalitaan ja heitä tuetaan kohti työtä ja itsenäistä elämää.
