Ohjaat ja motivoit opiskelijoita heidän opinnoissaan ja arkielämän taidoissa erilaisissa oppimisympäristöissä. Kannustat ja ohjaat heitä kohti tutkintokoulutusta sekä työelämää. Työskentelet opettajan työparina ja osana moniammatillista tiimiä, jossa yhteistyö ja avoin vuorovaikutus ovat avainasemassa. Työsi ytimessä on opiskelijan kokonaisvaltainen tukeminen ja vahvuuksien esiin nostaminen kohti tutkintokoulutusta.Toivomme sinulta- Hyviä ohjaus- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.- Itseohjautuvaa työotetta ja kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa- Kykyä innostaa ja motivoida opiskelijoita tutkintokoulutukseen ja työelämään.- Kokemusta erityisnuorten kanssa työskentelystä.- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta. (ammatillinen perustutkinto, ammatti- tai erikoisammattitutkinto tai AMK)- B-luokan ajokorttia.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Tiiviin ja kannustavan moniammatillisen työyhteisön. Merkityksellisen työn, jolla on todellinen vaikutus opiskelijoiden elämään Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa työn sisältöihin Vakaan ja arvopohjaltaan vahvan organisaation tuen.Työ on kokoaikatyötä 38 h 15 min / viikko, lukuun ottamatta oppilaitoksen loma-aikaa, jolloin työtä ei ole tarjolla. Palkkauksessa ja muissa työsuhteen ehdoissa noudatamme Yksityistä opetusalaa koskevaa työehtosopimusta. Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on noin 2368-2710 € / kk. Palkka riippuu tehtävään olennaista hyötyä tuovan aiemman työkokemuksen määrästä. Mainittu palkkahaarukka on ilmoituksessa kerrotun työajan mukainen. Tehtävään valitun on toimitettava nähtäväksi lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Olemme savuton työnantaja.Kiinnostuitko? Lisätietoja antaa Koulutuspalvelupäällikkö Sari Tulonen sari.tulonen@spesia.fi 040 900 4025 Lähetä hakemuksesi 6.11.2026 mennessä hakulinkin kautta. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan koeaikaa. Mistä työssä on kyse? Tässä tehtävässä vastaat englannin kielen lähi- ja verkko-opetuksesta ja ohjauksesta eri koulutusalojemme osaamistarpeisiin vastaten. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan korkeakouluopetuksen kehittämistehtäviin. Lähimmiksi työkavereiksi saat yhteisten opintojen opettajista koostuvan lämminhenkisen joukon. Miksi meille kannattaa hakea? Meillä teet vaikuttavaa työtä, jonka tulokset näkyvät koko yhteiskunnassa. Työskentelemme yhdessä laadukkaan korkeakouluopetuksen ja opiskelijoidemme kieli- ja viestintäosaamisen, kieli- ja kulttuuritietoisuuden sekä kansainvälisyyden eteen. Meillä on tiivis yhteishenki, joka yhdistää kaikkia opiskelijoista henkilökuntaan. Työskentelemme yhdessä tiedon ja tutkimuksen eteen ja tämä näkyy niin, että kaikki ovat valmiita auttamaan toisiaan. Arvostamme yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Meille on päivänselvää, että voit suunnitella omaa työtäsi ja työaikojasi. Haluamme, että voit antaa itsestäsi parasta työssä sekä vapaa-aikana. Palkkasi on Ammattikorkeakoulujen työehtosopimuksen mukainen. Pidämme hyvinvoinnistasi huolta tarjoamalla kattavan työterveyshuollon. Lisäksi tuemme vapaa-ajalla virkistäytymistä liikunta-, hieronta- ja kulttuurieduilla. Me Xamkissa työskentelemme uutta oppien ja toisiamme kirittäen. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittyä työsi mukana. Kannustamme sinua kehittämään osaamistasi jatkuvasti, ja siksi tarjoamme sinulle Xamkin avoimen ammattikorkeakoulun opinnot veloituksetta. Entä mitä odotamme sinulta? Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot ovat ammattikorkeakouluista annetun asetuksen mukaiset eli ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. Lisäksi edellytämme opettajan koulutusta tai vaihtoehtoisesti se tulee suorittaa 3 vuoden kuluessa työtehtävän aloittamisesta. Odotamme kokemusta englannin kielen opetuksesta ja opiskelijoiden ohjaamisesta. Kokemus korkeakoulu- tai ammatillisesta opetuksesta katsotaan eduksi.Arvostamme joustavaa ja itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä monialaiseen tiimityöhön. Arvostamme monipuolista opetusosaamista ja vahvaa digipedagogista osaamista. Pystyt käyttämään opetuskielenä sekä englantia että suomea.Miten hakuprosessi etenee? - Hae paikkaa tämän ilmoituksen alalaidasta ja liitä hakemukseen ansioluettelosi. Todistukset pyydämme valitulta. - Ensimmäisiä haastatteluita voidaan järjestää jo hakuaikana.- Olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin hakemuksen jättäneisiin viimeistään valinnan jälkeen. Jos sinulle jäi kysyttävää, pyydämme ottamaan yhteyttä yhteyshenkilöön.

Tehtävä voi mahdollisesti jatkua määräajan jälkeen. Tehtävän sijoituspaikka on Tampereen toimipiste.Tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti vesitalouden asiantuntijatehtäviä. Tehtävänhaltijan päätehtävät ovat:- Valtion vastuulla olevien vesistösäännöstelytehtävien toteutus ja muiden säännöstelyn luvanhaltijoiden ohjaus eri vesitilanteissa Kokemäenjoen vesistöalueella.- Tulva- ja kuivuusriskien vähentämiseen tähtäävien toimenpiteiden ja hankkeiden edistäminen ja ohjaus yhteistyössä sidosryhmien kanssa. - Tulvatilanteessa ja tulvan uhatessa osallistuminen tilannekuvan tuottamiseen, viranomaisyhteistyön järjestämiseen ja asiantuntijatuen antamiseen muille sidosryhmille.- Valtion vesioikeudellisten lupien lupavelvoitteista sekä vesistörakenteiden kunnossapidosta, perusparannuksista ja patoturvallisuudesta vastaaminen Pirkanmaan alueella.- Maa- ja metsätalouden vesienhallinnan osalta kuivatushankkeiden ja -kuivatusyhtiöiden ohjaus ja neuvonta sekä vesienhallintahankkeiden edistäminen. Työssä on tärkeää yhteensovittaa vesienkäytön erilaisia tarpeita kuten tulvasuojelu, vesivoimatuotanto, vesienhoito ja virkistyskäyttö sekä ottaa huomioon ilmastonmuutos. Tehtävän hoidossa pääsee verkostoitumaan laajasti muun hallinnon, yritysten ja asiakasryhmien kanssa.

Emme valitettavasti ota vastaan sähköpostihakemuksia.Me SOLissa käytämme siivoustyön ammattilaisistamme nimitystä palveluvastaava, sillä he ovat vastuussa tuottamastaan palvelusta eli erinomaisesta siivousjäljestä ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä. Jos etsit työtä mukavassa työporukassa ja jossa pääset näkemään kätesi jäljen, hae meille nyt.Tervetuloa mukaan aurinkoiseen tiimiimme!Tarjoamme- Kattava perehdytys- Esihenkilön vankkumaton tukiSOL Palvelut OyMeille on tärkeää työssä viihtyminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri – toimintaamme ohjaavat SOL arvot: aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas, arkiluovuus, yrittäjyys, luotettavuus ja iloinen työn tekeminen.Jos nämä arvot resonoivat kanssasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!Arvostamiamme ominaisuuksia ovat myös oma-aloitteisuus, vastuullisuus ja täsmällisyys.SOL on osaava, monipuolinen ja kansainvälisesti toimiva suomalainen palvelualan perheyritys, jonka keskiössä on aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas ja iloinen työn tekeminen.SOL Palvelut Oy:n palveluihin kuuluu siivous- ja toimitilapalvelut. jobs.title: Key Account Manager OOH
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Key Account Manager OOH---Key Account Manager OOH=======================Be a part of Nestlé. Be a force for good.Help us make a real difference on a global scale. With a presence in almost 185 countries, we're dedicated to our purpose of unlocking the power of food and beverages to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. Whether you're starting or continuing your career, explore how you can work with us.Key Account Manager OOH======================= **Location and work model:** Home\-based position in Switzerland, with regular travel to visit clients across the country and regular visits in our head office in La Tour\-De\-Peilz   **Contract type / duration:** Permanent   **Activity rate:** 80\-100%    **Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet**As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Professional, your mission is to acquire, develop and strategically manage key accounts across the out\-of\-home food and beverage channel, delivering sustainable sales growth and profitability through tailored culinary and beverage solutions. You'll make a difference by identifying new business opportunities and building trusted partnerships with customers, operators and distributors, in close collaboration with , Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to combine strategic account leadership with an entrepreneurial and consultative approach in a dynamic market.  **How you'll make an impact as a** **Key Account Manager** * Developing existing and new out\-of\-home key accounts by translating customer, channel and market insights into tailored growth opportunities* Identifying and converting new business opportunities across out\-of\-home foodservice environments* Building trusted relationships with customers, operators and distributors to co\-create culinary, coffee and beverage solutions that respond to their operational and commercial needs* Leading consultative commercial discussions and business reviews that strengthen customer performance, profitability and long\-term partnerships* Using distributor networks and cross\-functional expertise to expand Nestlé Professional's presence and bring customer solutions successfully to market* Acting with an entrepreneurial mindset, taking ownership from opportunity identification through implementation and measurable commercial results   **What will make you successful*** Bringing solid key account management and business development experience in foodservice, HoReCa or another out\-of\-home environment* Understanding the out\-of\-home ecosystem, including the role of operators, distributors and different foodservice channels, and using these insights to identify growth opportunities* Applying consultative and solution\-based selling, commercial planning and negotiation capabilities to create tailored customer propositions and sustainable value* Demonstrating a strong hunting mindset and the ability to acquire new customers while developing long\-term strategic partnerships* Communicating fluently in and French. English is a plus.* Working with autonomy, commercial curiosity and resilience, while collaborating across functions to turn opportunities into measurable results and shared value   **At** **Nestlé,**  **we place people at the heart of everything we do** Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life: * Paid holidays beyond legal requirements* Learning and development opportunities to grow your career* Performance based bonus* Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program* Strong employer contribution to your pension plan* Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions* Attractive employee discounts across various products and services   **What to expect from our hiring process** We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone. The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.  *Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.*  **Ready to Be a Force for ?** Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.******jid8a2c9e9jm jit1043jm jiy26jm

responsabilités et sachant faire preuve d'anticipation.* Qualités relationnelles, empathie et aisance dans la communication.**NOUS VOUS OFFRONS**  En plus d'un poste de travail attrayant au cœur de jobs.title: Product Owner H/F, 80-100%, CDI - Direction de l'Insertion et soutien opérationnel
jobs.description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Product Owner H/F, 80-100%, CDI - Direction de l'Insertion et soutien opérationnel---Product Owner H/F, 80\-100%, CDI \- Direction de l'Insertion et soutien opérationnel===================================================================================== **Description de l'entreprise**   **A l'Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève**Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d'un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l'aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l'asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d'intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l'isolement des seniors.Nous sommes plus de 1' 600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40' 000 personnes.En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l'inclusion, nous valorisons l'intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l'innovation et favorisons la prise d'initiative et l'expérimentation.   **Description du poste**   **Vos missions**Rattaché\-e directement à la directrice adjointe de l'ISO, référente stratégique, vous êtes l'interface entre les besoins métiers et les capacités technologiques.En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe produit Cœur de métier de la Direction des systèmes d'information et du numérique (DirSin), vous veillez à ce que les systèmes d'information répondent aux besoins opérationnels de la fonction, qu'ils soient exprimés au travers de projets ou de demandes d'évolution.  Dans le cadre du mandat qui vous est confié par la fonction, vous disposez de l'autonomie nécessaire pour arbitrer et prioriser les besoins et évolutions fonctionnelles de votre périmètre, en veillant à la cohérence avec les orientations stratégiques de l'ISO.Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :1\. Maximiser la valeur du produit :* Recueillir, analyser, formaliser et arbitrer les besoins et initiatives métier en explicitant leurs objectifs, résultats attendus, valeur et impacts en cas de non\-réalisation ;* Challenger et prioriser les besoins du périmètre en fonction de leur valeur métier et des priorités de la fonction ;* Maintenir et prioriser le backlog des évolutions fonctionnelles en fonction de leur valeur métier, en coordination avec le gestionnaire de produit ;* Garantir la pertinence et la valeur ajoutée des évolutions envisagées ;* Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction, d'usage et d'efficience des solutions et intégrer les exigences légales et réglementaires.2\. Assurer l'alignement stratégique :* Traduire les orientations stratégiques de la fonction en feuille de route produit et veiller à la cohérence avec les priorités métier ;* Veiller à la bonne gestion des priorités concernant la mise en place des applications et solutions technologiques dans le périmètre concerné ;* Apporter la vision et les priorités métier aux revues de la feuille de route pilotées par le gestionnaire de produit ;* Participer aux instances de gouvernance, comités de priorisation et revues de portefeuille.3\. Contribuer et participer à l'amélioration continue :* Définir les critères d'acceptation, mobiliser les utilisateurs concernés et assurer la validation métier des solutions livrées ;* Mesurer les résultats obtenus au regard des objectifs attendus et contribuer aux revues et rétrospectives d'amélioration continue.4\. Faciliter la communication et la collaboration :* Assurer une communication fluide entre les utilisateurs, les parties prenantes métier et l'équipe du produit Cœur de métier ;* Organiser et coordonner les phases de tests et de validation ;* Contribuer à l'accompagnement au le changement lié aux évolutions des solutions numériques.   **Qualifications**   **Votre profil*** Bachelor HES, diplôme universitaire ou formation jugée équivalente dans les systèmes d'information, la gestion de projets ou un domaine métier pertinent ;* Une certification ou formation complémentaire en gestion de projet ou méthodes agiles ( , PMP, Scrum, Agile) constitue un atout ;* Expérience confirmée d'au moins 3 ans dans l'identification, l'analyse et la formalisation de besoins métier ainsi que dans la priorisation d'évolutions fonctionnelles au sein d'un système d'information ;* Expérience dans la préparation et l'organisation de tests de validation ;* Pratique des méthodes agiles telles que Scrum ou Kanban ;* Une expérience dans une organisation publique, parapublique ou institutionnelle constitue un avantage ;* Excellente capacité d'analyse et de synthèse ;* Aptitude à négocier, influencer et fédérer sans lien hiérarchique direct ;* Solides compétences de communication avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;* Bonne compréhension des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'information ;* Connaissance des réglementations relatives à la protection des données et à la sécurité de l'information (LPD, RGPD, LIPAD) ;* Des connaissances du contexte et de l'environnement de l'Hospice général sont un atout ;* çais : excellente maîtrise orale et écrite ;* Anglais : bonnes connaissances professionnelles.   **Informations supplémentaires**   **Nous vous proposons*** Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et respectueuse ;* Un développement continu des compétences grâce à une politique de formation attractive ;* Des opportunités d'évolution de carrière et de mobilité interne ;* De nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives à vivre en collectif au sein de l'institution.Taux d'activité : 80\-100%Type de contrat : CDIClasse de fonction : 18Entrée en fonction : Dès que possibleDélai de postulation : 24\.10\.2026 **Notre processus de recrutement**Il se déroule en plusieurs phases selon le type de poste, où chaque étape conditionne la suivante : analyse de candidature, entretien téléphonique, entretiens de recrutement avec la hiérarchie et les ressources humaines et le cas échéant, test métier et/ou évaluation type assessement pour les postes de management et certains postes spécifiques. **Ce poste vous intéresse ?**Le service de recrutement de l'Hospice général se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (lettre de motivation, CV, diplôme de plus haut niveau de formation atteint, certificats de travail). Pour des raisons d'optimisation du suivi des candidatures, nous vous invitons à postuler uniquement en ligne via notre espace carrière, LinkedIN ou JobUp, en réponse à une offre d'emploi spécifique. Les candidatures papier et mail ne seront pas prises en considération. ![Hospice général]( )* Cour de Rive 12 1204 Genève** ![Hospice général]( )* Cour de Rive 12 1204 Genève** jid5f43bf8jm jit1042jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo  100 %
jobs.description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %---Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %=================================================== *Entreprise familiale active dans toute la Suisse, acteur incontournable de la distribution de vins et de boissons aussi bien aux privés qu'aux professionnels, le Groupe Alloboissons englobe une société de distribution de boissons (Alloboissons), un club de vin (DIVO), une chaîne de magasins spécialisés (Halle aux Boissons) et une société de négoce de vins (Les Vins ).* *Notre succès est avant tout dû au formidable travail de nos 184 collaborateurs qui s'activent au quotidien, sur 14 sites distincts, pour viser l'excellence de nos services. Le tout dans une démarche de dynamique participative où chacun peut et doit prendre sa place pour le bien de l'entreprise.* *Afin de renforcer notre équipe informatique, nous recherchons au plus vite (mais nous sommes prêts à attendre quelque peu si vous êtes la bonne personne) pour notre siège de Givisiez :* *Afin de faciliter la lecture, le masculin est utilisé dans cette annonce. Le poste est ouvert à toute personne, quel que soit son genre.*  Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %===================================================Notre ERP Odoo est le cœur opérationnel du Groupe : il orchestre l’ensemble des processus liés à la distribution, aux magasins, au négoce et au e\-commerce. En tant que business analyste et chef de projet, vous faites le lien entre les métiers et l’équipe IT. Vous transformez les besoins de nos 184 utilisateurs en solutions concrètes et vous pilotez les projets qui font évoluer notre ERP. **Votre environnement technique*** Odoo 16 à 20 hébergé on\-premise, 184 utilisateurs actifs  * Une équipe IT composée de : 1 business analyste, 3 développeurs, 2 supports (applicatifs/infrastructure), 2 apprentis.  * Vous rapportez au responsable informatique du Groupe Alloboissons   **Vos premiers défis***  **Fiabiliser notre reporting :** Recenser les besoins des métiers, définir des indicateurs clairs et partagés, puis accompagner la construction des tableaux de bord dont ils ont besoin chaque jour, sans passer par un export Excel.  *  **Remettre le standard au centre :** Revoir nos processus à la lumière du standard Odoo, challenger les demandes de développement spécifique et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption des bonnes pratiques.  *  **Conduire la migration Odoo 16 vers Odoo 20 :** Piloter le volet fonctionnel et organisationnel du projet, de l’analyse des écarts entre versions aux recettes avec les métiers, jusqu’à la formation des utilisateurs et au basculement en production. Le chantier le plus visible de votre première année.   **Vos missions***  **Analyser les besoins :** animer des ateliers avec les métiers (vente, logistique, magasins, achats, finance, etc.), cartographier les processus et identifier les axes d’amélioration.  *  **Concevoir les solutions :** rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, privilégier le paramétrage standard d’Odoo et arbitrer avec les développeurs lorsque du spécifique est nécessaire.  *  **Piloter les projets :** planifier, prioriser et suivre les projets de bout en bout (périmètre, délais, budget, risques) et coordonner les intervenants internes et les partenaires externes.  *  **Garantir la qualité :** préparer et conduire les recettes avec les utilisateurs clés et valider les livrables avant mise en A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. Le RFSM est un pôle de compétences médicales, infirmières et psychosociales spécialisé en santé mentale. Le RFSM recherche, pour son Secteur hospitalier de psychiatrie et psychothérapie de la personne âgée, **un\-e médecin adjoint\-e**. Dans le cadre de cette fonction de médecin cadre et sous la responsabilité du médecin directeur du secteur, vous participez activement à la conduite clinique, au développement des prestations et au fonctionnement du secteur. Le RFSM emploie 800 personnes et reste une institution à taille humaine avec une ambiance de travail chaleureuse et bienveillante. Fribourg est un canton de 350 000 habitants doté d'une université accueillant 11 000 étudiants. Marsens est situé à 50 km de Lausanne et à 30 km de Berne et dispose d'un parc immobilier non saturé avec des loyers bien inférieurs aux cantons de Vaud et Genève. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**L'Etat\-employeur encourage la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et offre un environnement et des conditions de travail attractifs à ses collaborateur\-trice\-s. jobs.title: Local Hosting Service Owner
jobs.description:
Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d) (80\-100%)  


  








Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy\-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best\-in\-class products, services, and solutions that are mission\-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting\-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.




Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d) (80\-100%)
==============================================




  








As a Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d), you are responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient delivery of local hosting and infrastructure services across Accelleron’s locations in Switzerland.



You take end\-to\-end ownership of on\-premises hosting environments, including servers, virtualization, storage, dedicated High\-Performance Computing (HPC) environments, and local data center infrastructure, ensuring stable operations, continuous improvement, service quality, and alignment with business needs.



Acting as the key interface between factory IT, global Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, service providers, and external partners, you ensure local requirements, enterprise standards, security policies, and strategic technology initiatives are effectively aligned and implemented. You manage changes, risks, compliance, service performance, resilience, and operational excellence through effective governance and stakeholder collaboration.



The role combines operational service ownership (RUN) with active contribution to infrastructure projects and modernization initiatives (BUILD), supporting factory growth, engineering and simulation environments, business continuity, lifecycle management, and long\-term infrastructure strategy from solution design through operational handover.



If you are a team player, a structured, reliable, and hands\-on infrastructure professional with strong stakeholder management skills a passion for delivering reliable services in a manufacturing and engineering environment, we look forward to getting to know you.



Your Responsibilities:
----------------------



### *Service Ownership \& Operations (RUN)*



* Own and continuously improve local hosting services, including servers, virtualization, storage, HPC environments, and data center infrastructure across Accelleron’s Swiss locations.
* Ensure stable, secure, resilient, and SLA\-driven operations for business\-critical factory and engineering environments.
* Act as technical authority for local hosting platforms, including capacity planning, infrastructure standards, and service governance.
* Manage incidents, problem resolution, root\-cause analyses, escalations, and operational risks.
* Ensure compliance with security, cybersecurity, regulatory, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements.
* Serve as the primary interface between local factory operations, global Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, and service providers.


### Lifecycle, Documentation \& Governance



* Define and maintain lifecycle, capacity, refresh, and modernization roadmaps for hosting services.
* Maintain infrastructure, asset, and operational documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, automation, and governance.
* Coordinate budgeting, purchasing, vendor governance, and service reviews with internal and external stakeholders.


### Vendor, Contract \& Cost Management



* Manage service providers, contracts, budgets, forecasts, and operational costs.
* Monitor and improve service delivery through SLA/KPI governance, escalation management, and performance reviews.
* Ensure effective collaboration between local service providers and global IT teams.


### Project \& Initiative Contribution (BUILD)



* Support and lead hosting\-related projects from solution design through implementation and operational handover.
* Lead and/or contribute to factory, infrastructure, modernization, and site expansion initiatives.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, application, cybersecurity, and external partner teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
* Drive automation, standardization, resiliency, and operational excellence across the hosting landscape.


Your Background \& Skills:
--------------------------



* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
* Strong expertise in on\-premises hosting, virtualization, storage, and data center technologies.
* Experience as a Service Owner or in managing infrastructure services with responsibility for SLAs, KPIs, service governance, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Experience in IT service operations, incident management, and vendor management; ITSM knowledge is an advantage.
* Experience in budget planning, cost management, and enterprise procurement processes; SAP knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with infrastructure standardization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, or other business\-critical operational environments is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in a global IT environment with international teams and service providers.
* Fluent German and good English (minimum B2\).
* High ownership, reliability, and willingness to support sites across Switzerland.


Your Benefits:
--------------



* Competitive compensation package.


* Performance\-related bonus opportunities for eligible employees.
* Supportive culture focused on trust, accountability, and flexibility.


* Global Parental Leave Program.


* Employee Assistance Program.


* Health and well\-being initiatives.


* Company canteen.


* Opportunities to work with global teams and industry\-leading technologies in a modern workplace.


We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website [](/).

for IGCSE and IB programmes. \* To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the school, and specifically within the provision for junior school students. \* To be actively involved in Test Engineer \- Function Validation (m/f/x)
============================================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You are responsible for the development, improvement and validation of the performance of axial piston machines
* You are responsible for establishing and improving standardised and automated test procedures to ensure reliable results and high quality
* You analyse measurement results and propose optimisation measures to improve products and reduce costs
* You use simulation tools to facilitate the interpretation and understanding of test results
* You identify the root causes of technical problems and independently develop innovative solutions
* You manage the implementation and evaluation of functional tests
* You provide technical expertise to assembly operators and test bench operators to ensure smooth operations
* You collaborate with various departments and internal customers to ensure effective coordination and the smooth execution of tests


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a higher education in microengineering, mechatronics, systems engineering or an equivalent field
* You have several years of professional experience in hydraulic systems development
* You are fluent in French and German and have a good command of English
* You have excellent knowledge of MS Office, Python, MATLAB, HBM Catman and NI DIAdem
* You have excellent analytical skills and demonstrate commitment, flexibility and autonomy. You also possess excellent professional communication skills


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)---Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)===============================================L’hôpital fribourgeois (HFR) s’engage au quotidien pour la santé de la population. Actif sur plusieurs sites, il offre une gamme complète de soins stationnaires et ambulatoires de haute qualité, en plaçant le bien\-être des patients au cœur de ses préoccupations. Respect, orientation patients, solidarité et engagement constituent les valeurs essentielles de ses 3’800 collaboratrices et collaborateurs.Vous avez l'opportunité de jouer un rôle clé dans la digitalisation au sein d'un hôpital au service de la population Fribourgeoise. Si vous avez une passion pour la technologie, la santé et l'innovation, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.  Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)===============================================ace à une activité croissante et des projets stratégiques en constante évolution, nous cherchons à renforcer notre équipe dédiée à la gestion des applications du système d’information médico\-technique. Rejoignez\-nous pour contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de nos services et accompagner notre développement. **Missions principales**Dans le cadre de la gestion du système d’information médico\-technique du domaine du laboratoire, vous serez chargé\-e de : **Gestion et exploitation des applications :*** Planifier, organiser et assurer l’exploitation courante d’un portefeuille d’applications supportant les activités du laboratoire.  * Coordonner la maintenance évolutive des applications en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.   **Coordination et relation fournisseurs :*** Assurer la liaison entre les utilisateurs, les équipes informatiques et les fournisseurs.   **Développement et intégration :*** Développer des interfaces et des scripts pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels spécifiques.   **Documentation et support :*** Rédiger, mettre à jour et gérer la documentation relative aux solutions logicielles, en partenariat avec les parties prenantes métiers.  * Fournir un support de 2ème niveau et servir de relais vers le support 3ème niveau (fournisseurs).  * Participer régulièrement au service de piquet du système d’information pour garantir la disponibilité et la continuité des services.   **Participation aux projets SI :*** Contribuer activement aux projets de l’HFR en lien avec le système d’information, en apportant votre expertise et vos recommandations.   **Projet Phare**Vous aurez l'opportunité unique de contribuer à un projet d'envergure : le renouvellement du dossier patient de l'hôpital. Ce projet, prévu pour les prochaines années, est un jalon important dans notre parcours d'innovation et d'amélioration continue de la qualité des soins. **Vos avantages*** Un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant au sein d'une équipe dédiée à l'excellence dans les soins de santé.  * La chance de travailler sur des projets innovants et d'avoir un impact réel sur le bien\-être des patients.  * Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.   **Votre profil :*** Formation supérieure (HES/EPF/Uni, brevet fédéral) en informatique ou équivalent  * Expérience dans la gestion technique d’applications et en coordinations d’intervenants  * Bonnes connaissances en SQL  * Compétences en développement de scripts et en intégration de solutions logicielles  * Avoir une expérience professionnelle dans une institution de soins constitue un plus  * Rigoureux\-se, consciencieux\-se et résistant\-e au stress  * Dynamique et ayant le sens des responsabilités  * Capacité à travailler en équipe, sens de la communication et esprit analytique.  * Langue maternelle français ou allemand avec de très bonnes connaissances de l’autre langue et de l’anglais (technique)   **Entrée en fonction :** 1er janvier 2027ou à convenir **Renseignements :** , Responsable des systèmes informatiques, tél : **Délai de postulation :** 31 octobre 2026Réf : HFR\-A\-264201   ![HFR Fribourg - Hôpital cantonal]()* Chemin des Pensionnats 2\-6 1708 Fribourg** ![HFR Fribourg - Hôpital cantonal]()* Chemin des Pensionnats 2\-6 1708 Fribourg**jidca7e72ejm jit1042jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Deputy School Director (Academic)---Deputy School Director (Academic)================================= **Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified  Deputy School Director (Academic)=================================to join the school from: **23\.08\.2027** **Your profile**The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application. **About us**Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. **What we offer**Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages. **How to apply**Deadline for applications: **23\.10\.2026**Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. **Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.** **Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s . **JOB PURPOSE**The role of Deputy School Director is a key management and leadership position in the school, and they are a pivotal member of both the School Council (the leadership team) overseeing many aspects of the operational management and leadership of the School. The role is primarily concerned with the school's academic leadership, with the other Deputy School Directors leading and managing school safeguarding, wellbeing, character education and boarding functions. Additionally, the Deputy School Director is an integral part of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), working alongside the School Director, CFO/COO, and other Deputy School Directors. Aiglon, distinguished by its philosophy and ethos, prioritises the holistic development of every child. As a school committed to character development and holistic education, we prioritise the student experience and ensure their wellbeing and safety, which are fundamental to their journey at Aiglon. **OBJECTIVES***      To deputise for the School Director as and when required.  *      To manage all academic aspects of the school.  *      The following list should not be considered definitive but act as a guide to those areas for which the Deputy School Director will be responsible.   **KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **MEMBERSHIP OF THE SCHOOL LEADERSHIP TEAM**1.      To be a member of the School Council and the ELT.  2.      To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.  3.      To ensure student needs and interests are placed at the forefront of all decisions made at the school.  4.      To be fully involved in the whole\-school strategic planning and implementing and developing the school’s vision of education.  5.      To be the representative and advocate for all direct reports.  6.      To work with all members of the School Council to ensure that students’ education is appropriate, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life and that the well\-being and safeguarding of students are prioritised.  7.      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.  8.      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.   **MANAGEMENT AND LEADERSHIP OF ACADEMIC ASPECTS OF THE SCHOOL, INCLUDING LEARNING, TEACHING, AND ASSESSMENT**1.      To monitor and evaluate the quality of teaching and learning in the school and to be proactive in devising and implementing strategies for high performance in these areas.  2.      Oversee the school reporting structure and academic assessment plans and monitor their delivery.  3.      To advise the School Director on academic policy and carry overall responsibility for the school's academic life, including chairing the Academic Leadership Group and leading new initiatives such as curriculum reviews and effective academic monitoring of students.  4.      To act as line manager to the ALG, Academic Heads of Departments and University Advising departments.  5.      To oversee the Learning Support Department and monitor the provision of Learning Support.  6.      In conjunction with the Assistant Heads, monitor and analyse all school public examination results.  7.      Management of student data and trends regarding academic performance and potential, including but not limited to overseeing the analysis and dissemination of data from year group examinations (e.g. MIDYIS and ALIS) and overseeing target setting and the administration of other measures of value added and academic performance.   **LEADERSHIP OF STAFFING, INCLUDING RECRUITMENT**1.      To be fully involved in recruiting new academic staff.  2.      To oversee the management of staff professional development days, inset and CPD (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).  3.      To be fully involved in new staff induction programmes (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).  4.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the academic staff have regular and useful performance management reviews.  5.      Manage the school’s PGCE programme.   **LEADERSHIP OF WHOLE\-SCHOOL ACCREDITATION**1.      To line\-manage the Accreditation Coordinator and ensure that all aspects of accreditation (CIS, NEASC, and IB) are well\-organised and well\-planned and that the School Director and School Council are fully informed about the progress of accreditation.   **MANAGEMENT OF UNIVERSITY ADVISING**1.      management of the Director of University Advising.  2.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding trends and patterns and new developments in university applications.  3.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding Year 13 university offers.   **MANAGEMENT OF LEARNING SUPPORT AND EXAMINATIONS**1.      management of the Head of Learning Support  2.      To work with the Head of Learning Support to oversee the applications for special consideration.  3.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the planning and management of internal and external examinations  4.      To work with the Assistant Heads to ensure the accurate and timely analysis and publication of examination results   **MANAGEMENT OF SCHOOL EVENTS AND MARKETING MATERIALS**1.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure school events are well\-planned and run smoothly.  2.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the well\-planning of Prize Giving, Graduation, and parent\-teacher events.  3.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure the Aiglon Guide is updated annually.  4.      To work with the Marketing and Communications team and the Director of Educational Systems to ensure Aiglon Study Guides are accurate and available to the school community.   **DIVERSITY, EQUALITY AND INCLUSIVITY**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the School’s DEIJ policies and procedures.   **SAFEGUARDING**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of safeguarding legislation and the School’s safeguarding policies and procedures and liaise closely with the Safeguarding lead.   **HEALTH AND SAFETY**1.      Ensure that up\-to\-date knowledge of health and safety legislation applicable to the role is maintained and that the school’s health and safety policies and procedures are fully implemented and adhered to.   **PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT**1.      Maintain and update personal knowledge and skills in line with legislation and the role's needs.   **GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**1.      To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director.  2.      To be on hand out of hours in the event of an emergency.  3.      Attend school functions and events as often as possible and support students and staff in their activities and endeavours.  4.      To be a teacher in their specialist area with a reduced teaching load.  5.      To participate in the duty rota of School Council members on certain weekends and weekend evenings.  6.      To be a member of the Critical Incident team.  7.      To undertake any other reasonable tasks delegated by the School Director.

jobs.description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Educational activities assistant (4 months replacement sick leave: 70-100%)---Educational activities assistant (4 months replacement sick leave: 70\-100%)============================================================================We are currently seeking an **Educational activities assistant** for a **4\-month temporary position (70–100%)** to support the coordination and delivery of ERS educational assessment activities, with a particular focus on the Adult and Paediatric HERMES examinations. The successful candidate will provide operational and administrative support, coordinate examination\-related activities, and work closely with expert committees, faculty members and international partners. The role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, a proactive approach and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a collaborative, international environment.Educational activities assistant (4 months replacement sick leave: 70\-100%)============================================================================**Role purpose**----------------The Educational Activities Assistant supports the delivery of ERS assessment activities, with a particular focus on the HERMES examinations for adult and paediatric. Working closely within the education team and the Assessment Director, Examination Committees, MCQ authors, national societies and internal stakeholders, the role ensures high\-quality assessment processes, supports the international development of HERMES examinations and contributes to the continuous evolution of ERS educational standards. **Key contribution areas**--------------------------### **1\. Governance \& operational coordination**Coordinate the operational planning and governance of ERS assessment activities by ensuring effective committees and MCQ authors support, examination delivery and continuous process improvement. **Key responsibilities*** Assist in the operational planning and delivery of the Adult and Paediatric HERMES examinations.  * Support Examination Committees activities, meetings, documentation and follow\-up actions.  * Monitor project plans, budgets, milestones and examination timelines to ensure timely delivery.  * Prepare reports, presentations, statistics and operational documentation supporting committee activities and decision\-making.  * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and examination delivery.  ### **2\. Learning pathways, assessments, accreditation \& certification**Ensure the quality, relevance and continuous development of ERS assessment activities by coordinating examination processes, supporting assessment design and promoting recognised educational standards. **Key responsibilities*** Assist in the development and delivery of the Adult and Paediatric HERMES examinations and other assigned assessment programmes.  * Support the continuous review and maintenance of examination blueprints, syllabi, question banks and assessment documentation.  * Coordinate MCQ author recruitment, onboarding, training and performance evaluation.  * Contribute to the development of innovative assessment approaches, digital examination solutions and AI\-supported translation/ initiatives where appropriate.  ### **3\. Global engagement, partnerships \& capacity building**Strengthen the international recognition and reach of ERS assessment programmes by developing partnerships, supporting national societies and promoting capacity building among assessment contributors. **Key responsibilities*** Coordinate translation initiatives to broaden access to ERS examinations and support multilingual delivery where appropriate.  * Maintain effective internal and external relationships with partners, providers and officers.  * Benchmark assessment practices and contribute to the continuous evolution of ERS examination programmes.  ### **4\. Collaboration \& cross\-functional Contribution**Contribute to a collaborative and high\-performing working environment by fostering teamwork, knowledge sharing and effective cross\-functional collaboration across ERS. **Key responsibilities*** Build effective working relationships across ERS departments and with external partners.  * Acquire knowledge and contribute to cross\-functional initiatives supporting organisational priorities.  * Promote collaborative ways of working and continuous improvement across projects and partnerships.  * On an ad hoc basis, contribute to projects and initiatives beyond the role’s defined responsibilities, in support of broader organisational needs.  Education \& professional background------------------------------------* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in education, health sciences, business administration, project management or a related discipline.  * Experience coordinating educational assessments, certification programmes or complex educational projects.  * Experience working with expert committees, examination boards or professional associations.  * Experience in an international scientific, medical, educational or not\-for\-profit environment is an advantage.  Your profile------------*  **A strong team player** with excellent interpersonal and communication skills  * High attention to detail and a solution\-oriented mindset  * Excellent command of **English**  * Strong multitasking, prioritisation, proactiveness and time management skills  * Proficient in MS Office  * Swiss or Swiss work permit holder  * Available immediately or at short notice  Application Process-------------------If you are interested in this position and see yourself contributing to our mission, please submit your full application (cover letter and CV). ![European Respiratory Society]( )* 4, Avenue Ste\- 1003 Lausanne** ![European Respiratory Society]( )* 4, Avenue Ste\- 1003 Lausanne** jide437c64jm jit1042jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Scientific Assistant – Real-Time Generative Models / Computer Vision
jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Biomedical Image Computing Group develops algorithmic solutions to enable automatic interpretation and forming of biomedical images, aiming to increase efficiency and accuracy in clinical practice and research.ProjekthintergrundThe enhancement of endoscopic videos is a critical yet complex task. These videos are integral to various clinical interventions, where the clarity of imaging data is essential for procedural success. Due to challenging imaging conditions, the quality of endoscopic videos can be significantly compromised by a range of artifacts. This project seeks to develop the next generation of enhancement algorithms tailored for endoscopic videos, with a focus on applications in real-time interventions. Development efforts will prioritize both enhancement quality and computational efficiency, particularly with respect to latency. The successful candidate will join the BMIC team at ETH Zurich and also be part of the Computer Vision Lab (CVL). The project is conducted in collaboration with an industrial implementation partner, who will provide support with hardware and software integration. The position is open immediately and initially limited to 8 months. Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThis position involves the implementation, optimization, and deployment of deep-learning image-enhancement models for real-time operation. Rather than focusing primarily on model training, the successful candidate will work on translating existing and new architectures into efficient real-time processing pipelines connected directly to an industrial camera system. Typical tasks will include profiling and optimizing models for low-latency inference, implementing and adapting neural-network architectures with real-time constraints in mind, integrating camera acquisition and preprocessing pipelines, and contributing to project deliverables and scientific manuscript preparation. Ihr ProfilMSc degree in computer science, machine learning, medical image computing, or a related field. Familiarity with neural-network-based image processing pipelines. Excellent programming skills and experience with Python. Experience implementing and validating neural-network architectures using PyTorch. Demonstrable experience with model deployment/acceleration (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA/C++, etc.), profiling tools, and camera/sensor integration is a plus. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Julio Jose Silva Rodríguez, julio.silva-rodriguez@vision.ee.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. jobs.description: R&amp;D Internship - Corrosion ProtectionPurpose of the roleWe at VAT Group AG invite a talented and passionate Internship candidate to join our Corporate R&amp;D.Fueled by the ever-growing demand for computational power, the leading-edge technology nodes (≤7nm) require process control at the atomic scale. At VAT, we are developing the next generation of advanced sensing and vacuum solutions for the semiconductor industry. Semiconductor manufacturing processes often utilize corrosive gases and plasma environments that pose a risk for VAT’s products. We are seeking an intern to join our team and focus on advancing the corrosion protection strategies for our sensors and products. This internship will be located in Zürich, Switzerland and will require occasional travel to Haag, Switzerland.What we offer  *  Join a global leader at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, we are a globally leading company in the semiconductor industry.  *  A technologically advanced and innovative working environment with Modern Laboratory and testing facilities.  *  Thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment that celebrates bold ideas and outstanding execution — where your potential knows no bounds.  *  Enjoy an exceptional working environment with great amenities at our VAT Group offices in Zurich and Haag.  *  Receive competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your expertise and contributions.Responsibilities   *  Support the development of protective measures to enhance material and sensor durability under extreme conditions.  *  Assist in the design, implementation, and testing of corrosion protection strategies.  *  Conduct failure analysis and material testing to identify failure mechanisms.  *  Design experiments for testing the durability of VAT’s products in plasma etching systems.Your competencies acquired at the end of the internshipThis internship aims to provide you with practical skills and knowledge in testing and experimental procedures in the semiconductor industry, preparing you for a future technical career. As a research &amp; development intern in our dynamic environment, you will get the opportunity to work on real-life industrial challenges. By the end of the internship, you will have acquired the following competencies:  *  Technical Skills: Gain hands-on experience in a cross-disciplinary project, where you will expand your knowledge in physics, chemistry, materials science, and both mechanical and electrical engineering.  *  Analytical Skills: Ability to plan, execute, and evaluate experiments, and to analyze and interpret experimental data.  *  Communication Skills: Experience in presenting technical information and progress reports, as well as participating in technical discussions.  *  Problem-Solving Skills: Practical experience in diagnosing and solving real-world problems in the semiconductor industry.  *  Collaboration Skills: Work within a dynamic team, including engineers, materials scientists, and designers, to address complex challenges.  *  Industry Experience: Insight into the practical aspects of product design, testing, and refinement within a commercial product development cycle.Qualifications  *  Current master’s student or recently completed master’s degree in materials science, chemistry, physics, or engineering.  *  Excellent communication skills, able to work independently, and passionate about learning.  *  Experience with or knowledge of material characterization and semiconductor fabrication.  *  (optional) Understanding of dry etching processes and thin-film deposition processes.  *  (optional) Practical experience working in a laboratory or clean environment.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head Client Lifecycle Integrity - Director - Member of Senior Management---Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management==========================================================================At Swissquote, we're all in.  All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.We're Switzerland's leading digital bank — 1,400\+ people across Europe, the Middle East and , building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. From trading and investing to everyday banking, we cover the full picture. We move fast, but we build things we're genuinely proud of. Have a look behind the scenes by checking on Instagram.Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can't offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there's space for both here.We've ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.Feeling it? It's a good start. Apply.Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management==========================================================================As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.  **Key responsibilities:** **1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management*** Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews. **2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring*** Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department. **3\. Process Effectiveness, Automation \& Continuous Improvement*** Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.* Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.* Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity\-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.* a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.  **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional experience in a leadership position in Operations, Compliance, AML, Risk Management or similar functions within a banking, financial services or fintech environment.* Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Law, Business Administration or equivalent degree.* Proven track record in process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and operational excellence.* A relevant certification in project management, process improvement or transformation (e.g. PMP) is considered an asset.* Strong understanding of howdata, technology, workflow tools and AI can be used to enhance control effectiveness, decision\-making and operational efficiency.* Strong expertise in client onboarding, KYC/AML, client lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring, with a broad understanding of related legal and regulatory requirements.* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities, particularly when dealing with complex or high\-impact regulatory and operational matters.* Demonstrated experience managing and developing large and diverse teams, with a strong track record of building high\-performing management structures, developing talent and leadership capabilities, and establishing effective career development and succession planning frameworks.* Past exposure to Executive Management, regulators, auditors and senior internal stakeholders.* High level of integrity, sound judgement and professional credibility, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative leadership approach.* Native French or English speaker, with full professional fluency in the other language. ![Swissquote Bank SA]()* Chemin de la Crétaux 33 0 Gland** ![Swissquote Bank SA]()* Chemin de la Crétaux 33 0 Gland**jide44f20ajm jit1042jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Head of Years
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Years (Up to Year 4)---Head of Years (Up to Year 4\)============================= **Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified  Head of Years (Up to Year 4\)=============================to join the school from:  **2027** **Your profile**The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application. **About us**Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. **What we offer**Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages. **How to apply**Deadline for applications: **30\.10\.2026**Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. **Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.** **Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s .JOB PURPOSEAiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5\-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8\.The school wishes to appoint, for 2027 (possibly January or 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative, caring, and dynamic Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) who will provide operational leadership, and support strategic development, for the lower junior phase up to Year 4, line manage class teachers and teaching assistants up to Year 4, and work in close partnership with the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced primary/early years specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in early childhood education, literacy and numeracy foundations, and outdoor/experiential learning. Knowledge of inquiry based learning, project based learning, or biophilic education would be preferable.This position involves a teaching component and presents a unique opportunity to lead and nurture our youngest learners in a world\-class alpine environment.KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES*      To put the students first.  *      To lead the day\-to\-day operational and educational provision for students up to Year 4, working in close partnership with and under the strategic oversight of the Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To participate actively in School Leadership Team meetings and contribute to strategic planning for the lower primary phase.  *      Direct line management of classroom teachers and teaching assistants across years up to Year 4, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and high\-performing staff team.  *      Direct operational delivery and coordination of the Mountain School programme up to Year 4, working closely with the Head of Expeditions and the Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To be the primary point of contact for day\-to\-day academic, pastoral, and operational matters for families and day students up to Year 4\.  *      To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.  *      Become involved in discipline and pastoral matters up to Year 4, ensuring student behavior aligns with school expectations.  *      To ensure smooth transition and induction for children entering Year 1 and progressing through to Year 4, preparing them seamlessly for upper junior years (Years 5\-6\).  *      To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the daily routine and learning environment of students up to Year 4\.  *      To participate in staff recruitment for lower junior phase positions as required by the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To be a classroom teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 20% reduction).  *      To embrace innovative forms of assessment, play\-based learning, and holistic reporting for young learners.  Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students*      To oversee the daily pastoral care, wellbeing, and progress tracking of all students up to Year 4\.  *      To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the School DSL, Director of School, and wellbeing team.  *      To work with the Director of School, Head of Curriculum and Academics and School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing, and healthcare in lower primary.  *      To implement a nurturing and sequential Wellbeing programme across years up to Year 4 aligned with the Spirit Curriculum.  *      To promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion formally within the Spirit Curriculum to build a kind, positive, and inclusive culture among young learners.  *      To liaise with the Activities Coordinator and House teams to ensure appropriate co\-curricular activities, sports, and outdoor experiences for students up to Year 4\.  Academic Responsibilities*      To lead the daily implementation and delivery of the lower junior curriculum (up to Year 4\), including the 'Wonder' projects and early literacy/numeracy frameworks.  *      To work closely with the Head of Expeditions to plan and deliver the experiential Mountain School curriculum for students up to Year 4\.  *      To champion sustainability, outdoor exploration, and biophilic education within the classroom and Mountain School activities.  *      To ensure Aiglon's Guiding Principles for learning are embedded in all teaching and learning activities for students up to Year 4\.  *      To assist in monitoring student progress, organising learning interventions, and supporting personalised learning in coordination with the Head of Learning Support and Head of EAL.  *      To support the Head of Curriculum and Academics in teacher professional reviews and development for staff who teach up to Year 4\.  *      To assist in overseeing internal assessments, reporting structures, and parent\-teacher communication up to Year 4\.  *      To promote and ensure effective and safe usage of school educational technology (such as Google Apps for Education and age\-appropriate devices).  *      To participate in staff development days and continuous professional learning for the lower primary phase.  *      To monitor and enhance standards of teaching, learning, and classroom environment up to Year 4\.  *      Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Director of the School or Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.  *      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.  *      Embrace artificial intelligence and other related educational innovations to enhance early learning experiences.  This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.     ![AIGLON COLLEGE SA]()* Avenue Centrale 61 1885 Chesières (VD)** ![AIGLON COLLEGE SA]()* Avenue Centrale 61 1885 Chesières (VD)**jid61657adjm jit1043jm jiy26jm
