jobs.title: Technical Sales / Business Development
jobs.description:
STALKONE is looking for a Technical Sales / Business Development professional to develop sales and actively acquire new customers in the Norwegian market. The role involves regular customer meetings across Norway and is intended for a candidate already based in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

  • experience in technical sales, business development or industrial services sales,

  • knowledge of the Norwegian industrial, offshore, onshore or maritime market,

  • basic technical understanding of steel structures, manufacturing or machining,

  • ability to independently acquire customers and conduct technical-commercial discussions,

  • current residence in Norway,

  • Polish and English language skills,

  • Category B driving licence, access to a car and availability for customer meetings.

Preferred qualifications

  • an existing business network in Norway,

  • experience in subcontracting services or industrial staffing,

  • technical experience in steel structures, welding, mechanical engineering or CNC machining,

  • experience with RFQs, tenders and contract negotiations,

  • Norwegian language skills.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • identify and acquire new customers, projects and RFQs,

  • develop business relationships in offshore, onshore, maritime and industrial sectors,

  • maintain direct contact with purchasing, project, production and technical departments,

  • identify customer needs and present STALKONE's technical and production capabilities,

  • support quotation preparation and commercial negotiations,

  • monitor upcoming projects, investments, maintenance activities and shutdowns,

  • meet customers across Norway,

  • manage sales opportunities from initial contact through to contract award

Vi tilbyr

  • a key commercial role in the Norwegian industrial and offshore market,

  • cooperation with an experienced technical and production organisation,

  • a broad portfolio of manufacturing, subcontracting and personnel services,

  • significant independence in developing customer relationships and sales opportunities,

  • direct influence on the development of STALKONE's activities in Norway

Om arbeidsgiveren:

STALKONE provides technical, manufacturing and subcontracting services for industrial, offshore, maritime and onshore clients. Our services include qualified personnel for projects in Norway, steel structures and components manufactured in Poland, machining and production based on customer documentation, as well as technical and industrial subcontracting services.

jobs.title: Kjøkkenassistent i Heggebø Friluftsbarnehage SA
jobs.description:
Øystre Slidre kommune har fått tilskudd til "toppet bemanning" i barnehagen, og vi ønsker å bruke tilskuddet til å tilsette en kjøkkenassistent for barnehageåret 2026/2027. Stillingen er ledig fra dags dato og varer til og med 10.08.2027. Stillingen er på 24% og har arbeidstid på 3 timer 3 dager i uka. Arbeidstiden er ved lunsjtid.

Stillingen kan kombineres med vikartimer på avdeling.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Være fleksibel når det gjelder oppgaver som skal utføres.

  • Være pålitelig og pliktoppfyllende.

  • Kunne samarbeide med og skap gode relasjoner til barn og voksne i barnehagen.

  • Ha humor og glede i arbeidshverdagen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Planlegge og tilbrede enkle varmmåltid og brødmåltid, i hovudsak lunsj.

  • Vaske og rydde etter måltidet.

  • Andre oppgaver kan også være aktuelt, ut ifra bakgrunn i erfaring og kompetanse til den som blir ansatt.

  • Vikartimer på avdeling kan være aktuelt.

Vi tilbyr

  • Det stilles ingen formelle utdanningskrav, og vi søker deg som har interessen for matlaging, lage enkle måltider og har interesse for å jobbe med barn.

  • Om du har vært utenfor arbeidslivet en periode, er du velkommen til å søke på stillingen hos oss.

  • Du må ha grunnleggende norskkunnskap og forstå beskjeder som blir gitt.

  • Det er krav om politiattest etter barnehagelova §30.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en privat Friluftsbarnehage med 42 plasser, i et flott nyoppusset bygg og unikt uteområde. Vi har fokus på friluft og fysiske aktiviteter, samtidig fokuserer vi alltid på barnets beste. Hver barnehagehverdag fylles med livsglede, lek, mestring og læring. Vi holder til i Heggenes ca.15 km fra Beitostølen. Vårt fokus er personalutvikling og å skape et godt sted for både barn og voksne. Du er selvstendig, blid og positiv, til stede for barna og glad i å være ute og legge til rette for gode aktiviteter og lek både inne og ute. Mer informasjon om barnehagen, gå inn på: https://heggebo.barnehage.no/

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra nettopp deg!

Ta gjerne kontakt for mer informasjon.

jobs.title: Territory Manager , Peripheral Vascular Health
jobs.description:
Medtronic’s Peripheral Vascular Health team supports vascular disease treatment through endovascular and minimally invasive therapies, advancing clinical education, therapy adoption, and patient access across Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

This field-based commercial role is responsible for developing the PVH business within an assigned territory in Norway. The position requires regular customer visits, attendance at procedures, participation in educational activities, and collaboration with Nordic and cross-functional teams. Frequent travel throughout Norway and occasional travel within the Nordic region are required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and some sales experience within medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, or a comparable commercial environment.

  • Experience managing customer accounts and delivering against defined sales or business objectives.

  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly throughout Norway and occasionally within the Nordic region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the medical device industry, particularly in peripheral vascular, interventional radiology, vascular surgery, embolization, or venous therapies.

  • Knowledge of the Norwegian healthcare system, hospital purchasing processes, and stakeholder landscape.

  • Experience supporting public procurement, tender submissions, and contracting activities.

  • Experience providing clinical, technical, or procedural support for complex medical technologies.

  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals in hospital-based environments.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Territory Manager, Peripheral Vascular Health, you will be responsible for driving business growth, managing customer relationships, and supporting the adoption of Medtronic vascular therapies across your territory. You will work closely with healthcare professionals and internal partners to execute territory plans, identify new opportunities, and deliver commercial and clinical support to customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned with business objectives to drive market growth and achieve sales targets.

  • Identify, engage, and build relationships with key stakeholders, including physicians, nurses, procurement teams, administrators, and key opinion leaders.

  • Grow existing accounts and develop new business opportunities through effective account management and territory planning.

  • Deliver product presentations, clinical education, and technical support to support therapy adoption and customer success.

  • Support procedures and provide product expertise to healthcare professionals when required.

  • Lead commercial discussions and collaborate on pricing, contracting, and public tender activities.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, customer activity records, and opportunity pipelines using company systems.

  • Partner with Nordic colleagues and cross-functional teams to support customer needs, educational activities, and business initiatives.

Vi tilbyr

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Pay range / Rango salarial / Intervalo salarial /Fascia retributiva / Tranche de salaire / Gehaltsband / Salaribereik: Norway: 589,600.00 NOK - 884,400.00 NOK |

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first --- developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

jobs.title: A-larm søker nå ny Generalsekretær
jobs.description:
A-larm søker en tydelig, samlende og utviklingsorientert generalsekretær som vil lede organisasjonen videre i en spennende fase.

Generalsekretæren er A-larms øverste administrative leder og rapporterer til styret ved styrets leder. Rollen innebærer ansvar for å lede administrasjonen, følge opp styrets vedtak og sikre god drift.

Som generalsekretær får du blant annet ansvar for

· å lede og utvikle A-larm i tråd med styrets vedtak, samt sikre gjennomføring av vedtatte strategier, planer og mål

· økonomistyring, budsjett og virksomhetsoppfølging

· å organisere og forberede løpende styremøter samt årsmøtet

· å lede organisasjonsutvikling og endringsprosesser

· å arbeide for økt synlighet, positiv medlemsutvikling og en sterk og bærekraftig organisasjon

· å bidra til at teknologi, digitalisering og nye arbeidsformer benyttes strategisk og effektivt

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en leder med god organisasjonsforståelse, evne til å skape tillit, god gjennomføringsevne og som følger opp utviklingen av organisasjonen sammen med styret. Du må kunne balansere strategisk ledelse med praktisk gjennomføring og motiveres av å utvikle både mennesker og organisasjon.

Du bør ha et sterkt engasjement for rusfeltet, og vi verdsetter både fagkompetanse og egenerfaring -- eller en kombinasjon av begge.

Kvalifikasjoner:

· utdanning innenfor ledelse og økonomi

· relevant ledererfaring med personal- og resultatansvar

· erfaring med økonomistyring, strategi og personalledelse

· erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling og endringsledelse

· evne til å bygge tillit og gode relasjoner internt og eksternt

· erfaring fra frivillige organisasjoner eller medlemsorganisasjoner

· god skriftlig og muntlig formidlingsevne

· forståelse av politiske prosesser og rammevilkår

· relevant formalkompetanse

Vi tilbyr:

Som generalsekretær i A-larm får du en meningsfull lederrolle i en organisasjon med stor utviklingskraft, sterke miljøer og høy aktivitet.

Du får ta del i et viktig nettverk med samarbeidspartnere og andre interesseorganisasjoner, og du vil lede et engasjert organisasjonsmiljø med dedikerte ansatte og frivillige.

Lønn etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

A-larm er en landsdekkende bruker- og pårørendeorganisasjon på rusfeltet.

Organisasjonen ble etablert i 1995, er én juridisk enhet og er livssynsnøytral og partipolitisk uavhengig. Administrasjonen holder til i Kristiansand. Den utøvende virksomheten er det regionene våre som står for. De drifter og gjennomfører A-larms daglige aktiviteter for brukere og pårørende. I dag har vi aktiviteter i Agder, Akershus, Buskerud, Innlandet, Oslo, Rogaland, Telemark, Trøndelag, Vestfold, Vestland og Østfold. I tillegg har vi samarbeid med Finnmarkskollektivet i nord, og flere fra de nordligste fylkene deltar i våre nasjonale digitale pårørendetjenester.

I arbeidet vårt vektlegger vi både fag og erfaringsbasert kunnskap. Staben vår består derfor av personer med fagkompetanse og med egenerfaring som bruker eller pårørende. Sammen praktiserer vi <<erfaring og fag på samme lag>>.

A-larm har sitt hovedkontor i Kongensgate 4 i Kristiansand.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher in land surface modelling of forest ecosystems (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST E.P.
jobs.description: SD-26154-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN LAND SURFACE MODELLING OF FOREST ECOSYSTEMSFixed term contract | Belvaux | 12 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/How will you contribute?The researcher will participate in two complementary projects focused on modelling forest ecosystem responses across seasonal to decadal timescales: SORTIE (Seasonal Forecast of Forest Status in Luxembourg), funded by the National Collaboration Program (NCP) of the Copernicus Climate Change Services, and HiDRATE (Integrating High resolution Data from Remote sensing And land surface models for Transpiration and Evaporation mapping), funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR). The overarching objective is to quantify the predictive capabilities of land surface models in capturing forest ecosystem responses under stress and to translate their outputs into diagnostic indicators. To address these challenges, both projects will jointly employ the latest version of the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (CTSM), multiple in situ measurements (e.g., sap flow, eddy-covariance fluxes, dendrometers), various Earth Observation (EO) data streams, and climate information across multiple temporal scales. The selected candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling group of the Environmental Sensing and Modelling unit and will collaborate closely with the national project partner MeteoLux and the international project partner CESBIO.The selected candidate will play a central role in both projects and their scientific outputs. The primary mission is to: (1) implement the CTSM model across multiple forest monitoring sites; (2) develop a robust analytical framework to assess model sensitivity to environmental drivers using in situ and EO data; and (3) synthesize model outputs into diagnostic indicators that integrate meteorological conditions, forest fluxes, phenological dynamics, biomass productivity, and forest health status. To accomplish these objectives, the candidate will apply advanced statistical methods and leverage high-performance computing (HPC) resources. The candidate will actively contribute to the dissemination, valorisation and transfer of project results. This will include presenting findings at national and international scientific conferences, publishing in reputable peer-reviewed journals, and communicating outcomes to relevant stakeholders. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!EducationPhD degree in Environmental Science, Forest Science, or similar disciplinesExperience and skillsProven previous experience (minimum 2 years) in Land Surface ModellingDemonstrated expertise in forest ecosystem processes and their response to environmental driversKnowledge of post-processing techniques and analysis of seasonal predictions and climate projectionsExperience in manipulating and analysing in-situ and Earth Observation dataHigh proficiency in high-level scripting languages (e.g., Python)Proven previous experience in using High-Performance ComputingLanguage skillsFluency in English (and French), both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.Your LIST benefitsAn organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projectsSustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green societyInnovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we doAn environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areasPersonalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skillsMulticultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforceDiverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitionsGender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insuranceFlexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchersApply onlineYour application must include:A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experienceA scientific CV with contact detailsList of publications (and patents, if applicable)Contact details of 2 referencesPlease apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.Application procedure and conditionsWe kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. jobs.title: Telecoms Software Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description: Description des tâches:Telecom Software EngineerWith our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in satellite IoT connectivity and next-generation non-terrestrial network (NTN) services. As the first company to seamlessly integrate standardized cellular technology with satellites, OQ Technology is transforming how connected devices communicate beyond the reach of terrestrial networks.Our technology enables secure, scalable connectivity for industries including Oil & Gas, Utilities, Mining, Agriculture, Maritime, Logistics, Transport, and Environmental Monitoring, helping organizations monitor and manage critical assets anywhere in the world. We are now extending this capability to 5G NR-NTN direct-to-device (D2D) services, connecting commercial smartphones and dedicated terminals directly to satellites.As we continue to develop our 5G NR-NTN D2D missions, we are looking for an experienced Telecom Software Engineer to join our Telecom Team at our facility in Luxembourg, reporting to the Team Lead. You will develop, integrate and test the OQ 5G gNodeB protocol stack adapted to run onboard our satellites, working across 3GPP specification study, NTN adaptation of L2 and L3, C/C++ implementation, and porting to space-representative processing platforms. You will validate your work hands-on in our telecom lab against commercial smartphones and D2D terminals, and collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary team spanning the 5G Core, user equipment, and the satellite payload.Job Location:  LUXEMBOURGStarting Date:  Start ImmediatelyJob Type:  UNLIMITEDTasks:  The tasks below are representative and not exhaustive. The Company may assign the post holder to other tasks where it considers this in its interests.General and Teamwork• Contribute to OQ's 5G NR-NTN D2D projects, delivering assigned tasks to the agreed schedule and quality.• Carry out hands-on experiments in the Telecom Lab to test and validate new implementations and theoretical concepts.• Take part in Telecom Team brainstorming sessions and technical discussions, and share relevant findings with the team.• Report task progress and completion status to the Team Lead at regular intervals.• Support colleagues on other project tasks and on hands-on troubleshooting.• Take on additional work on the 3GPP NTN NB-IoT protocol stack, eNodeB and UE sides, including end-to-end and interoperability testing with third-party and commercial devices.Technical• Review mission and project documentation to understand scope, objectives and technical baseline, including statements of work, proposals, 3GPP discussion notes and progress reports.• Study the NR-NTN direct-to-device problem across the use cases, protocol layers and procedures each mission depends on, including services such as SMS over NAS and emergency broadcast, the L2 and L3 adaptations NTN requires, TDD DL-UL pattern design, initial access and system information acquisition, and the effects of long propagation delay and Doppler shift on the link.• Review the relevant 3GPP specifications to extract requirements, confirm compliance and identify technical constraints.• Build working knowledge of the open-source gNodeB stack: code structure, software architecture, build, installation, configuration and execution.• Port and adapt the stack to onboard processing environments, covering cross-compilation, embedded Linux targets, real-time performance, CPU and memory budgets, and interfaces to the FPGA/SDR physical layer.• Develop new C/C++ code blocks from the preceding studies, and carry out unit, functional and end-to-end testing in the lab on representative hardware.• Gain knowledge of the other system elements: the 5G Core Network (5GC), the UE (commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals), and the satellite platform (onboard processing units, FPGA, SDR and RF front-end).• Maintain continuous documentation of research, analysis, requirements, design, proposed solutions and evaluation results.• Commit work to the project GitLab repositories under version control on a continuous basis.• Raise concerns, open questions, risks and critical issues with the team as soon as they are identified.RequirementsEssential• MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.• Minimum five years of professional software development experience in telecoms or embedded systems.• Commercial experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux, in a real-time or embedded context, including multithreaded and latency-sensitive code.• CMake-based build systems.• Working knowledge of 5G NR Higher L1 and L2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC) and of the cell search, system information and random-access procedures.• Ability to read 3GPP specifications and translate them into design and code.• Automated unit and integration testing with GoogleTest/GoogleMock or Catch2, run through CTest within GitLab CI, with JUnit XML test reports and code coverage (gcov, lcov or gcovr) published to merge requests.• GitLab workflows: merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines using containerised (Docker) build and test runners.• Debugging and runtime analysis with GDB and sanitisers (AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer).• Protocol and log analysis using Wireshark and UE or terminal diagnostic tools.• Professional written and spoken English.Desirable• Experience with open-source RAN stacks (for example srsRAN or OpenAirInterface).• Familiarity with 3GPP Release 17 and later NTN features.• MAC scheduler, carrier aggregation or TDD pattern design experience.• Embedded Linux build systems (Yocto, Buildroot) and cross-compilation for ARM targets.• Static analysis tools (clang-tidy, cppcheck) and performance profiling (perf, Valgrind).• SDR platforms (for example USRP) and FPGA-to-software PHY interfaces.• Understanding of satellite systems and orbital effects on the radio link.• Exposure to ECSS software standards (ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C).• NB-IoT or NB-IoT NTN protocol experience.• Integration and verification, field testing or interoperability testing with commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals.• Python for test automation (for example pytest).Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.Benefits• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary - an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.• Regular company events and team activities.Études:  Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:  MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.

jobs.description: Description des tâches:The European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is the institution responsible for governing 56 National Federations throughout Europe and is recognised as such by the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB).Our ultimate goal is to promote Volleyball and Beach Volleyball and to raise the status of our sport to a higher level.Whether the game is played indoors or on sand, Volleyball connects and brings people together from children playing in their free time up to professional and elite athletes.We cultivate a strong sense of togetherness with all stakeholders, the Member National Federations, their national leagues, clubs, players, coaches, organisers and other partners of European Volleyball, from grassroots level to the top events.We are currently looking to recruit a:CRM ManagerLocation: Luxembourg headquartersType of contract: Full time - PermanentDepartment: Digital & TV DepartmentReporting to: Digital, Content & OTT ManagerSalary: CompetitiveStart date: ASAPThe RoleThe European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is seeking a highly analytical and strategic CRM Manager to join the Digital & TV Department. You will be the primary architect of our fan data ecosystem. Your core mandate is to significantly grow the CEV fan database, develop sophisticated email marketing automations, and build hyper-segmented audiences. You will utilize gamification tools (such as Engage Engine) and high-value incentives to convert anonymous digital traffic intoknown, monetisable contacts, directly driving OTT subscriptions, ticket purchases, and commercial revenue.Key ResponsibilitiesDatabase Growth & Data Capture Strategy:• Develop and execute a comprehensive, multi-channel strategy to significantly grow the CEV fan database, targeting key European and Global markets with demographic and interest segments.• Take full ownership of our gamification and data-capture platforms (e.g., Engage Engine) and design interactive campaigns.• Optimise website data capture points, landing pages, and lead-generation funnels to maximise conversion rates.Email Marketing & Automation:• Manage the end-to-end creation, scheduling, and deployment of all CEV email communications, including newsletters, promotional offers, and event announcements.• Design, build, and maintain automated email journeys (e.g., welcome series, abandoned cart for OTT, subscription win-back campaigns, birthday offers).• Conduct continuous A/B testing on subject lines, content layouts, and call-to-actions to improve open rates, click-through rates, and overall conversion.Segmentation & Targeting:• Build and maintain a highly structured and segmented database, ensuring data hygiene and compliance with GDPR regulations.• Categorise fan based on granular data points including geography, favoured national teams, preferred clubs, and past purchasing behaviour (e.g., PPV buyers vs. annual subscribers).• Utilise this segmentation to deploy hyper-targeted, localised marketing campaigns that increase fan engagement and reduce subscriber churn.Reporting & Commercial Insights:• Provide comprehensive monthly performance reports detailing database growth metrics, email campaign performance, and subscriber acquisition costs.• Generate custom commercial reports for the leadership team and Commercial Department, proving the monetary value Your analysis - built on SQL, statistical methods, data visualization, and generative AI — will directly support capital investment decisions (where and when to add fulfillment center capacity, retrofits, and building design) as well as operational decisions around staffing strategy and under-the-roof productivity.This is a particularly exciting time to join: the team is actively integrating Same Day delivery into our First Mile topology strategy, opening up new problems to solve and new impact to drive. You will split your time between analytical work (roughly 75%) and cross-functional project management (roughly 25%), working with senior leaders on high-stakes recommendations that shape how we move goods across Europe.Key job responsibilities- Analyze First Mile network capacity, flow, and cost data using SQL, statistical modeling, and data visualization to build recommendations that inform capital and operational investment trade-offs across the European delivery network.- Collaborate with partner teams to influence and maintain a roadmap of First Mile improvement projects, launching pilots for the most complex opportunities and building scale-up business cases that quantify benefits, risks, and required resources.- Design and maintain analytics tools and dashboards — applying generative AI where it accelerates insight — to surface defects, track process performance, and extract actionable findings from pickup through fulfillment center injection.- Lead regular business reviews with cross-functional stakeholders to monitor project progress, identify and remove bottlenecks, and drive alignment on priorities.- Consolidate findings into concise, data-driven status updates and present recommendations to senior leadership, managing stakeholder expectations and adapting communication to your audience.A day in the lifeImagine we need to decide whether a new fulfillment center in one region versus another best unlocks faster delivery for customers. You bring transportation, fulfillment center operations, and last-mile partners along as you work, and package everything into a clear recommendation for senior leadership. The expectation is a sound, numbers-backed decision in days — set up to refresh quickly and scale — not a perfect answer in a month.About the teamOur Long Term Planning team sits within Amazon's European operations organization and is responsible for tackling the most complex supply chain problems and decisions. jobs.title: Projektingenieur Bau / Industrie- & Anlagenbau (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Bau)
jobs.description: Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte im internationalen Industrie- und Anlagenbau technisch begleiten und aktiv mitgestalten? Dabei stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Terminen, Kosten, Qualität und technischen Anforderungen über den gesamten Bauprozess sicher.Schwerpunkte: Bauingenieurwesen | Industrie- & Anlagenbau | Bauplanung | Projektkoordination | Ausschreibung & Vergabe | Technische Vergabeverhandlungen | Bauausführung | Termin-, Kosten- & Qualitätskontrolle | Bauunternehmen | RIB iTWO | MS Office | Internationale ProjekteIhre Aufgaben- Technische Koordination und Abstimmung innerhalb internationaler Projekte mit Kunden, Ingenieurbüros, Behörden, Bauunternehmen sowie internen Fachbereichen, Projektleitung und Einkauf- Erstellung von Ausschreibungsunterlagen für Bau- und Ingenieurleistungen sowie technische Bewertung eingehender Angebote- Durchführung und Begleitung technischer Vergabeverhandlungen mit externen Partnern bis zum Vertragsabschluss- Koordination sämtlicher Bauplanungsaktivitäten sowie Sicherstellung der Umsetzung von Kundenanforderungen und technischen Vorgaben- Fachliche Leitung und Koordination der beteiligten Bauausführungsunternehmen während der Projektabwicklung- Überwachung und Steuerung des Bauprozesses hinsichtlich Terminen, Kosten und QualitätsstandardsIhre Qualifikationen- Abgeschlossenes Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulstudium im Bauingenieurwesen; Auslandserfahrung durch Studium oder Praktika ist von Vorteil- Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Industrie- und Anlagenbau ist wünschenswert; Bewerbungen mit erster relevanter Berufserfahrung sind ebenfalls willkommen- Gute Fachkenntnisse in den wesentlichen Bereichen des Bauingenieurwesens sowie Erfahrung in der technischen Planung und Koordination von Bauprojekten- Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse in RIB iTWO sind von Vorteil- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse, beispielsweise Französisch, Italienisch oder Spanisch, sind willkommen- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsvermögen, Planungs- und Organisationsgeschick sowie Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Dienstreisen

jobs.title: Anlagenmechaniker SHK / Heizungsbauer (m/w/d) – Fokus Wärmepumpen (Anlagenmechaniker/in - Sanitär-, Heizungs- und Klimatechnik)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:SHK; HeizungsbauerStellenbeschreibung:Wer wir sindWir sind die engelstrom GmbH aus Bad Bergzabern. Mit unserem 20-köpfigen Team bringen wir die Energiewende in die Südpfalz: Wir kombinieren Photovoltaik, Klimaanlagen und Wärmepumpen zu smarten Gesamtlösungen.Da unser Bereich Heizungstechnik rasant wächst (und unser Kollege Eric Unterstützung braucht!), suchen wir dich als SHK-Gesellen (m/w/d), der Bock hat, veraltete Öl- und Gasheizungen rauszuschmeißen und durch moderne Wärmepumpen zu ersetzen.Deine Mission auf der Baustelle- Wärmepumpen-Installation: Du bist unser Mann / unsere Frau für den fachgerechten Aufbau, die Verrohrung und den hydraulischen Anschluss moderner Wärmepumpen-Systeme.- Teamwork: Du arbeitest auf der Baustelle Hand in Hand mit unseren Elektrikern. Du machst die Hydraulik und Verrohrung, die Jungs klemmen den Strom an.- Inbetriebnahme & Wartung: Du richtest die Systeme ein, erklärst dem Kunden die Anlage und übernimmst Servicearbeiten.- Modernes Arbeiten: Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit komplett digital und stressfrei über unsere Firmen-App auf dem Tablet/Smartphone.Das bringst du mit- Ausbildung: Du hast einen Gesellenbrief als Anlagenmechaniker SHK, Heizungsbauer, Gas-Wasser-Installateur (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.- Leidenschaft fürs Handwerk: Du arbeitest sauber, kundenorientiert und hast Lust auf Zukunftstechnologie. Erfahrung mit Wärmepumpen ist super – falls du bisher nur Gas/Öl gemacht hast, arbeiten wir dich aber auch gerne intensiv in die neuen Systeme ein!- Führerschein: Klasse B für die Fahrten zu unseren Kunden.- Teamgeist: Du packst gerne mit an und passt in ein lockeres, aber hochprofessionelles Team.Was wir dir bieten- Regionale Baustellen: Unsere Kunden sitzen in der Südpfalz. Du fährst keine Montage quer durch Deutschland und bist jeden Abend pünktlich zu Hause.- Top-Ausstattung: Du bekommst dein eigenes, top ausgestattetes Firmenfahrzeug, hochwertiges Werkzeug und moderne Arbeitskleidung.- Zukunftssicher: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, faire und pünktliche Bezahlung.- Starkes Team: Flache Hierarchien, offene Türen bei den Chefs (Stefan & Julian) und regelmäßige Team-Events.- Kein Papierkram: Wir arbeiten maximal digital – vom Urlaubsantrag bis zur Projektakte läuft bei uns alles digital.Klingt nach deinem neuen Job?Vergiss das klassische Anschreiben und den dicken Bewerbungsordner. Schreib uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht, ruf an oder schick uns deinen Lebenslauf über den Kanal, der dir am besten passt oder komm auf einen Kaffee vorbei.Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!------Dieser Hinweis ist für Personaldienstleister, Headhunter und Personalvermittler:Wir besetzen alle Stellen bei der engelstrom GmbH ausschließlich eigenständig. Anfragen sind ausdrücklich nicht erwünscht und untersagt. Rechtlicher Hinweis: Unverlangte Kontaktaufnahmen werten wir als unzumutbare Belästigung und wettbewerbswidrige Handlung im Sinne des § 7 UWG (Gesetz gegen den unlauteren Wettbewerb). Bei Zuwiderhandlung behalten wir uns rechtliche Schritte sowie die Erteilung einer kostenpflichtigen Abmahnung ausdrücklich vor.

jobs.title: Lagermitarbeiter / Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik (m/w/d) – Zentrallager (Fachlagerist/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Lagerarbeiter; Kommissionierer; Fachlagerist; Lagerhelfer MöbellogistikStellenbeschreibung:Damit morgens jede Tour startklar istSeit 1934 stehen wir für Qualität, Beratung und Handschlag-Mentalität. Heute führen wir als Familienunternehmen in dritter Generation mit knapp 50 Mitarbeitern zwei starke Marken: Möbel Kerkfeld für hochwertige Einrichtung mit Tradition und Skurios für Trend und Lifestyle.Und wir wachsen: Wir erweitern unsere Ausstellung, gewinnen neue Kunden und bekommen mehr Aufträge. Damit jedes Möbelstück vollständig und unbeschädigt beim Kunden ankommt, braucht es jemanden, der in unserem 2.500 m² großen Zentrallager den Überblick behält. Sie sorgen dafür, dass unsere Monteure und Schreiner morgens alles abholen können, was sie für ihren Tag brauchen.Das sind Sie. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!Das erwartet SieSie sind die Basis für eine reibungslose Auslieferung und sorgen dafür, dass bei uns alles seinen Platz hat:- Sie nehmen Ware entgegen, kontrollieren sie auf Vollständigkeit und Schäden und lagern sie fachgerecht ein- Sie buchen Wareneingänge und Bestände im Warenwirtschaftssystem- Sie geben Ware an Kunden heraus, wenn diese direkt an unserem Zentrallager abholen- Sie kommissionieren die Aufträge für unsere Monteure und Schreiner und stellen sie so bereit, dass morgens jede Tour pünktlich starten kann- Sie halten Ordnung im Lager und auf dem Außengelände und pflegen unsere Lagerflächen- Sie wirken bei Inventuren mit und sorgen für korrekte Bestände- Sie melden Schäden und Abweichungen frühzeitig, damit Reklamationen schnell geklärt werden- Sie arbeiten eng mit unserer Logistikleitung, den Monteuren und dem Innendienst zusammenDas bringen Sie mit- Eine Ausbildung als Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik, Fachlagerist oder vergleichbare Erfahrung im Lager, gern auch als Quereinsteiger- Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Möbeln oder großvolumiger Ware- Eine sorgfältige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und ein Auge fürs Detail- Körperliche Belastbarkeit und Freude an anpackender Arbeit- Sicheren Umgang mit einem Warenwirtschaftssystem oder die Bereitschaft, es zu lernen- Teamgeist und Lust, mit anzupacken, wenn es mal schnell gehen muss- Führerschein Klasse B von VorteilDas bieten wir Ihnen- Sicherheit: Eine Stelle in einem Familienunternehmen mit über 90 Jahren Geschichte und langfristiger Perspektive- Fairness: Ein leistungsgerechtes Gehalt- Kurze Wege: Ein direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und schnelle Entscheidungen statt Bürokratie- Mitarbeiterrabatt: Attraktive Rabatte auf unser Sortiment – für Sie und Ihre Familie- Fahrrad-Leasing: Job-Räder für alle, die lieber auf zwei Rädern unterwegs sindKlingt nach Ihrem nächsten Job?Dann machen Sie den ersten Schritt! Bewerben Sie sich ganz unkompliziert über die unten angegebenen Kontaktdaten. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!Ihr Ansprechpartner: Ralf Tenbeck, Ralf.Tenbeck@moebel-kerkfeld.de (https://mailto:Ralf.Tenbeck@moebel-kerkfeld.de) , 02861 7038820

jobs.description: SAPV-/ Palliative Care Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) Diakonie-Station Steglitz in BerlinWeil wir #pflegeleben!Im Gemeindehaus der Evangelischen Markusgemeinde hat unsere Diakonie-Station Steglitz ihren Sitz – eine der ältesten Sozialstationen Berlins. Wir suchen dich als Verstärkung.Komm ins Team Diakonie!Dein Aufgabengebiet:Du bist bei schwer erkrankten Menschen zu Hause – und bei denen, die sie begleiten. Wir tragen das gemeinsam, auch nachts.Palliative Begleitung kann jeder Mensch brauchen, ganz gleich, wie alt er ist. Unsere Diakonie-Station Steglitz ist für die Pflegekundschaft und ihre An- und Zugehörigen da. jobs.title: Elternbegleiterin (m/w/d) für die Arbeit im Projekt ElternChanceN im Familienzentrum (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description: Der Kinderschutzbund Regionalverband Freiberg e.V. ist ein anerkannter Träger der freien Jugendhilfe mit Sitz in Freiberg. In unseren Einrichtungen sind wir mit verschiedensten Angeboten Partner für Kinder, Jugendliche und deren Erziehungsberechtigte. Dabei ist es für uns grundliegende Aufgabe, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Rechte der Kinder gesellschaftlich wahrgenommen werden. Wir handeln nach den Grundsätzen von Diversität, Weltoffenheit und Vielfalt.  Das Projekt ElternChanceN (https://elternchancen-muenchen.de/projektbeschreibung) in Freiberg wird im Rahmen des ESF Plus-Programms „ElternChanceN – mit Elternbegleitung Familien stärken“ durch das Bundesministerium für Familie, Senioren, Frauen und Jugend und durch die Europäische Union über den Europäischen Sozialfonds Plus (ESF Plus) gefördert. Elternbegleitung unterstützt Familien in besonderen Lebenslagen bei Erziehungsfragen und Bildungsprozessen. Elternbegleitung schafft einen vertrauensvollen Zugang zu Familien, führt niedrigschwellige Begleitungs- und Beratungsangebote durch, bietet Unterstützung bei der Alltagsbewältigung und vermittelt an passende Angebote der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe. Sie hilft Eltern, bestmögliche Bildungsentscheidungen für ihre Kinder zu treffen. Elternbegleitung stärkt eine frühzeitige und individuelle Entwicklungsförderung und trägt damit nachhaltig zu besseren Bildungs- und Teilhabechancen von Kindern bei. Elternbegleitung bezieht die Übergänge von der Familie in die außerhäusliche Betreuung und von der KiTa in die Schule mit ein. Wir suchen Sie ab sofort als Elternbegleiterin (m/w/d) für die Arbeit im Projekt ElternChanceN im Familienzentrum (anerkannte/r Erzieher:in) in Freiberg mit einem Stundenumfang von 19,5h, befristet bis 31.05.2028.   Wir bieten:  - eine gute Zusammenarbeit in einem engagierten Team von Kolleg:innen, die sich fachlich und persönlich einbringen, - ein interessantes, abwechslungsreiches und entwicklungsfähiges Arbeitsfeld, - Möglichkeiten der fachlichen Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Einrichtungen des Trägers und extern, - interne und externe Fortbildungen, - Bezahlung in Anlehnung an den TVÖD,  - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, - Jahreseinmalzahlung und Leistungszulage Sie bringen mit:  - Sie haben einen Abschluss als anerkannte/r Erzieher:in.  - Sie sind eine offene und engagierte Person, die die Fähigkeit besitzt, eigenständig Angebote für Eltern und Familien mit Kindern bis zum Grundschulalter vor Ort zu gestalten. - Sie haben Freude an und Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Eltern und Kindern mit unterschiedlichstem sozialem Hintergrund. - Sie verfügen über sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. - Sie haben Teamgeist, bringen Ihre Kreativität ein und sind ein Organisationstalent. - Sie haben die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Themen methodisch und didaktisch ansprechend umzusetzen. - Sie verfügen über gute Fähigkeiten zu Kooperation und Netzwerkarbeit - Sie sind in der Lage eigenverantwortlich nach den Qualitätsstandards des Trägers zu handeln. - Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in Social Media, Budgetierung und Verwaltung  - Kenntnis der Beratungslandschaft in Freiberg Das erwartet Sie: -  Ansprechen der Zielgruppe der Familien besonderen Lebenslagen mit Kindern von 0 bis zum Ende der Grundschulzeit über - Empfehlungen/Vermittlung durch Netzwerkpartner*innen (Kindergarten, Schule und Hort, Familienzentren/-einrichtungen)  - Social Media, Flyer, Presseartikel,  - Stadtfeste, Dorffeste, Kinderspielplatz - Schaffung und Gestaltung einer Vielfalt von niedrigschwelligen und präventiven Angeboten für Familien zur Stärkung der elterlichen Kompetenz und Förderung einer altersgerechten, gesunden kindlichen Entwicklung  - Umsetzung folgender Aktivitäten  - Elterncafé, Elternabend, Elternsprechstunde - Eltern-Kind-Kurse, Familientage, - Sportangebote für Eltern  - Workshops/ Kurse - Thementage/ Feste - Interkulturelle Angebote - Familienangebote - Weitervermittlung der Eltern an Angebote zur Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Erziehungskompetenzen und weiterer Beratungen - Evaluierung der eigenen Arbeit mit geeigneten Instrumentarien (Sachbericht, Statistik, Verwaltung)  Bei Interesse freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung:  Der Kinderschutzbund RV Freiberg e.V. jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer II, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineer IIStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionBig systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Software Engineer II (Fullstack), you'll take ownership of features across our Supply Chain Engineering systems — from Purchase Orders and Store Transfers to Cross Dock operations and Returns — building the backend services and integrations that keep inventory moving efficiently across our network. You'll design event-driven, Kafka-based workflows that connect our platform to external Warehouse Management Systems, and see your code go straight into production supporting Quick Commerce's growing Non-Food business.Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We own and evolve systems supporting Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns orders, as well as capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and WMS integrations. Our systems operate across multiple markets and integrate with different internal platforms and external WMS, creating interesting challenges around distributed workflows, data consistency, reliability and system integration.Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.- Develop backend services using Golang/Python and frontend applications using React- Design and evolve APIs, event-driven workflows, and Kafka-based integrations — including with internal platforms and external Warehouse Management Systems and logistics platforms- Partner with Product Managers, engineers, and operational stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions- Make technical decisions within your features and contribute to broader architecture and design discussions within the team- Own the complete software lifecycle: design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operation- Investigate production issues and improve system reliability, performance, resilience, and observabilityQualifications- Professional experience building and operating production software, with the ability to independently own features from problem understanding through production delivery- Strong experience with at least one backend programming language — Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with the willingness to work across our backend stack- Experience building modern web applications using React or comparable technologies, integrating them with backend APIs- Solid understanding of software design principles, REST APIs, relational databases, and automated testing, with the ability to reason about technical trade-offs- Experience or good understanding of distributed/event-driven systems and production infrastructure such as Kafka, AWS, Docker/k8s, CI/CD, and observability- A collaborative and proactive engineering mindset, comfortable working across the stack, sharing knowledge, and using modern development practices and AI-assisted tooling responsiblyAdditional InformationEnsuring you and all our Dough. Cheddar. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com (inclusion@deliveryhero.com) .You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the children (age 1-6) entrusted to us in line with our educational approach, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!

jobs.title: KOMUNALNI/A RADNIK/RADNICA U ODVODNJI
jobs.description:
Obavlja poslove na čišćenju i održavanju objekata i postrojenja u sklopu sustava odvodnje, vrši čišćenje slivnika, radi na ispumpavanju septičkih jama, te na odčepljenju javne i kućne kanalizacije. Na temelju članka 28. Društvenog ugovora Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o. za javnu vodoopskrbu i odvodnju /potpuni tekst/ sa sjedištem u Karlovcu, Gažanski trg 8, direktor društva Miroslav Vukovojac, dipl.ing.stroj. raspisuje JAVNI NATJEČAJ za zaposlenje na neodređeno vrijeme u Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o. Komunalni radnik u odvodnji – 2 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti:
  • Završena osnovna škola.
  • Obvezan probni rad. Uz pismenu prijavu na javni natječaj, kandidati su obvezni priložiti (u izvorniku ili neovjerenoj preslici):
  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak ne starije od 30 dana
  • dokaz o radnom stažu i
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti temeljem Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17 i 98/19) dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz čl. 103. citiranog Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja RH: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od šest mjeseci. Na javni natječaj mogu se javiti osobe oba spola. Riječi i pojmovi u ovom natječaju koji imaju rodno značenje odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod bez obzira na to jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu. Javni natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama Društva www.vik-ka.hr i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu na natječaj neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. O rezultatima izbora kandidati će biti pisano obaviješteni u roku od 30 dana od završetka natječaja. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži svu potrebnu dokumentaciju navedenu u natječaju i koja je pristigla na adresu tvrtke zaključno s datumom 31.10.2026. godine. Prijave na natječaj s prilozima dostavljaju se na adresu Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o., Gažanski trg 8, 47 000 Karlovac sa naznakom »Natječaj za komunalnog radnika u odvodnji – ne otvaraj». Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o. Karlovac zadržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku ne navodeći razloge poništenja.
Opis poslova:

Obavlja poslove na čišćenju i održavanju objekata i postrojenja u sklopu sustava odvodnje, vrši čišćenje slivnika, radi na ispumpavanju septičkih jama, te na odčepljenju javne i kućne kanalizacije.

jobs.title: FIZIOTERAPEUT/FIZIOTERAPEUTKINJA
jobs.description:
OptiMove Centar traži fizioterapeuta/fizioterapeutkinju za rad u području rehabilitacije lokomotornog sustava. Poslovi uključuju provođenje individualnih rehabilitacijskih postupaka, planiranje i vođenje terapijskog vježbanja, rad s osobama s akutnim i kroničnim bolnim stanjima, sudjelovanje u postoperativnoj rehabilitaciji, primjenu fizioterapijskih i manualnih postupaka te praćenje funkcionalnog napretka pacijenata. Uvjeti:
  • VŠS/VSS, odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz fizioterapije
  • odgovoran i profesionalan pristup radu
  • komunikativnost, samostalnost i spremnost na timski rad
Prednost pri odabiru:
  • iskustvo rada u rehabilitaciji lokomotornog sustava
  • praktično iskustvo u planiranju i vođenju terapijskog vježbanja
  • poznavanje i iskustvo primjene DNS principa
  • dodatna znanja iz manualnih i miofascijalnih terapijskih postupaka
  • iskustvo u postoperativnoj rehabilitaciji
Nudimo:
  • puno radno vrijeme (rad u smjenama) i slobodne vikende
  • strukturirano uvođenje u rad i upoznavanje s pristupom centra
  • rad u manjem stručnom timu
  • interne stručne sastanke i razmjenu znanja
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja i dodatnog usavršavanja
  • profesionalno i ugodno radno okruženje
Prijava: Zainteresirani kandidati trebaju dostaviti životopis i kratak opis dosadašnjeg radnog iskustva na mail info@optimove-centar.hr ili poslati na adresu De Franceshijeva ulica 62/a, Pula. Odabrani kandidati bit će pozvani na razgovor.

Osim navedenih uvjeta, kandidati/kinje moraju ispunjavati i dodatni uvjet propisan člankom 24. stavkom 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnoga mjesta Odgojitelj/ica). Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osoba za koju postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidati/kinje dužni/e su priložiti: 1) životopis 2) dokaz o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja (diploma, svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava koju je izdala ovlaštena pravna osoba) 3) dokaz o državljanstvu 4) rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije, ako se radi o inozemnoj stručnoj kvalifikaciji 5) dokaz o završenom programu za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi, ako se na natječaj javlja osoba koja ispunjava uvjet pod brojem 1. točka b) Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju te koja je vlastoručno potpisana. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom/kinjom prijavljenim/om na natječaj. Iznimno, u skladu s člankom 26. stavkom 5. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava uvjete iz članka 24. toga Zakona, radni odnos se može zasnovati s osobom koja ne ispunjava propisane uvjete do zasnivanja radnog odnosa na osnovi ponovljenog natječaja. Prijave se podnose neposredno u tajništvo ili poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić Vedri dani, Ulica Milana Makanca 11A, 10 000 Zagreb, uz naznaku: „Za natječaj – ODGOJITELJ  ODREĐENO  ne otvaraj“.
