jobs.title: Deltid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person?
jobs.description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Denne her stilling er deltid - vi forventer at arbejdet til en start er på 20-30 timer ugentligt, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du har egen bil, som du kan burge til at komme rundt imellem ejendommene.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaverDet med småt

Bil: Da stilling er deltid, stiller vi en bil til rådighed, så du skal derfor forvente at du skal have mulighed for at transportere dig selv i egen bil rundt imellem ejendommene.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Horsens, men der er også mulighed for opgaver i de omkringliggende byer.

Vi er fleksible i forhold til opstart, så lad os holde en åben dialog omkring det.

Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

jobs.title: koordinerende planlægger til afdeling for praktisk bistand
jobs.description:
Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger koordinerende planlægger

Vil du have en central rolle i hverdagsdriften i en privat hjemmepleje – og samtidig understøtte den daglige ledelse gennem struktur, overblik og stabil drift?

Hos Carelink Pleje søger vi en koordinerende- og planlægningsansvarlig medarbejder, som kan tage ansvar for den daglige planlægning og koordinering i vores afdeling for praktisk bistand i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens 2 øvrige medarbejder.

Stillingen er en nøglefunktion i organisationen og et vigtigt led i at sikre kvalitet, kontinuitet og trivsel for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Vagtplanlægning og koordinering

  • du skal udarbejde konkrete vagtplaner inden for de rammer og principper, som virksomheden har fastlagt og med udgangspunkt i 3F gældende overenskomst.

  • Håndtere daglige ændringer, herunder sygemeldinger og akutte justeringer. Herunder at man i samarbejde med øvrige nøglepersoner skal modtage sygemeldinger på telefonen.

  • Være første kontaktpunkt for medarbejdere ved ændringer i vagter

  • Sikre overblik over bemanding, kontinuitet og stabil drift

Dag-til-dag disponering

  • Justere ruter og opgaver i løbet af dagen ved sygdom, forsinkelser eller aflysninger

  • Koordinere indsatsen, så borgerne får den rette hjælp på rette tidspunkt

  • Have løbende kontakt med medarbejdere i vagten ved behov for justeringer

  • Være tilgængelig på telefonen og besvare henvendelser fra medarbejdere, visitationen, borgere og deres pårørende.

Ruteplanlægning og systemunderstøttelse

  • Daglig ruteoptimering og justering i planlægningssystemer

  • Opdatere ruter ved ændrede visiteringer

  • Arbejde aktivt i Cleanmanager og Cura , sikre korrekt anvendelse af systemerne i planlægningen

Understøttelse af den daglige ledelse

  • Understøtte afdelingslederen i den daglige ledelse gennem:

  • Overblik over drift, bemanding og udfordringer

  • Tidlig opsamling på mønstre (fx gentagne sygemeldinger, pres på ruter, ustabilitet)

  • Bidrage med input til forbedring af arbejdsgange, planlægning og kontinuitet

  • Være en stabil og tydelig samarbejdspartner for både ledelse og medarbejdere i hverdagen

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra hjemmepleje, planlægning eller koordination

  • Er uddannet SSA , sygeplejerske eller terapeut

  • Har praktisk erfaring med Cura.

  • Trives med struktur, overblik og mange samtidige opgaver

  • Er tydelig, rolig og respektfuld i din kommunikation – også når hverdagen er presset

  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem drift, faglighed og medarbejdertrivsel og er indstillet på at arbejde under helhedspleje konceptet.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer og i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen

  • Villig til at varetage opgaver i perioder, som ligger udenfor jobfunktionsbeskrivelsen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En tydeligt afgrænset rolle med ansvar og mandat

  • Tæt og dagligt samarbejde med en øvrige administrativ personale

  • Mulighed for uddannelse, kursus og udvikling

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet og ordentlighed

  • Mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på struktur og hverdagsdrift

  • Stillingen er på 30-37 timer.

jobs.title: Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet
jobs.description:
Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet

Har du hjertet på rette sted, lyst til at være sammen med børn og mod på at blive en del af et lille børnehus med masser af historie og personlighed? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Bag den grønne port i Helsingørs gågade ligger vores lille private børnehave med 27 børn og fem medarbejdere, herunder vores leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med mere end 190 års historie, en hyggelig legeplads, bålfad og vildtvoksende gemmesteder. Her er der plads til leg, fantasi, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi elsker at være ude i al slags vejr.

Hos os er det nære børneliv i fokus. Vi vægter relationer, leg og nærvær højt.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld timelønnet medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en fast del af vores hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med børn og lyst til at arbejde pædagogisk.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

·        er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe relationer til børn

·        deltager aktivt i børnenes leg og hverdag

·        møder børn med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiver

·        kan tage initiativ og indgå i husets rammer og rutiner

·        er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

·        kan træde til med kort varsel og tage både åbne- og lukkevagter

Hos os får du

·        en arbejdsplads med historie, charme og personlighed

·        27 skønne børn og en hverdag fyldt med leg og oplevelser

·        engagerede kollegaer, der vægter samarbejde og faglighed

·        mulighed for at få erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde

·        mulighed for at blive en tryg og genkendelig voksen i børnenes hverdag

Praktisk information

Vi søger en timelønnet medarbejder. Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel og har mulighed for at træde til med kort varsel ved sygdom og andre akut opståede situationer. Ved i forvejen planlagt fravær blandt personalet, vil arbejdstiderne være fastlagt på forhånd, så du i god tid ved hvornår du skal arbejde.

Du skal kunne arbejde inden for hele børnehavens åbningstid og varetage både åbne- og lukkevagter.

Åbningstider: mandag–torsdag kl. 6.30–17.00 og fredag kl. 6.30–16.15.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst og aftaler. Der indhentes børneattest inden ansættelse.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Børneasylet?

Send os en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med børn, og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig at arbejde hos os. Vi holder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Helsingør Børneasyl  |  Telefon: 26 21 21 70  |  Mail: leder@hbasylet.dk

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik, Västerskog daghem
jobs.description: Ligger småbarnspedagogik dig varmt om hjärtat?Vill du vara med och utveckla pedagogiken i en varmhjärtad och omtänksam kommun?Om svaret är ja, är detta ditt drömjobb!Vi söker nu till vårt team en LÄRARE INOM SMÅBARNSPEDAGOGIK för en visstids anställning för tiden 7.1.2026- 31.7.2027. Arbetsplatsen är Västerskogs daghem och arbetet inleds enligt överenskommelse från och med 7.1.2026. Vill du arbeta i en varm, kreativ och flerspråkig miljö där leken står i centrum? Västerskog daghem söker nu en engagerad lärare inom småbarnspedagogik som vill bli en del av vårt professionella och dedikerade team. Vårt daghem ligger nära naturen, och våra lokaler är trivsamma och funktionella. Gården inbjuder till mångsidig lek och aktivitet. Våra värderingar är- närvaro- arbetsglädje- barncentrerad pedagogik- en varm famnHär får både barn och vuxna vara sig själva — och växa tillsammans.Vi söker dig som:- är entusiastisk, flexibel och positiv- är genuint närvarande i barnens vardag- möter barnen med värme och sensitivitet, både som individer och som gruppmedlemmar- har goda samarbetsfärdigheter och en lösningsfokuserad arbetsstil- vill utveckla småbarnspedagogiken med hjälp av lekpedagogikVi lägger stor vikt vid att du trivs i ett team och tycker om att arbeta i en miljö där humor, gemenskap och öppen kommunikation är en naturlig del av vardagen.Leken är en central del av vår pedagogik. Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik deltar du aktivt i leken och finns nära barnen i deras utforskande och lärande. Du ansvarar för den pedagogiska verksamheten i din grupp enligt planen för småbarnspedagogik- enhetens verksamhetsplan- barnets individuella plan (vasu)Du planerar, genomför, dokumenterar och utvärderar verksamheten tillsammans med ditt team och barnen. Du får en god introduktion och kontinuerligt stöd av kollegor, daghemsföreståndaren och vår speciallärare inom småbarnspedagogik.Vi erbjuder ett engagerat och stöttande arbetslag och en varm och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samt dagligt samarbete och kollegialt lärande. Med oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka pedagogiken genom lek.  Varför skulle du välja just Sibbo?I småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo är utvecklingsarbetet smidigt, långsiktigt och övergripande. I det betonas en verksamhetskultur som uppmuntrar till lek och rörelse. Närheten till naturen och tvåspråkigheten är våra styrkor. Vi satsar på kunnandet samt på ett arbetssätt som beaktar barnets bästa.Vi erbjuder dig:- en varmhjärtad, kunnig arbetsgemenskap och en omtänksam chef - starkt stöd av din chef, ditt team och speciallärarna- en arbetsgivare som bryr sig om just din välfärd- många möjligheter att utbilda dig och utveckla din yrkeskunskap- mångsidiga digitala verktyg, utlåning av idrottsredskap - idrotts-, kultur- och välfärdsförmån (epassi) Välkommen till vårt varmhjärtade och innovativa team som förverkligar småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo med stort hjärta! Behörighetskravet för uppgiften är minst behörighet i enlighet med i lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018), dock så att ikraftträdandet av 74 § och 75 § samt övergångsbestämmelserna tas i beaktande. Läraren inom småbarnspedagogik som väljs ska ha utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga färdigheter i svenska. Lönen och villkoren för anställningsförhållandet bestäms enligt UKTA Undervisningspersonalen inom småbarnspedagogiken (Del G).I arbetsförhållandet tillämpas en prövotid. Den uppgiftsrelaterade nivålönen är 3111,76 euro/månad + eventuella tillägg. Den som väljs ska visa upp ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002) samt ett godtagbart intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd. Enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar ska den som arbetar med barn under skolåldern utreda risken för tuberkulossmitta. Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi ser fram emot att få en ny kollega som tillsammans med oss vill skapa en trygg, lärorik och glädjefylld vardag för barnen. Ansökningarna ska lämnas in senast 3.11.2026 kl. 16. Studie- och arbetsintyg i original ska visas upp vid en eventuell intervju.

jobs.title: Welders, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
jobs.description: We are looking for welders for the Meyer Turku Shipyard. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. jobs.title: ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B) / ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)
jobs.description:
ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS oplever fortsat vækst, og vi udvider nu vores team. Vi søger to engagerede, ansvarsfulde og stabile profiler til vores transport- og logistikdrift: En struktureret koordinator (med aktiv kørsel) og en professionel chauffør. Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag i en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet og højt serviceniveau er i højsædet. Læs mere om de to stillinger nedenfor og angiv i din ansøgning, hvilken rolle du søger.

PROFIL 1: Teamkoordinator & Chauffør (Hybridstilling)

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

  • Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

  • Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

  • Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

  • Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

  • Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

  • Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

  • Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

  • Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

  • Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

  • Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

  • Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

  • En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

  • Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne, så snart de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte os via ovenstående e-mail, hvorefter vi vil vende tilbage til dig.

 

ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS continues to grow, and we are now expanding our team. We are seeking two dedicated, responsible, and reliable profiles for our transport and logistics operations: A structured coordinator (with active driving) and a professional driver. Both positions require a standard driver's license (Category B), as well as proficiency in Turkish and English.

We offer a dynamic everyday work environment in a developing company where quality and high service levels are paramount. Read more about the two positions below and please specify in your application which role you are applying for.

PROFILE 1: Team Coordinator & Driver (Hybrid Position)

As our new coordinator, you will be the core of our daily operations. You will be responsible for planning the work schedule for our drivers, but you will also be an active part of the fleet and step behind the wheel yourself.

Your primary tasks:

  • Planning and coordination: Daily route planning and task management for the company's employed drivers.

  • Quality assurance in the field: Periodically driving with the drivers to evaluate, guide, and ensure our high-quality standards.

  • Active driving: Even though you have administrative tasks, you will also act as an active driver (License B) on a daily basis and during busy periods.

  • Administrative tasks: Handling ad-hoc administrative tasks related to operations.

  • Sparring and support: Acting as the primary contact person, guide, and motivator for the driver team.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You must be able to communicate fluently in Turkish and English (both written and spoken) for our internal coordination and business partners.

  • Experience in logistics, coordination, or team leadership (experience in the transport industry is a major advantage).

  • Structured, solution-oriented, and able to maintain an overview in high-pressure situations.

  • Valid driver's license (B) and experience as an active, experienced driver.

PROFILE 2: Driver (Driver's License B)

We are looking for a reliable and service-minded driver who will be the face of the company to our customers. You will become an important part of our daily delivery team.

Your primary tasks:

  • Transport and delivery: Safe and efficient execution of planned routes in the company's vehicles (Category B).

  • Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

  • Quality-conscious work: Making sure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy, and that applicable regulations for transport are followed.

  • Collaboration: Close dialogue with the coordinator and the rest of the team to optimize the daily workflow.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

  • Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

  • Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

  • Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

  • A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

  • A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

  • Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

Starting date: By agreement.

Sunshine Thaimassage welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of nationality or background.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Vuoropäällikkö Helsingin sydämeen – Kellotorni etsii tiiminvetäjää!
jobs.description: Etsimme vuoropäällikköä vastaamaan upeiden ja uniikkien tilojemme tilaisuuksien operatiivisesta onnistumisesta Helsingin päärautatieasemalla. Kellotornissa järjestämme monipuolisia B2B- ja B2C-tapahtumia aina 10 hengen intiimeistä kokouksista 160 hengen istuviin illallisiin ja jopa 300 hengen suuriin cocktail-tilaisuuksiin.Tässä roolissa olet ravintola-alan rautainen ammattilainen, joka johtaa esimerkillään ja varmistaa, että jokainen tilaisuus on asiakkaallemme ikimuistoinen elämys.**Tehtäväsi ja vastuualueesi**Vuoropäällikkönä vastaat tilaisuuksien sujuvasta kulusta ja asiakaskokemuksesta paikan päällä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tapahtumapäällikön kanssa, joka vastaa tilaisuuden ennakkosuunnittelusta:· **Vetovastuu tilaisuuksissa:** Vastaat tapahtuman operatiivisesta läpiviennistä ja kykenet hahmottamaan tilaisuuden kokonaisuuden alusta loppuun saakka.· **Isojen tilaisuuksien rinnalla työ on myös erittäin itsenäistä:** vastaat yksin pienryhmien kokouspäivistä aina tilojen esittelystä ja opastuksesta tarjoilujen hoitamiseen.· **Esihenkilötyö ja serviisi:** Toimit vuorosi aikana esihenkilönä tarjoilijoille ja muulle salihenkilökunnalle. Johdat tiimiä salissa ja olet itsekin aktiivisesti mukana serviisissä ja asiakaspalvelussa.· **Asiakkaan kohtaaminen:** Varmistat omalla panoksellasi, että asiakaspalvelu on ensiluokkaista ja asiakkaat otetaan lämpimästi vastaan Kellotornin arvokkaissa puitteissa.· **Perehdytyksen jälkeen:** haluat myös itse päästä jakamaan Kellotornin ainutlaatuista tarinaa ja elämyksiä asiakkaillemme! Esittelet historiallisia tilojamme ja menukokonaisuuksiamme sekä tarvittaessa johdatat pienryhmiä tornin huipulle ihailemaan Helsingin upeita maisemia ja kuulemaan kiehtovia tarinoita Kellotornin historiasta. Sinulle elämyksellisyys ei ole vain sana, vaan tapa kohdata asiakkaat ja tehdä jokaisesta vierailusta ikimuistoinen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**· **Vankkaa tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan osaamista:** Sinulla on jo kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, ja erinomainen asiakaspalvelutaito on sinulle itsestäänselvyys.· **Kyvykkyyttä johtaa tiimiä:** Osaat ohjata, motivoida ja tukea tarjoilijoita kiireenkin keskellä, pitäen ilmapiirin innostavana.· **Vahvaa ruoan ja juoman tuntemusta:** Hallitset laadukkaan salityöskentelyn ja tarjoilun vaatimukset erilaisissa tilaisuuksissa kokouksista gaalaillallisiin.· **Joustavuutta työajoissa:** Kellotorni elää tapahtumien mukaan. Työvuorot sijoittuvat maanantain ja lauantain välille klo 06.30–03.00 välisenä aikana.· Koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea ratkaisevat aito osaamisesi, asenteesi ja näyttösi alalta.**Tarjoamme sinulle:**· Upean ja täysin uniikin työympäristön historiallisessa maamerkissä.· Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa esihenkilöosaamistasi monipuolisten tapahtumien parissa.· Vastuullisen työnkuvan, jossa pääset työskentelemään ravintola- ja tapahtuma-alan huipulla.· Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen Kellotornin kanssa.· Palkkaus: MaRan TESin mukaan aiempi kokemus huomioiden, 2500-2800 €/kk + TES-mukaiset lisät_._· Etuna tarjotaan vuoden työaikapankki.Rekrytoinnista vastaa Job To Do Oy. Sopimus solmitaan suoraan Kellotornin kanssa.**Kellotorni** on Helsingin päärautatieaseman historiallinen maamerkki, jonka uniikit ja arvokkaat tilat tarjoavat upeat puitteet niin liike-elämän kohtaamisille kuin elämän suurille juhlille. Toimintamme keskiössä ovat korkealaatuiset ravintola-, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut. Luomme asiakkaillemme räätälöityjä elämyksiä arjen yläpuolella – kirjaimellisesti Helsingin sydämessä.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. Tavoitteena on muuttaa henkilöstöpalvelutoimialaa inhimillisemmäksi ja innostavammaksi. Arvojamme ovat joustavuus, ammattitaito, kumppanuus ja turvallisuus. Välitämme ihmisiä, joista välitämme.

jobs.title: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksBattery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: PhD in Quantum Computing for Power Systems
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from December 1, 2026, or as soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksThis PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. The position requires both independent research and collaboration with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds, as well as good written and spoken English.

Sopimus solmitaan suoraan Kellotornin kanssa.**Kellotorni** on Helsingin päärautatieaseman historiallinen maamerkki, jonka uniikit ja arvokkaat tilat tarjoavat upeat puitteet niin liike-elämän kohtaamisille kuin elämän suurille juhlille. Toimintamme keskiössä ovat korkealaatuiset ravintola-, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut. Luomme asiakkaillemme räätälöityjä elämyksiä arjen yläpuolella – kirjaimellisesti Helsingin sydämessä.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. jobs.title: Personal Trainers Wanted Across Norway
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring Personal Trainers at Multiple SATS Clubs Across Norway!

SATS is taking the personal training profession to the next level! We are proud to offer newly hired Personal Trainers greater security and closer support than ever before. We are now looking for passionate individuals who are driven to improve the health and well-being of people across Norway, backed by the best support system in the industry.

SATS operates fitness clubs in several of Norway’s largest cities, and we are currently recruiting Personal Trainers for multiple locations in Greater Oslo, Bærum, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand, Drammen, Porsgrunn, Sarpsborg, Skien, Stavanger, and Tromsø.

Please indicate in your application which location or region you would prefer to work in.

Are you passionate about inspiring others to live healthier lives and helping members achieve their goals? Would you like to work in a professional, energetic environment alongside knowledgeable and inspiring colleagues, while developing both personally and professionally? Then we would love to hear from you!

💙 How You Can Make a Difference

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will play an important role in the lives of our members. For many, working with a Personal Trainer is the key to achieving lasting results, whether that means improving their lifestyle, reaching specific fitness goals, or building sustainable training habits.

You will work closely with members from the very first meeting, conducting thorough needs assessments and using your expertise to create realistic, motivating, and individualized training and nutrition plans that help them achieve their goals.

You are a positive motivator, a proactive team player, and someone who contributes beyond your own responsibilities. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure that the club delivers an exceptional experience in every area while continuously developing and improving.

🤩 Does This Sound Like You?

  • You have at least one year of Personal Trainer education (equivalent to 60 ECTS credits or similar). PT certifications that do not award academic credits but are equivalent in scope to a one-year program are also accepted. (Please upload documentation of completed and/or ongoing studies as part of your application.)

  • Alternatively, you have other education relevant to the PT profession, such as a bachelor’s degree in sports science, physiotherapy, psychology, coaching, or a related field. (All candidates, regardless of educational background, must complete a thorough interview process, including a practical audition.)

  • You have strong work capacity and see yourself delivering approximately 80 to 100 hours per month as an established Personal Trainer.

  • You are passionate about creating unique training experiences based on concrete and individual goals.

  • You enjoy sales and take responsibility for developing and growing your own client portfolio.

  • You are confident and skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships.

  • You are positive, inclusive, and approachable.

  • You work independently and take initiative.

  • You are committed to following procedures and respecting rules and guidelines.

🤝 Why Join the SATS Team?

  • SATS offers an introductory salary during your start-up period.

  • Close mentoring and support from experienced leaders and PT Managers.

  • You will become part of a competent and professional team that supports and motivates one another to succeed.

  • Access to a large membership base, providing unique opportunities to build your client portfolio.

  • The chance to work with an exciting and continuously evolving product.

  • Excellent development opportunities through our internal education platform, SATS Academy.

  • Guaranteed minimum income protection following maternity/paternity leave and/or periods of illness.

  • Free training at all SATS clubs across the Nordic region.

  • Employee benefits and discounts through our partner network.

  • As a new PT at SATS, you will participate in our introductory program, PT Trial Session. Personal Trainers help members get started with exercise and establish healthy training habits. Working with PT Trial Sessions is the perfect gateway to becoming a full-time PT. It allows you to gain valuable experience in PT sales, build relationships with potential clients, and develop your business while receiving an introductory salary.

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will contribute to work that truly matters. You help people improve their quality of life, achieve important goals, and sometimes even realize long-held dreams. That is why we believe a career at SATS offers a more meaningful and rewarding workday than many others.

#SATSNorge#LI-AB1

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SATS Group, through our brands and concepts SATS, ELIXIA and Fresh Fitness, is the leading provider of fitness and training services in the Nordics with over 275 clubs, some 10 000 employees and around 700,000 members. At SATS, everyone is welcome and our members have full flexibility to tailor packages for their individual needs. We offer cutting-edge studio facilities for individual training, the broadest offering of group training programs, and highly qualified personal trainers for specialized training and individual coaching. We also focus strongly on supporting our members with online training and digital tools when they are unable to visit our club facilities. We are constantly working with trend research and innovation to be the industry’s best and most forward-looking fitness chain.

jobs.title: Senior Logistics Engineer
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.

Lastly we are entering the space of becoming a logistics systems provider to serve other online grocery players meaning we are commercializing our hardware blueprint, our proprietary smart software and our ways of working into Oda systems - our new brand and business area!

We’re looking for a Senior Logistics Engineer to join Oda!

As our new Senior Logistics Engineer, you will take ownership of core physical process flows, optimize layout solutions, and lead physical installation projects from concept to commissioning. You will play a vital role in ensuring that our technical and physical solutions optimize unit economics, maximize throughput, and eliminate waste across our operations.

What you’ll be doing

  • Process Ownership & Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve physical process flows, layout solutions, process dependencies, and supporting systems to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Lead Installation Projects: Drive and manage physical installation projects for equipment, hardware, and infrastructure from initial concept through to commissioning.

  • Cost Control & Insights: Analyze cost drivers within the process flow and ensure all technical and physical solutions directly optimize unit economics and bottom-line results.

  • Lean Application: Apply Lean manufacturing principles to eliminate waste, enhance safety, and foster a continuous improvement culture.

  • Operational Collaboration: Work closely with on-site operational teams to ensure drawings and technical designs function seamlessly in daily operations and execute smooth handovers.

  • Flexibility: Step up and contribute to responsibilities beyond the core job description when the team or business needs it.

To thrive in this role,

You are analytical and strategic with a sharp eye for cost drivers and unit economics. You excel at switching abstraction levels effortlessly, combining a precise attention to detail with the strategic bird’s-eye view. As a highly structured project manager, you have the drive to push process improvements and complex physical implementations forward.

You are communicative and highly collaborative, capable of building strong bridges between on-site operations, software developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers. Above all, you are self-driven, confident in taking full ownership of entire processes, and act in alignment with our shared behaviors and values.

What you’ll need to succeed

Education: Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or an equivalent relevant field.

Operational Experience: 5–10 years of hands-on experience within Lean manufacturing, industrial production, or logistics environments.

Project Management: Proven track record of successfully leading complex, physical installation projects from concept to completion (delivered on time and within budget).

Technical Competence: A solid understanding of modern software development methodologies.

Business Acumen: Strong financial and operational understanding of cost drivers and how process design impacts the bottom line.

Language: Fluent in spoken and written English.

What would be nice to have

  • Experience scaling logistics or fulfillment center infrastructure in rapid-growth environments.

  • You value innovation and enjoy working in an AI-integrated environment where we constantly iterate on what’s possible.

What we offer

  • A chance to make a real impact in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by amazing chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.

Practical Information

  • Application deadline: 08.11.26

  • Percentage: 100%

  • Location: Tøyen, Oslo OR Larsboda, Sverige

  • Background check: required prior to hire

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Vuokra-/kiinteistönvälittäjä Rovaniemi
jobs.description: Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä suoritettua LVV- tai LKV-tutkintoa. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt työskentelemään asiakkaiden kanssa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi. Koska saat pitkälti suunnitella omien työpäiviesi aikataulun, toivomme, että pystyt myös itse tarpeen tullen joustamaan. Työ on lähtökohtaisesti osa-aikaista, mutta mahdollisuus myös kokoaikaiseen työhön. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen.Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.Hakuaika on 19.10.-1.11.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Tehtävän aloitusajankohta sopimuksen mukaan. Työhön valitulta tarkistetaan luottotiedot.Lähetä CV ja työhakemuksesi viimeistään 1.11.2026 osoitteeseen karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi otsikolla Välittäjän rekry/Rovaniemi.Kysy tehtävästä lisää: Karoliina Peltola, Tiimipäällikkö, Asuntopehtoori karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi p. 044 768 0122

jobs.title: Deltidsmedarbeider hos Hertz Stavanger – 30–50 %
jobs.description:
Hertz Bilutleie ved Auto Finans AS søker en serviceinnstilt deltids medarbeider til vår avdeling på Stavanger lufthavn.

Stillingsprosenten avtales med riktig kandidat. Vi ser for oss en stilling på omtrent 30--50 %. Arbeidstid vil omfatte kveld og helg, noe som kan passe godt ved siden av studier.

Stillingen passer for deg som liker kundekontakt og logistikk, har god oversikt og trives i en travel arbeidshverdag.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Besvare og følge opp kundehenvendelser i skranke, på e-post og telefon

  • Veilede kunder og presentere Hertz' produkter og tjenester

  • Planlegge og koordinere bilflåte ut fra reservasjonene

  • Kontrollere og følge opp leiekontrakter

  • Utføre rapportering og andre daglige kontoroppgaver

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B, innehatt i minst ett år

  • Gode norskkunnskaper og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du trives med kundekontakt og høyt tempo

  • Du er fleksibel og tar ansvar for oppgavene dine

Personlige egenskaper

  • Serviceinnstilt og imøtekommende

  • Strukturert og god til å holde oversikt

  • Positiv og løsningsorientert

  • Samarbeidsvillig

Tiltredelse etter avtale. Søknad og CV sendes til [roy@autofinans.no] (snarest mulig).

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med på laget bak gode reiseopplevelser

Når noen skal på ferie, på jobb eller trenger en bil for å komme seg videre, er Hertz der. Siden oppstarten i Chicago i 1918 har Hertz vokst til å bli verdens eldste bilutleieselskap, med over 10 000 lokasjoner i mer enn 150 land og over 33 millioner bilutleier hvert år.

Hertz åpnet sin første lokasjon i Norge i 1968. I dag er Hertz Norge markedsledende, med over 500 utleiepunkter over hele landet, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Nettverket omfatter rundt 170 corporate-utleiepunkter og cirka 250 lisenstakere.

Auto Finans AS representerer Hertz i Stavanger, Sola, Egersund, Haugesund, på Karmøy og Stord. Med mer enn 50 års erfaring innen bilutleie kjenner vi bransjen godt. Målet vårt er alltid å drive Norges beste Hertz-stasjoner. Med ekstra god kundeservice sørger vi for at både mennesker og biler kommer dit de skal.

Hos oss blir du en del av et lokalt lag med en sterk merkevare i ryggen -- og får en viktig rolle i kundenes reise.

jobs.title: Waiter-Cleaner, Christmas Season, Arctic Snowhotel & Glass Igloos, Rovaniemi, Lapland
jobs.description: Are you the WAITER-CLEANER we are looking for?Snowhotel Family is a family-owned business in Lehtojärvi, Rovaniemi, offering unique experiences in snow and ice. Arctic Snow Hotel & Glass Igloos with its restaurants guarantee a memorable overnight experience by the shores of Lehtojärvi, surrounded by the Northern Lights and nature. Located in Santa Claus Village, Snowman World invites the whole family to winter fun at a snowy playground made of snow and ice. In Santa Claus Village also locates charming gingerbread houses of Piparina and a cozy restaurant where customers can savor authentic Lapland flavors and relax in private gingerbread cottages throughout the day.We are now seeking waiter-housekeepers for the busy Christmas Season of 2026–2027 at the Arctic Snow Hotel in Lehtojärvi. Lehtojärvi is located about 25 kilometers from the center of Rovaniemi. The area has five restaurants; at the Ice Restaurant and Ice Bar, drinks are served in dishes made of ice in a stunning environment, not forgetting local delicacies. Breakfast and dinner are served in the Snow Castle, which is the main building. The Hut Restaurant features a flickering fire at its center, where salmon is grilled with delicious side dishes, as well as offering à la carte dishes. In the Sky Bar, guests can sip various drinks while comfortably watching the Northern Lights through the ceiling windows on the upper floor.As a waiter, your responsibilities will include both plated and buffet service, bar service, recommending food and drinks, and ensuring customer satisfaction with your valuable contributions. The waiter position also includes cleaning tasks in the hotel area. In the housekeeping roles, you will work as part of a cleaning team, ensuring attractive and clean accommodation units and public areas.Full-time work (112.5 hours/3 weeks) is available from the end of November until 6.1.2027. jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the Japan/APAC region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with Japan leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local Japan markets and customers while providing support for other APAC priorities as needed.

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for Japan/APAC sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization

 - Act as a partner to the Japan/APAC sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the Japan/APAC sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

 - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length

 - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
jobs.description: **AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.Työhön kuuluu mm.- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot - jarrujen huolto ja korjaus - alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset - katsastuskorjaukset - moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot - jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot - vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka - rengastyöt - ilmastointihuollot - muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.Odotamme sinulta- B-luokan ajokorttia - vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta - oma-aloitteista työotetta - kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä - kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen - halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa - kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa **Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**Tarjoamme- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle - työajan **37,5 h/vko** - ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00** - 6 kuukauden koeajan - pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön - mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa - palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi** Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSEPuhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä? 2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti? 3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti? 4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä? 5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista? 6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti? 7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi? 8. Milloin voisit aloittaa? 9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä? **Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com****Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

Hvis du er teknisk stærk, kreativ og udadvendt — og samtidig trives i et tempofyldt og foranderligt miljø — så har vi måske det perfekte job til dig.

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Om stillingen:

Du underviser ét eller to hold medarbejdere face‑to‑face på arbejdspladsen i Ballerup. Undervisningen ligger 1–2 gange om ugen og består af 2–3 lektioner pr. mødegang (á 50 minutter). Dage og tidspunkter aftales i samarbejde med deltagerne.

• har erfaring med undervisning af voksne• har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund• er født eller opvokset i et tysktalende land• kan undervise i tysk sprog og kultur • er fleksibel og god til at tilpasse undervisningen efter deltagernes behov• har evnen til at motivere og engagere kursisterne• kan starte snart eller efter aftalen• har stærke kommunikationsevner og en professionel attitude

Vi tilbyder: 

• en spændende og meningsfuld stilling med engagerede kursister• samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer og en støttende ledelse• mulighed for flere undervisningsopgaver, både fysisk og online• fleksibel arbejdstid i samarbejde med kursisterne• konkurrencedygtig løn

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og fjerner opslaget, når den rette underviser er fundet. Send din ansøgning og CV til info@sprog-kursus.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig snart!Lidt om os:

Vi er et privat sprogfirma, etableret i 2003, som har specialiseret sig i at tilbyde sprogkurser til virksomheder, kommuner, foreninger og private. Med vores 14 forskellige sprogkurser tilbyder vi både face2face og online undervisning, enten som enelektioner eller lukkede firmahold. Alle vores sprogkurser skræddersys i tæt samarbejde mellem kursister og undervisere, så vi kan sikre, at undervisningen altid er af høj kvalitet og fleksibilitet, der passer til den enkelte kursistens behov.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer
