jobs.title: Cruise Consultant til MyCruise
jobs.description:
Brænder du for salg, rejser og gode kundeoplevelser?

Vil du rådgive kunder om nogle af verdens mest spændende rejser og samtidig være en del af en virksomhed i vækst?

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Cruise Consultant til vores salgsteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse.

Som Cruise Consultant får du ansvaret for at rådgive vores kunder og sammensætte den helt rigtige krydstogtrejse. Det handler ikke bare om at finde en kahyt og en afrejsedato, men også om alt det uden om, som fly, hotel, udflugter og meget mere. Du skal forstå kundens ønsker, inspirere, rådgive og skabe en rejse, der passer til den enkelte kunde.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst salgsteam, hvor vi arbejder professionelt med salg, konvertering og kundeoplevelse, men hvor der samtidig er plads til personlighed, godt humør og forskellige måder at være en dygtig sælger på.

Om jobbet

Dine kunder kontakter os, fordi de allerede drømmer om at komme ud at rejse. Din opgave er at omsætte drømmen til den rigtige rejse.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

• Rådgive kunder om krydstogter, destinationer, rederier og rejsemuligheder

• Sælge og sammensætte individuelle krydstogtsrejser

• Afdække kundens behov og finde den løsning, der passer bedst

• Følge op på tilbud og kundehenvendelser

• Arbejde aktivt med mersalg og muligheder for at gøre kundens samlede rejse endnu bedre

• Opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder

• Arbejde med nogle af verdens største og mest spændende krydstogtsrederier

• Holde dig opdateret på produkter, destinationer og nye muligheder i markedet

Du får naturligvis en grundig introduktion til vores produkter, systemer og rederier.

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide at sælge og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater sammen med kunden.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har erfaring med salg, rådgivning eller kundekontakt

• Er god til at lytte og hurtigt kan forstå kundens ønsker og behov

• Har et naturligt kommercielt mindset og trives med mål og resultater

• Er serviceminded og forstår, at den gode kundeoplevelse og det gode salg går hånd i hånd

• Har energi, drive og lyst til at tage ansvar for dine egne kunder

• Trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige kundehenvendelser

• Er struktureret og følger dine tilbud og kunder helt til dørs

• Er fortrolig med IT og har nemt ved at lære nye systemer

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen eller kendskab til krydstogter, er det naturligvis en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Resten kan vi lære dig.

Hvem er MyCruise?

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse.

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises samt River cruises.

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder salg tæt sammen med blandt andet Concierge &  Product Marketing

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi også efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En spændende salgsrolle i en branche, hvor produktet virkelig kan begejstre

• Grundig oplæring i krydstogter, rederier, destinationer og vores systemer

• Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

• Studieture og mulighed for selv at opleve nogle af de produkter, vi sælger

• Personalepriser på rejser

• Pension og sundhedsordning

• Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand

• Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

• En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selv at gøre en forskel

• Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S tog

Lyder det som dig?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og med arbejdssted på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly:Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products:Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

â Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

Weâre excited to hear from you! â¤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

jobs.title: Renovasjonssjåfør
jobs.description:
NordRen AS department Asker

We are looking for:

• Motivated individuals who are solution-oriented, have experience driving a truck and enjoy being physically active while working. You must enjoy working outdoors, regardless of weather conditions.

• Hold a valid Class C driving licence and a valid Driver CPC/CAP (Code 95). Be ready to operate our truck with precision and responsibility.

• Is in good physical shape and can work efficiently. We value a structured approach to work and the ability to handle tasks in an organized manner.

• We believe in service with a smile! We are looking for candidates with a positive attitude who value customer service and are ready to represent NordRen AS in a professional way.

• Can take initiative, work independently, and are proactive in handling various tasks.

• Good language skills in English. You must be able to participate in an online interview in English.

• Digital skills – Comfortable using maps on a tablet in the trucks.

Work tasks:

• Collection and transport of household waste on established routes. With maps on pad in the trucks.

• Responsibility for the truck, including weekly washing and weekly/daily maintenance according to routines.

• Monitoring of waste sorting and discrepancy recording.

• Communicating with and guiding customers when necessary.

• Other tasks typically associated with the waste collection profession.

We offer:

• Environmentally conscious: NordRen AS is committed to contributing to a sustainable future. As one of Norway's leading companies in waste management, we are proud of our environmental focus and our commitment to waste sorting.

• Secure workplace: Join a company that has experienced steady growth since its establishment in 2013. NordRen AS offers you the opportunity to help shape the future of waste management.

• Performing a socially beneficial and socially critical service.

• Gain valuable experience in handling challenging situations in traffic.

• Varied workday.

• 7.5-hour workday during daytime (06:00-13:30) Rotational work or shift work is not possible.

• Secure job with Class C License.

• Annual salary from NOK 516 750- 528 450, - (€ 48 249 – 49 342) depending on experience.

• NordRen covers further education (35 hours) related to CPC.

• NordRen can help with accommodation for a period 3-6 months. (Considering the location and working hours, having your own car is an advantage.)

• NordRen covers Norwegian language courses (A2) after 3 months of employment.

How to apply:

Send CV and application letter to: rekruttering@nordren.no.

Please mark the application with Department Asker

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In NordRen departement Asker, we have 23 trucks. Some are small Volvo and Iveco single-operator trucks, while the larger ones are Scania three-axle trucks with two-person crews. The trucks have two compartments: One for paper and one for plastic, one for food and one for residual waste.

Each two-person crew handles between 300 and 350 stops per day, meaning they empty around 600–700 bins daily. All bins are equipped with RFID chips, which are scanned by antennas on the lifting mechanism during collection. This records the chip number, time of collection, and waste type and kilos of waste

We empty approximately 1.8 million waste containers on an annual basis.

On average, we empty about 7000 - 7500 containers per day, totaling around 36 000 containers per week.

jobs.title: Transfer Pricing Senior
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   RBK is seeking a high-performing Transfer Pricing Senior to join our International Tax – Transfer Pricing (TP) Team. Working directly with our Transfer Pricing Director, you will support a varied portfolio of multinationals, mid-market companies and fast-growing international businesses across transfer pricing, tax compliance and advisory.

The role can be tailored to your experience and career goals, whether you wish to broaden your consultancy experience across tax, focus on compliance or develop a specialist area.

Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end TP projects, including scoping, benchmarking, documentation (local and master files) and financial/economic analysis.

Draft and review TP reports, technical memoranda, intercompany agreements, intangible pricing, intra-group services and cost allocations.

Handle client queries and conduct functional, industry and economic analyses to support pricing models.

Support TP audits and disputes, defend documentation before tax authorities and contribute to dispute prevention and resolution.

Apply and monitor OECD/G20 BEPS guidance, EU and local TP regulations.

Build client relationships, understand business models, value chains and risks, and align TP policies with commercial strategies.

Collaborate across tax, finance, legal and operations on structuring, cross-border transactions, supply chains, IP and intra-group financing.

Review junior colleagues' work, provide coaching and feedback, and contribute to training and knowledge sharing.

Manage project budgets, billing and WIP, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.

Support business development through proposals, client pitches and practice growth.

Requirements

2–4 years' relevant TP experience in a professional services consulting firm.

Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines, the BEPS framework and local TP regulations.

Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with TP databases (e.g. Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat or TP Catalyst) preferred.

Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain high-quality work.

Teamwork, leadership potential and willingness to coach junior colleagues.

Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to keeping up with international tax and TP developments.

Commercial awareness and understanding of how TP interacts with business strategy, risk and cost structures.

This is a full-time position based in Dublin, with a 37.5-hour working week.

Halcyon provides specialist hygiene, ventilation cleaning and building compliance services to commercial customers throughout Ireland.
We are seeking a Ventilation and Cleaning Engineer to join our operations team. This is a practical role combining technical work on systems with specialist cleaning, equipment preparation and accurate reporting.
The Role
Working under the direction of your Team Leader, you will help deliver work safely, efficiently and to the standards set by senior management. You will travel to customer premises, prepare the equipment and materials required, complete assigned duties and leave each work area clean and tidy.
Key Responsibilities
•	Examine drawings and specifications to establish system layouts.
•	Measure and cut required lengths of copper, lead, steel, iron, aluminium or plastic using appropriate hand or machine tools.
•	Attach fittings and join piping using the appropriate methods, including welding, soldering, cementing, fusing or screwing.
•	Test completed installations for leaks and make necessary adjustments.
•	Repair burst pipes and mechanical or combustion faults, and replace faulty taps, washers and valves within your competence and authorisation.
•	Carry out specialist ventilation and kitchen extraction cleaning as instructed.
•	Meet the cleaning and workmanship standards set by senior management.
•	Follow your Team Leader’s instructions and work cooperatively with colleagues.
•	Assist with cleaning, photographic records and the final tidy-up of customer premises.
•	Prepare equipment and materials for each job.
•	Maintain accurate photographic reports and records of premises visited.
•	Submit accurate timesheets using the company’s time-recording system.
•	Keep company vehicles and equipment clean and report mechanical faults or damage.
•	Follow company policies, safety procedures and site instructions.
What We Are Looking For
•	Relevant practical experience in ventilation, pipework, mechanical maintenance or specialist cleaning.
•	The ability to understand drawings, specifications and work instructions.
•	Competence in the tools and technical tasks relevant to the role.
•	A valid driving licence for driving company vehicles.
•	Good communication and teamwork skills.
•	Attention to detail and a reliable approach to record keeping.
•	Flexibility to travel and work variable shifts, including nights and weekends.
•	A strong commitment to safe working practices.
Desirable Training and Experience
•	Commercial kitchen extraction or ventilation cleaning.
•	Industrial or specialist cleaning.
•	Safe Pass.
•	Manual Handling.
•	Working at Height.
•	MEWP or IPAF training.
Working Arrangements
The role is based from Unit 1, Racecourse Road, Roscommon Town, F42 ET67, with work at customer sites across Ireland.
Start and finish times vary according to the weekly schedule. The role includes a six-month probationary period. There are opportunities to progress to Team Leader as skills and experience develop.

Laadun takeena heillä on eri automerkkien sekä nykypäivän standardien monipuolinen ja pitkä tuntemus.Tehtävässä keskityt tekemään ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtäviä bensiini-, diesel-, hybrid- ja sähköautoille, on sitten kyseessä avustavat tai haastavemmat tehtävät. Työpäiviisi voi sisältyä esim. lisävarusteasennuksia, vikojen etsintää, alustatöitä, sähköistyksiä, moottorin korjauksia, vaihteistotöitä, jarrutöitä tai sitten yksinkertaisempia määräaikaishuoltoja kuten öljyjen ja suodattimien vaihdot sekä paljon muuta. jobs.title: Production Worker - Nakskov (Day/night)

We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace. Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines.The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night. Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.

  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.

  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.

  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.

  • You don't mind changing tasks.

  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We OfferA workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement. Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov

  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring. At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.DEIB Statement At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process About VestasVestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   Job Purpose

The Support Worker will work alongside a multidisciplinary team to assist Service Users in living fulfilling, independent lives. You will provide compassionate, person-centred care and promote dignity, choice, and respect at all times.

Your role is to enable and empower Service Users to achieve their personal goals, develop life skills, and participate fully in their communities.

Key Responsibilities

Provide direct care and support in daily living activities such as personal hygiene, dressing, eating, and mobility.

Support Service Users with their individual care plans, helping them to engage in meaningful social, recreational, and educational activities.

Encourage independence and promote self-care skills where possible.

Assist with meals, ensuring Service Users maintain good nutrition and hydration.

Safely use equipment and aids in accordance with care plans and safety guidelines (e.g., hoists, wheelchairs, walking frames).

Offer emotional support, reassurance, and companionship to promote mental and emotional wellbeing.

Accompany Service Users to appointments, community activities, and social outings.

Work collaboratively with families and healthcare professionals to maintain a supportive and consistent environment.

Qualifications & Experience

A QQI Level 5 qualification in Healthcare Support (or equivalent) is desirable.

Previous experience in a care, disability, or mental health support setting is an advantage.

Strong communication skills, empathy, and the ability to work as part of a team are essential.

A full clean driver’s licence is advantageous but not required.

Direct Employer: Medforce Healthcare Recruitment

jobs.title: Senior Signal Processing Engineer – Acoustics & DSP
jobs.description:
Triton Depth | Copenhagen, Denmark | Full-time

About Triton Depth

Triton Depth is a Danish defence technology company developing advanced maritime sensing and surveillance technologies.

We bring together expertise in electronics, embedded systems, signal processing, and artificial intelligence to develop innovative solutions for some of the most challenging problems in maritime security.

We are a fast-growing, multidisciplinary engineering team working on technologies with real-world applications in defence and critical infrastructure protection.

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Signal Processing Engineer with a strong background in digital signal processing (DSP), preferably specializing in acoustics.

You will work on complex signal-processing challenges, developing algorithms that extract meaningful information from real-world acoustic data. Your work will involve advanced mathematical modelling, spectral analysis, filtering, detection, and statistical signal processing.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy exploring signals, understanding their underlying physical characteristics, and pushing the boundaries of what can be extracted through classical signal-processing techniques.

This is a research-intensive, hands-on engineering position with significant technical freedom and ownership.

You will work closely with our embedded software, electronics, and AI teams, taking ideas from mathematical concepts through experimental validation and practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and implement advanced digital signal-processing algorithms.

  • Analyze complex acoustic signals in both time and frequency domains.

  • Develop techniques for spectral analysis, digital filtering, noise reduction, and signal detection.

  • Apply statistical signal processing and estimation theory to extract meaningful information from noisy measurements.

  • Investigate new signal-processing approaches and evaluate their performance using real-world data.

  • Develop efficient implementations of algorithms for practical applications.

  • Design experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve algorithm performance.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary engineering team to integrate signal-processing solutions into operational systems.

Qualifications

We value technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills more than specific degrees or years of experience.

We would like you to have:

  • An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • A strong theoretical foundation in digital signal processing.

  • Experience with spectral analysis, FFT, digital filters, and time-frequency analysis.

  • Knowledge of statistical signal processing, detection theory, and estimation methods.

  • Experience developing and evaluating signal-processing algorithms.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, and/or C++.

  • Experience working with real-world measurement data, including noisy or low-SNR signals.

  • The ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Acoustic signal processing.

  • Adaptive filtering and advanced noise-reduction techniques.

  • Passive sensing systems.

  • Real-time or embedded DSP.

  • Advanced mathematical modelling and numerical methods.

  • Signal processing within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Academic research, including publications or a PhD in a relevant field.

Experience in the defence industry is not required. We welcome candidates from both industry and academia, including researchers looking to apply their expertise to real-world engineering challenges.

What We Offer

Work on meaningful challenges. Contribute to advanced technologies addressing real-world security challenges.

Technical freedom and ownership. Take responsibility for complex engineering problems, explore new approaches, and influence the technical direction of our products.

From research to reality. See your algorithms move beyond simulations and become part of real systems deployed in demanding environments.

A multidisciplinary engineering environment. Work alongside talented engineers specializing in embedded software, electronics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering.

A growing defence technology company. Join Triton Depth at an exciting stage, where individual contributions have a direct impact on the company's technology and future.

Who You Are

You are someone who genuinely enjoys understanding signals.

You are curious about the information hidden within complex measurements and have the mathematical knowledge and practical skills to uncover it.

You are equally comfortable exploring theoretical concepts, experimenting with algorithms, and analyzing real-world data.

You enjoy difficult, open-ended technical challenges and take pride in developing solutions that work outside controlled laboratory environments.

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to turn advanced signal-processing research into technology with real-world impact.

Apply

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your CV and a short introduction describing your background and relevant experience.

We are particularly interested in hearing about signal-processing projects, research, or technical challenges you have worked on.

Location: Copenhagen, DenmarkEmployment: Full-time

jobs.description: **Kimbtron Oy etsii myyntiedustajia kasvavalle tekoälyalalle!**Haluatko päästä myymään moderneja tekoälyratkaisuja yrityksille ja rakentamaan omaa menestystäsi nopeasti kehittyvällä toimialalla?Kimbtron on suomalainen tekoälyratkaisujen kehittäjä, joka rakentaa käytännönläheisiä AI-työkaluja yritysten arjen tehostamiseen, tiedonhallintaan ja liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.Etsimme nyt tavoitteellisia ja oma-aloitteisia myyntiedustajia viemään ratkaisuja uusille yritysasiakkaille.**Mitä pääset myymään?**Kimbtronin tuotevalikoimaan kuuluu muun muassa:- **Johdon raportointi ja päätöksenteon tuki:** Ratkaisut yritysten tiedonhallintaan, raportointiin ja liiketoiminnan seurantaan. - **Älykäs perehdytys ja työntekijöiden tuki:** Tekoälyratkaisut perehdytykseen, ohjeistukseen ja monikieliseen työntekijätukeen. - **AI-tuotehaku:** Ratkaisut teknisen kaupan tuotetietojen, dokumenttien ja tuotteiden nopeaan löytämiseen. Tuotteita kehitetään jatkuvasti, ja myyntiedustajilla on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan myös uusien ratkaisujen kaupallistamiseen.**Mitä tehtävä sisältää?**Tehtävässä vastaat uusien yritysasiakkaiden hankinnasta, asiakaskontaktien avaamisesta ja myyntimahdollisuuksien edistämisestä.Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekoälyn tekninen asiantuntija. Saat tueksesi tuote-esittelyt, demot sekä Kimbtronin teknisen asiantuntemuksen.Tärkeintä on kyky tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita, rakentaa luottamusta ja saada kauppaa aikaan.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- Kiinnostavat ja kilpailukykyiset tuotteet nopeasti kasvavalla tekoälyalalla - Selkeän provisiopohjaisen ansaintamallin, jossa oma aktiivisuus ja tulokset vaikuttavat ansioihin - Valmiit tuotedemot ja teknisen asiantuntijatuen myyntiin - Joustavuutta oman myyntityön organisointiin - Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita - **Etenemismahdollisuuksia** esimerkiksi myynnin vetovastuuseen, uusien tuotteiden kaupallistamiseen tai laajempiin liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin **Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Arvostamme erityisesti:- Myyntihenkisyyttä, tavoitteellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta - Kykyä lähestyä yrityspäättäjiä ja avata uusia asiakassuhteita - Kiinnostusta teknologiaan ja tekoälyn mahdollisuuksiin - Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja - Halua kehittyä ja edetä urallasi Aiempi kokemus B2B-myynnistä tai olemassa olevat yritysverkostot katsotaan eduksi, mutta ratkaisevinta on asenne ja kyky saada tuloksia aikaan.**Kiinnostuitko?**Haluatko päästä mukaan rakentamaan seuraavan sukupolven tekoälyliiketoimintaa?Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, myyntikokemuksestasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri sinä sopisit tähän myyntitiimiin.**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Bogholder
jobs.description:
Jobtype: Fastansættelse

Geografi: København

Sprog: Dansk

Er du i starten af din karriere inden for bogholderi og økonomi, og leder du efter et sted med god oplæring, mere ansvar og højt til loftet? På vegne af vores kunde søger Work Supply en energisk, lærenem og talstærk profil til en central rolle i økonomiafdelingen.

Stillingen er skræddersyet til dig, der har opbygget dit første fundament (1-2 års erfaring) og er klar til at tage næste skridt. Virksomheden tilbyder en grundig oplæring i deres specifikke systemer og ønsker at forme den rette kandidat til holdet.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Daglig drift: Bogføring af finansbilag, kreditor/debitor-styring og håndtering af købsfakturaer.

  • Afstemninger: Deltagelse i månedlige afstemninger og administrative økonomiopgaver.

  • Løn & Rapportering: Mulighed for løbende oplæring i lønbehandling.

  • Digitale værktøjer: Løbende arbejdsgange i moderne ERP-, løn- og BI-rapporteringssystemer.

Hvem er du?

  • Erfaring (1–2 år): Du har minimum 1 års reel erhvervserfaring fra et regnskabs- eller bogholderijob (udover evt. praktik). Du har en god grundforståelse for debitor/kreditor og bogføring, men er stadig i den tidlige fase af din karriere (maks. 2 års erfaring).

  • Uddannelse: Relevant teoretisk baggrund inden for økonomi og regnskab (f.eks. Finansøkonom, Financial Controller AK, Handelsassistent eller tilsvarende).

  • Systemstærk & Lærenem: Du knækker hurtigt koden til nye digitale systemer og software. Du er nysgerrig, arbejder struktureret og trives med at lære nye arbejdsgange.

Ansøgning og kontakt: For at søge stillingen bedes du sende et opdateret CV med et nutidigt foto (maks. 2 måneder gammelt).

Læs mere på: https://worksupply.dk/

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så mail dit CV til: ak@worksupply.dk Husk at oplyse: JOB ID: 260616

jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

jobs.title: Sähkö- ja automaatioasentaja, Algol Technics Oy
jobs.description: _Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut.__Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä kymmenessä eri maassa._Miltä kuulostaisi vaihtelevat työtehtävät huollon ja kunnossapidon saralla? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.Algolilla toimit huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Päiviisi kuuluvat vaihtelevat tehtävät, jotka sisältävät monipuolisia sähköasennus- ja huoltotöitä pääsääntöisesti teollisuusnostureiden parissa. Huolehdit asiakasyrityksissä, että hommat etenevät ja linjastot liikkuvat. Pääset toimimaan itsenäisesti ja työssä liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Toimit osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Sinulla on taustaa teollisuussähköstä, mutta tartut mielelläsi myös mekaanisiin töihin. Sähköalan osaamisen olet voinut hankkia koulutuksen tai käytännön työkokemuksen kautta. Työssä tehdään paljolti myös mekaanista asennusta, joten esimerkiksi autojen, koneiden tai muun tekniikan parissa harrastaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.Arvostamme omatoimista ja palveluhenkistä työotetta. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työn mielenkiintoisissa tehtävissä ja osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Algol Technicsin palvelukseen.Pääset osaksi osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen perustuu yhteistyöhön ja keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys näkyy arjessa ja vaihtuvuus on poikkeuksellisen pientä.Algol Technics tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön osana pitkän historian omaavaa perheyritystä, jossa asiat tehdään suunnitelmallisesti ja luotettavasti. Taustalla on yli 130 vuoden historia saman perheen omistuksessa, mikä näkyy pitkäjänteisyytenä ja varmuutena arjessa.Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten työterveyshuollon ja Epassin.**Kiinnostuitko?**Tahdomme kuulla sinusta! Jätäthän hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026.** Tehtävässä aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Algol Technicsin kirjoille.Tehtävän rekrytoinnista vastaa Biisoni ja Algol Technicsin toiveesta mahdolliset yhteydenotot: roope.takala@biisoni.fi, p.0504752852

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

jobs.title: Director of IT and Workplace
jobs.description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

  • Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

  • Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities

  • Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

  • Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

  • Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

  • Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

  • Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in IT, spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

  • 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

  • Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

  • Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

  • Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

jobs.description: Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.Your responsibilities:Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership TeamContribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function. Your background:Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controlsResults-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skillsStrong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organizationAbility to translate financial and operational insights into actions10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilitiesDigital mindset with proof record on digital innovationsYour benefits:Attractive compensation & benefitsEmployee Assistance Program GlobalParental Leave ProgramWe look forward to receiving your application. jobs.title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work
