jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   Role Profile
The successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach.

Background
The Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. These include records from parishes throughout Ireland, the archives of the Church’s dioceses, cathedrals, architectural drawings, the administrative records of the Representative Church Body and its multiple committees, and thousands of manuscripts relating to the Church’s people, buildings and activities, spanning from medieval times to the present. Some have relevance for a worldwide research audience, and public engagement with that audience is an important Library function.

Specific Responsibilities
•	Assisting in the processing and cataloguing of incoming collections;

jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology
If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestockWe are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics
2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public HealthWe are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.Research tasksThe focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.
3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary PathologyWe are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.Research tasksThe focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock
Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.
Your profileThe preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.
Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professorYou are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.
Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Your profile as Associate professorYou are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management
In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined hereHow to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .
Who we areThe Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.
Living in DenmarkPlease visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.Area of employment and place of workThe area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/ContactFor further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)Technical Sciences Tenure TrackAarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship. The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path
As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level
As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.Application procedureShortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. Read the full text and apply online

jobs.employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

ResponsibilitiesYou will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

jobs.title: 4 chauffører/montører søges til hvidevarer og TV – søg alene eller med din makker!
jobs.description:
4 chauffører/montører søges – fast makker, egen rute og kundeservice i topklasse!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS søger 4 dygtige og ansvarsbevidste chauffører/montører til levering, indbæring og montering af hvidevarer og TV.

I bliver fordelt på to teams med to medarbejdere i hver 8-pallers liftbil. Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan samarbejde, tage ansvar og sikre, at kunden får en god oplevelse fra ankomst til færdig montering.

Har du allerede en makker, som du arbejder godt sammen med? Så er I meget velkomne til at søge sammen! Du kan også søge alene, så sammensætter vi de rette teams.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstid

• Ruterne starter og slutter i Fredericia.• Arbejdsdagene er mandag til fredag.• Mødetid kl. 06.00 med forventet afslutning omkring kl. 15.00. Sluttidspunktet kan variere efter dagens opgaver.• Forventet opstart den 2. november 2026 – den endelige dato aftales.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Sammen med din makker står du for sikker transport, indbæring, udpakning, placering og montering hos kunderne. Opgaverne omfatter:

• Opstilling og tilslutning af vaskemaskiner.• Opstilling og tilslutning af opvaskemaskiner.• Montering af integrerede opvaskemaskiner, herunder tilpasning og montering af frontlåge.• Montering af integrerede køleskabe.• Tilslutning af ovne og tørretumblere.• Lednings- og tilslutningsopgaver, hvor de nødvendige kompetencer og eventuelle autorisationskrav er opfyldt.• Vending af døre på køle- og fryseskabe.• Montering af TV på væg, fod og stativ.• Montering af udsugning/emhætte.• Kontrol af, at leveringen og monteringen er udført korrekt.• Registrering af leveringer, billeder og dokumentation i chaufførappen.• Oprydning og håndtering af emballage samt eventuelle returvarer efter aftale.

Alle monterings- og tilslutningsopgaver skal udføres fagligt korrekt og efter gældende regler og producentens anvisninger.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har praktisk erfaring med levering og montering af hvidevarer og TV og kan arbejde selvstændigt med opgaverne.• Har gyldigt kørekort til bilen og de nødvendige chaufførbeviser.• Kan håndtere en liftbil og sikre godset forsvarligt.• Trives med fysisk arbejde, herunder indbæring på trapper, og bruger hjælpemidler korrekt.• Er mødestabil, omhyggelig og tager ansvar for både varer, bil og kundens hjem.• Kan kommunikere med kunderne på dansk og forstå arbejdsinstruktioner.• Er fortrolig med smartphone, navigation og registrering af leveringer.• Er løsningsorienteret og bevarer en professionel tone, også når en opgave er krævende.

Vi søger medarbejdere med erfaring fra starten. Beskriv derfor tydeligt, hvilke monteringsopgaver du selv har udført, og hvilke du kan løse selvstændigt.

Vi tilbyder

• Fast kørsel mandag til fredag.• Arbejde i et fast team med to medarbejdere pr. bil.• En varieret hverdag med både kørsel, kundekontakt og praktiske opgaver.• Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst.• En arbejdsplads med direkte kontakt til ledelsen, tæt samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet.

Søg alene – eller sammen med din makker

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til info@nstransportdk.dk med emnet: “Chauffør/montør – Fredericia”.

Fortæl os:

• Hvilken erfaring du har med kørsel, hvidevarer og TV-montering.• Hvilke kørekort og chaufførbeviser du har.• Hvornår du kan starte.• Om du søger alene eller sammen med en makker.

Søger I sammen, må I gerne sende én fælles ansøgning med oplysninger og CV for jer begge.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette fire medarbejdere.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

N & S Transport Denmark ApS

Tlf +45 42 49 82 72

Mobil +45 21 82 83 21

jobs.title: Product Manager, Connections
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap.

 - Take ambitious ideas from first principles to launch, building closely with design and engineering to create experiences that feel simple, useful, and distinctly Notion.

 - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality.

 - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution.

 - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful customer problems and turn them into products that are intuitive, useful, and built with a high level of craft.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed.

 - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment.

 - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests.

 - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building collaborative, productivity, or AI-powered products used by a broad range of customers.

 - Experience operating across both zero-to-one product development and the improvement of products at scale.

 - Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on complex product systems.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $238,000 - $250,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Hausing is a dedicated property management software platform that helps commercial property managers and owners save time through automation and gain a real-time overview with centralized portfolio data. The solution replaces manual and unreliable spreadsheets, allowing users to track lease changes, special agreements, work orders, utilities, and analytics in one place. Core features include task management, lease management, automated preventive maintenance calendars, and automated utility cost sharing with quick invoice generation. Hausing also provides robust analytics, such as rent-rolls, task reports, vacancy reports, and tenant changes, in both spreadsheet and visual formats. The team focuses on building practical, data-driven tools that make property operations more efficient and transparent. What you'll do: - Design and develop reliable, user-friendly solutions that make a real difference for our customers. - Work closely with stakeholders to ensure business needs align with technical capabilities. - Take part in cross-functional initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve long-term scalability. - Proactively identify and solve complex problems. - Share your knowledge and help drive engineering excellence across the team.

We offer: Benefits:- Professional development and career growth opportunities. - Autonomy in organizing and managing your own work. - A modern and inspiring work environment. - An inclusive company culture where employees' opinions are valued and taken into account. - Remote work opportunities. - Flexible working hours. - Flexible arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance.

Other requirements: What we're looking for:- Strong skills in Java development and familiarity with React or similar frameworks. - Experience in building technical solutions for complex business logic. - Experience in API design and/or service-oriented architecture. - Solid competence in working with relational databases. - Familiarity with AWS or similar environments. - An AI-first mindset and curiosity to explore how AI can improve both your workflow and the products you build. - Familiarity with product engineering methodologies. - Willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment. - Courage to take responsibility, show initiative, and give constructive feedback. - Proficiency in Estonian language is a plus.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io http://Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

Scope guardrails: this role owns campaign strategy, hands-on execution, cross-functional delivery, and performance analysis. It is not the primary Customer.io http://Customer.io architect or incident-response owner, a general intake coordinator, or a production-only role receiving prewritten briefs. The person should operate as an independent campaign owner who can take work from an ambiguous opportunity to a high-quality, measured launch.

This role may be based in either our San Francisco or New York City offices. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the campaign portfolio. Independently lead a portfolio of launch, one-off, and evergreen lifecycle campaigns with clear prioritization and predictable delivery.

 - Turn opportunities into strategies. Translate product launches, lifecycle moments, and business priorities into clear objectives, audiences, journeys, channel plans, and success metrics.

 - Build high-impact lifecycle programs. Develop campaigns across onboarding, activation, adoption, collaboration, monetization, retention, and resurrection.

 - Execute from brief to measurement. Own audience creation, build, QA, localization, launch readiness, and post-campaign analysis across email and in-product messaging.

 - Improve foundational journeys. Audit existing programs and recommend which should be maintained, improved, rebuilt, or retired; lead the rebuild of priority onboarding or adoption journeys.

 - Raise the experimentation bar. Develop testable hypotheses and use segmentation, personalization, holdouts, and A/B tests to understand incremental impact.

 - Measure customer and business outcomes. Connect campaigns to activation, product adoption, collaboration, conversion, retention, or qualified sales outcomes—not only opens and clicks.

 - Lead cross-functional delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales, and external partners.

 - Create repeatable systems. Turn recurring campaign work into templates, playbooks, and reusable operating patterns that improve quality and velocity.

 - Enable safe self-service. Help cross-functional partners execute effectively while maintaining Lifecycle's strategic, customer-experience, and quality standards.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Significant experience owning lifecycle, CRM, growth, or product-marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.

 - A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional campaigns at meaningful scale.

 - Strong customer-journey thinking across activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention.

 - Hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

 - Strong audience segmentation, personalization, experimentation, and campaign-measurement skills.

 - Ability to use data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate results, and change strategy; working knowledge of SQL or self-serve analytics is a plus.

 - Excellent project leadership: clear briefs, dependable execution, proactive risk management, and crisp stakeholder communication.

 - Strong editorial and customer judgment—you care about sending useful, relevant messages rather than maximizing message volume.

 - Comfort operating in a product-led, highly cross-functional environment with incomplete information.

 - Experience with B2B or product-led growth, product telemetry, in-product messaging, or AI-assisted campaign workflows is a plus.

 - 8+ total years relevant + transferrable experience.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS:

 - Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch, one-off, and evergreen campaigns.

 - Independently own a meaningful portfolio from strategy through performance analysis.

 - Launch a materially improved onboarding, activation, or adoption journey with a defined experiment and measurement plan.

 - Establish consistent briefs, segmentation standards, QA, launch-readiness checks, and post-campaign readouts.

 - Demonstrate credible incremental movement in a product or business outcome.

 - Create meaningful capacity for senior Lifecycle teammates to focus on systems architecture, journey strategy, personalization, and modernization.


Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $220,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere samt en sygeplejerske med fokus på kvalitet og undervisning
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed til at skabe tryghed og udviklingsmuligheder for børn og unge? Hos MerVib søger vi både medarbejdere til det daglige arbejde på vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge og en sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinhåndtering og undervisning. Vores tilgang Et barn eller en ung kommer med erfaringer, interesser og håb – og ofte med andres fortællinger, der med tiden kan være blevet til faste sandheder om, hvem de er. Hos MerVib er vi nysgerrige på barnets egen oplevelse: Hvad er vigtigt? Hvad lykkes? Og hvad kan vi voksne have overset? På vores fire børne- og ungehjem arbejder vi for, at børn og unge oplever tryghed, tilhørsforhold og indflydelse på eget liv. Vores narrative tilgang præger, hvordan vi taler med og om børnene. Vi undersøger vores egne antagelser og får sammen med barnet øje på færdigheder, initiativer og håb. Barnets perspektiv er med til at forme vores støtte. Pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til Herrestrup og Grevinge Du arbejder med tydelig struktur, professionel omsorg og relationer – både i fællesskaber og i individuelle opgaver med 1:1-støtte. Du tilpasser støtten til det enkelte barn og bidrager til en tryg og forudsigelig hverdag. Vi søger dig der
  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse og erfaring med børn og unge i sårbare positioner.
  • Har viden om og erfaring med autisme, ADHD og omsorgssvigt.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for narrativ praksis og TEACCH.
  • Er nysgerrig på barnets perspektiv og kan tilpasse støtten inden for trygge, tydelige rammer.
  • Arbejder ud fra en Low Arousal-tilgang, tager ansvar, dokumenterer systematisk og er åben for faglig sparring.
Du kan eksempelvis være uddannet pædagog, socialpædagog, pædagogisk assistent, social- og sundhedsassistent, sygeplejerske, socialrådgiver, skolelærer, fysioterapeut eller ergoterapeut. Du kan også have en anden relevant socialfaglig, sundhedsfaglig eller pædagogisk uddannelse. Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger med 12-timers dagvagter, 24-timers døgnvagter og weekendarbejde. Arbejdsstederne er vores børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup og Grevinge. Sygeplejerske til sundhedsfaglig kvalitet medicinhåndtering og undervisning Som sygeplejerske skal du have et solidt fagligt og lovgivningsmæssigt fundament. Du kombinerer praktiske medicinopgaver med undervisning og kvalitetsudvikling og hjælper ledelsen og medarbejderne med at omsætte gældende regler til tydelige og forsvarlige arbejdsgange. Dine opgaver omfatter at
  • Varetage medicinopgaver, herunder dispensering efter gældende ordinationer og instrukser.
  • Undervise og vejlede medarbejderne i medicinhåndtering og følge op på oplæring og kompetencer.
  • Gennemgå, opdatere og versionsstyre sundhedsfaglige instrukser i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og vejledninger samt følge op på, at de anvendes korrekt i hverdagen.
  • Omsætte faglige krav til brugbare arbejdsgange inden for blandt andet ansvar og kompetencer, journalføring, samtykke, hygiejne, utilsigtede hændelser og egenkontrol.
  • Indgå i det pædagogiske arbejde i husene i dagtimerne eller i weekender. Tilrettelæggelsen aftales med udgangspunkt i dine interesser og stillingens øvrige opgaver.
Vi søger dig der
  • Er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske med solid erfaring med medicinhåndtering, dispensering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.
  • Har solidt kendskab til relevant sundhedslovgivning, herunder regler om medicinhåndtering, journalføring, samtykke, tavshedspligt og delegation af sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Kender og kan anvende relevante vejledninger fra Sundhedsstyrelsen og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed og holder dig ajour med ændringer.
  • Kan underbygge din vejledning med gældende regler og faglige kilder og afklarer tvivlsspørgsmål, før du vejleder eller ændrer en instruks.
  • Kan skrive klare instrukser og gøre faglig viden anvendelig for medarbejdere med forskellige uddannelsesbaggrunde.
  • Kan undervise og vejlede præcist og praksisnært samt følge op på, at medarbejderne forstår deres opgaver, ansvar og kompetencegrænser.
  • Arbejder systematisk og selvstændigt og trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Møder børn og unge med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiv.
Erfaring fra et børne- og ungehjem eller et andet socialt tilbud er en fordel. Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med opgaver på MerVibs børne- og ungehjem i Herrestrup, Grevinge og Jyderup. Vi har desuden undervisningslokaler i Herlev. Du skal være villig til at bruge egen bil. Hos MerVib får du Et arbejdsfællesskab med varme, engagement og høj faglig standard. Du introduceres til vores hverdag, værdier og metoder og deltager fra start med støtte fra kolleger og ledelse. Vores årshjul rummer intern og ekstern undervisning samt faglige oplæg gennem hele året. Derudover får du tæt ledelsesmæssig sparring og supervision. For begge stillingsprofiler gælder:
  • Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.
  • Pension og sundhedsforsikring.
  • Kørekort til almindelig bil (B) er et krav.
  • Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest før ansættelse.
Ansøgning og kontakt Fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil hos MerVib. Angiv tydeligt i din ansøgning, om du søger en medarbejderstilling i Herrestrup eller Grevinge eller stillingen som sygeplejerske med fokus på sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og undervisning. Upload din ansøgning, CV og dit uddannelsesbevis via linket "Ansøg" her på siden. Vil du høre mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Grevinge: Afdelingsleder Rikke Gjesing, telefon 92 90 42 24.
  • Medarbejderstillinger i Herrestrup: Afdelingsleder Nada Shouhani, telefon 92 90 42 16.
  • Sygeplejerskestillingen: Gitte Praastrup, specialkonsulent – drift, HR og kommunikation, telefon 92 90 42 22 eller job@mervib.dk .
Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

jobs.title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist - PCI On-Call Service
jobs.description: The opportunityAre you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.The positionYour primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.What we offerThe opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.Qualifications and experienceEssential requirementsYou hold specialist certification in cardiology.You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicineYou are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)Or are willing to learn DanishYou can perform PCI procedures independently.You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.Desirable qualificationsExperience participating in a PCI on-call service.Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.About the DepartmentThe Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.Our department performs approximately:6,000 invasive procedures annually8,000 inpatient admissions annuallyMore than 30,000 outpatient consultations annuallyApproximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annuallyOur medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.Salary and terms of employmentThis is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk ApplicationApplications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. Please include:Curriculum Vitae (CV).Letter of motivationProof of specialist certification in cardiology.List of publications, if applicable.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator, EMEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:




CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.


COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily GTM roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.


BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both GTM roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €68,000 - €76,000.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Software Architect for Research Cloud Services at the SDU eScience Center
jobs.description:
The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. 

Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud, which is the core of the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing.

We address stimulating new technological challenges. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals.

Job description:The center is expanding its staff in one of its core areas: research cloud services. 

We seek an expert in the following areas:

  • Distributed and concurrent systems

  • SQL databases

  • Software development for HPC environments

  • Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or OpenStack

  • Software development experience using Go, C or C++

  • Container and virtualization technology

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience with Go, Kubernetes and distributed systems will be strongly preferred.

The successful candidate will become part of the cloud team at the eScience Center. Tasks under the user cloud team include, but are not limited to: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems and services. Integrating with HPC schedulers such as Slurm and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Participating in the full feature lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architectural design to coding, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring of production environments.

The cloud team at the eScience Center currently consists of four employees with long expertise in building cloud computing infrastructure, programming and software engineering. 

Required qualifications for the position: 

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, C, C++, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, supporting software and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with DevOps practices (e.g. git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidates are expected to be on-site in Odense.

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the positions is 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible. Appointments are for full time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. 

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Dan Sebastian ThraneTeam leader for Cloud ServicesSDU eScience CenterDept. of Mathematics and Computer ScienceUniversity of Southern DenmarkEmail: dthrane@imada.sdu.dk

Or:

Prof. Director Claudio PicaSDU eScience CenterDept. of Mathematics and Computer ScienceUniversity of Southern Denmarkemail: pica@cp3.sdu.dk 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

  • High Performance Computing (hardware and software)

  • Kubernetes (on-prem)

  • Automated deployment (e.g. via Ansible)

  • Advanced networking (ethernet and infiniband)

  • Cloud computing

  • Systems development and integration

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience in high-performance computing, Linux systems administration, and Kubernetes will be strongly preferred.

Tasks under the infrastructure team include, but are not limited to, configuration of hardware, network, and software; automated deployment using Ansible; configuration of virtualized and container-based environments, such as Kubernetes; operating and maintaining distributed storage systems, such as Ceph WekaIO, and Quantum ActiveScale; configuration of Linux systems and common services.

Required qualifications:

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, Python, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, systems administration, and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with common DevOps practices (such as Git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

Condition of Employment

or the infrastructure team leader:Martin Lundquist HansenSDU eScience CenterDept. of Mathematics and Computer ScienceUniversity of Southern Denmarkemail: hansen@imada.sdu.dk

jobs.title: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

  • Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

  • Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

  • Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

  • Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

  • The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

  • Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

  • Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

  • Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges.
