jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

jobs.description:

Classification: Full-time, exempt
Reports to: School Leader

Pay Range: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

  • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

  • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

  • Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

  • Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

  • Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

  • Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels.Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiterâs identity.Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods.Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses.Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @tether.to orÂ @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details.Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Projektstilling i projekt med at være kirke for unge i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Kan du se dig selv i en vision om at folkekirken tilbyder et sted for unge i Aarhus, hvor man kan hænge ud og indgå i fællesskaber? Er du relationelt orienteret? Og har du det fint med både at sidde til planlægningsmøder og løfte konkrete, praktiske opgaver – så tror vi, at du vil finde dette opslag interessant.

For godt et års tid siden åbnede Christianskirken i Aarhus STEDET. Her kan unge i Aarhus hænge ud, sidde med deres studier, deltage i aktiviteter, møde andre unge til fællesspisning og få et møde med kirken i øjenhøjde. Er du den, som skal være med til at videreudvikle og konsolidere dét arbejde?

 

STEDET er fysisk lokation på Katrinebjerg, men det er også en måde at vise at kirken er mere end gudstjenester; at kirken er fællesskaber, samtaler om stort og småt, mulighed for at møde andre unge og et pitstop i den hverdag, som unge lever i.

 

Der er tale om en etårig projektstilling på 30 timer ugentligt, med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse, hvis den fremtidige finansiering falder på plads.

Opgaver

Som projektmedarbejder ved Christianskirken, skal du overordnet set være med til at udleve kirkens vision:

Christianskirken - et livstræ med mange grene, der

·        Rækker synligt ud i sognet

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:

Christianskirken er en aktiv kirke på Christiansbjerg. Kirkens arbejde præges af mere end 400 frivillige, der bidrager til kirkens liv og aktiviteter på forskellig vis.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

•        Samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i et godt arbejdsmiljø, der vægter teamsamarbejdet højt.

•        Godt besøgte gudstjenester, der i udtryk og stilarter rummer variation, tradition og fornyelse.  

•        Et rigt menighedsliv.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder, Vibeke Dahmen på 41 72 71 06 eller projektleder Lasse Holmgaard Iversen på 26 25 57 88.

Som ansat ved Christianskirken refererer du overordnet set til menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver, repræsenteret ved menighedsrådets kontaktperson. I det daglige referer du til Christianskirkens daglige leder, Vibeke Dahmen, der vil forestå den daglige ledelsesopgave, samt til projektleder for STEDET, sognepræst Lasse Holmgaard Iversen. Beskrivelse af sognet kan findes på kirkens hjemmeside www.christianskirken.dk

Ansøgningssted: Ansøgning, anbefalinger, referencer samt kopi af evt. eksamensbevis, sendes via sikker mail til kirkekontoret, att. daglig leder Vibeke Dahmen. (Link findes på kirkens hjemmeside).

Ansøgningsfrist: 1. november 2026.

Samtaler: Forventes afholdt d. 11. og/eller 12. november 2026, i tidsrummet mellem kl. 16 og 21.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles i overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomster på området. Disse kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Der er knyttet rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen.

Løn samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

This senior leadership role is responsible for managing a team of Legal Entity Controllers across several Stora Enso locations. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental well-being. - Career growth opportunities within an international organisation. - Access to modern technologies and digital tools. - Professional development opportunities. - Motivating additional benefits package. - Hybrid work options and flexible working hours. - Inspiring, sustainable, and innovation-driven work environment.

jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

 - Demo environments: Notion, plus demo automation platforms as needed

 - Collaboration: Slack, Salesforce, Gong for call review

 - Automation: Zapier, scripting tools, API clients (Postman or similar)

 - AI Coding Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

  • Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

  • Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

  • Supporting training sessions and workshops 

  • Gathering and tracking user feedback 

  • Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

  • Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

  • Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

  • Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

  • Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

  • Coordinating meetings and workshops 

  • Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

  • Preparing presentations and communication materials 

  • Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

  • Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

  • Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

  • Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

  • Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

  • A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

  • Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

  • Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

  • Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

  • Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

  • A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: OT Security Architect - Renewables, Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!  Your position In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo. Your tasks & responsibilities In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.
Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met. Your profile & qualificationsYou are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
  • Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage
If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo. Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

  • Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

  • Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

  • Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

  • Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

  • Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

  • Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

  • Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

  • Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

  • Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

  • Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)

Do you imagine a position where you play a key role in an engaged and committed team creating professional film projects?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and still deliver great results? 

Are you able to facilitate film production and at the same time create a supreme client experience, both in the studio and on location?

As producer at AVdesign you will get the chance to work in a top professional, positive and encouraging work environment with like-minded individuals who have a strong passion within their field. We value rich opportunities for professional and personal development. 

 

About us

We are a Billund based international production company. AVdesign was founded in 2005 and now employs 16 colleagues including animators, CG generalists, producers, production assistants, sound designers, videographers etc.

We create a great variety of content across different platforms and support clients worldwide with a range of exciting projects.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our video team, where we have gathered some of the most skilled and dedicated enthusiasts from the business. The team consists of 6 people.

This is a maternity cover position, offering a unique opportunity to join AVdesign and play a key role in coordinating and delivering a wide range of media productions.

We are looking for an experienced Producer / Production Manager with a strong background in production planning and project coordination.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and adaptable, with an open mindset and a flexible approach to a broad range of assignments. Our projects vary across video production, live streaming, studio product shoots, and other media-related productions, so versatility and a willingness to take on different challenges are important.

At AVdesign, we foster an open, supportive, and collaborative working environment where sharing knowledge, ideas, and experience is highly valued.

Experience within the media industry, such as video production, live streaming, or broadcast, is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

This is a hands-on role that combines operational coordination with practical involvement in productions. It requires a genuine interest in planning, problem-solving, and collaborating with colleagues, clients, and partners to ensure successful project delivery.

 

About you

You are a natural coordinator who enjoys bringing people, plans, and ideas together. You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks at once. Whether coordinating logistics, supporting creative productions, or solving last-minute challenges, you take ownership and help keep projects on track. Fluency in Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your profile:

·      Experience in a coordination, project support, administrative, or production-related role.

·      Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

·      Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats, contributing wherever needed to support the team and deliver great productions.

·      Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

·      Experience with light photo editing, video editing, or basic graphic design is an advantage.

·      A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a flexible approach to changing priorities.

·      Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

·      A positive team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others succeed.

 

Additional information

If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you soon. Potentially we are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

The role is based in Billund, Denmark. Remote working is not an option. 

If you have any question about the job, please get in touch on: application@avdesign.dk

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV on: application@avdesign.dk

We will interview potential candidates on an ongoing basis and deactivate the job advert once the position has been filled.

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do:
  • Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
  • Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
  • Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
  • A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
  • We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process:

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

jobs.title: Skønne Frederik i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag

  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

You will need:
