jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step

 - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees

 - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion

 - Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates

 - Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality

 - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals

 - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders

 


SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools)

 - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft.

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence

 - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year

 - You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Zainteresirani kandidati mogu se javiti porukom ili poslati životopis.

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

jobs.title: Er du den fagperson, man kan regne med, når det bliver komplekst?
jobs.description:
Hos MerCare søger vi erfarne socialfaglige vikarer, der vil mere end bare tage en vagt. Hos MerCare leder vi ikke efter flest muligt. Vi leder efter de rigtige. Vi arbejder med socialfaglige opgaver, hvor relation, stabilitet og faglighed gør en reel forskel. Vi ved, at det ikke er ligegyldigt, hvem der træder ind ad døren – hvad enten det er på et bosted, i en institution, på en specialskole eller i en familie, hvor der er brug for en ekstra voksen. Derfor matcher vi ikke bare mennesker med ledige timer. Vi matcher faglighed, erfaring og menneske med den konkrete opgave. Er du den fagperson Hvem er du? Du har erfaring fra det socialpædagogiske område og ved, hvad det vil sige at være en del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker har brug for tydelige, stabile og fagligt stærke voksne. Din erfaring kan fx være fra:
  • bosteder eller botilbud
  • institutioner
  • specialskoler
  • børne- og ungehjem
  • støtteopgaver i hjemmet
  • arbejde med børn, unge eller voksne med særlige behov
Du behøver ikke have prøvet alt. Men du skal have faglig erfaring, dømmekraft og lyst til at gøre en forskel i praksis. Er du den fagperson Det lægger vi vægt på Hos MerCare leder vi efter medarbejdere, der:
  • kan skabe ro – også når situationen bliver presset
  • kan balancere relation og struktur
  • arbejder fagligt og reflekteret
  • tager ansvar for det, de siger ja til
  • kan samarbejde og indgå i en eksisterende praksis
  • møder mennesker med respekt og ordentlighed
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og søge sparring, når det er nødvendigt
Du skal ikke være perfekt. Men du skal være ansvarlig. Er du den fagperson Hvilke opgaver kan du få? Vi matcher altid opgaven med den medarbejder, der har de rette kompetencer og den relevante erfaring. Det kan blandt andet være:
  • støtte på bosteder, botilbud og institutioner
  • støtte i skole- og specialtilbud
  • 1:1-støtte i hjemmet, skolen eller fritiden
  • ledsagelse
  • aflastning i hjemmet
  • støtte omkring struktur og trivsel i hverdagen
  • længerevarende individuelle støtteforløb
Nogle opgaver kræver bred socialpædagogisk erfaring. Andre kræver en mere specialiseret profil. Det er netop derfor, vi matcher grundigt. Er du den fagperson Hos MerCare bliver du valgt til opgaven Når du bliver en del af MerCare, bliver du ikke bare oprettet i et system og sendt videre. Vi lærer dig at kende og spørger ind til din erfaring, dine kompetencer og de opgaver, du fungerer bedst i. Vi tager kun nye medarbejdere ind, når vi kan se et fagligt og menneskeligt match. For kvalitet må aldrig være tilfældig. Er du den fagperson Det får du hos os

  • mulighed for både fleksible opgaver og længerevarende forløb

  • en organisation, der tager ansvar, også når noget bliver svært Er du den fagperson

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. Your position As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.Your tasks & responsibilities Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.Your main responsibilities will be to:
  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately
Your profile & qualifications You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:
  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation
Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Experienced Massage Therapist – AIRE Ancient Baths Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each.

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols.

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock.

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols.

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience!

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182DKK

  • Permanent Contract and Working Hours: You will have a permanent contract with 20 hours per week

  • Working days: Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips.

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected.

Copenhagen locationYou will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About AIRE:

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Upper East Side and Toronto facilities in 2024.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:


CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEERING

 - Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

 - Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

 - Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

 - Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.
   


SECURE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

 - Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

 - Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

 - 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM tools (Wiz, Lacework, Prisma, Orca, SCC, etc.).

 - Deep expertise in GCP security (IAM, VPC, KMS, GKE, Cloud Logging).

 - Experience securing and governing SaaS platforms and identity integrations.

 - Operational experience with infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud and container environments.

 - Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure security services and configurations.

 - Experience with container and Kubernetes security across GKE, EKS, or AKS.

 - Strong IaC security experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tooling.

 - Familiarity with compliance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience supporting engineering teams in building secure-first, cloud-native or PaaS environments.

 - Background securing AI/ML pipelines, model-serving infrastructure, or developer platform services.

 - Experience in high-growth technology or cloud-native product companies.

 - Experience with securing AI/agentic systems and sensitive data pipelines.

 - Automation/scripting with Python.

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS/Azure security certs).
   
   


WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset — Ability to break down complex security and operational challenges into clear engineering solutions.

 - Autonomy — Comfortable leading initiatives, collaborating effectively,  and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Communication excellence — Able to translate deep technical concepts for engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.

 - Continuous learning — Passion for staying current with AI security, cloud-native advances, and emerging threats.

 - Automation-first approach — Belief in reducing operational toil and building scalable, self-healing systems.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Korterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Otsime kohusetundlikku, hoolikat ja kogenud koristajat pikaajaliseks koostööks

Tööülesanded: Otsime kohusetundlikku, hoolikat ja kogenud koristajat pikaajaliseks koostööks.📍 Töö asukoht: Mustamäe, Sääse tänav, Tallinn. või 📍 Töö asukoht: Kesklinn, Türi tänav, Tallinn. Töö sobib hästi lisatööks inimesele, kellel on juba põhitöö või kes soovib teenida lisaraha mõned korrad kuus. Peamiselt tegeleme korterite põhjaliku koristamisega pärast pikaajalist elamist. Enamasti on tegemist 1- või 2-toaliste korteritega. Tööülesanded: • Korterite põhjalik ja hoolduskoristus. • Köögi, vannitoa, WC, magamistoa ja teiste eluruumide koristamine. • Rasva, katlakivi ja muu mustuse eemaldamine erinevatelt pindadelt. • Aurupuhasti kasutamine. • Tekstiilipesuri kasutamine. • Professionaalsete puhastusvahendite, sealhulgas happeliste puhastusvahendite kasutamine. • Kvaliteetse lõpptulemuse tagamine ning tähelepanu detailidele. Tingimused: • Enamik koristusi kestab keskmiselt 4–5 tundi. • Vahel on vaja teha ka lühemaid töid kestusega umbes 2–3 tundi. • Töödest teavitame tavaliselt 3–4 päeva ette. • Tööd toimub vastavalt vajadusele mõned korrad kuus. • Töö toimub töövõtulepingu või muu kokkuleppel sõlmitava lepingu alusel. • Tasu kokkuleppel.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Ametlikku koostööd lepingu alusel.• Võimalust teenida lisaraha põhitöö kõrvalt. • Paindlikku töökorraldust. • Tööde ja tööaja eelnevat kokkuleppimist. • Tavaliselt teavitame töödest 3–4 päeva ette. • Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid ja töövahendid on meie poolt. • Püsivat koostööd kvaliteetse töö korral. • Õigeaegset töötasu. • Sõbralikku ja lugupidavat suhtumist. • Selgeid tööülesandeid ning eelnevalt kokkulepitud töömahtu.

Muud nõuded: • Varasem kogemus korterite või majade koristamisel on kohustuslik.• Oskus töötada iseseisvalt ja organiseeritult. • Kogemus professionaalsete puhastusvahendite ja seadmete kasutamisel. • Oskus eemaldada keerulisemaid määrdumisi. • Korrektsus, vastutustunne ja täpsus. • Tähelepanu detailidele ning kohusetundlik suhtumine töösse. Oluline: otsime koristajat, kellel on varasem töökogemus koristusvaldkonnas. Ilma kogemuseta kandidaate me kahjuks ei kaalu.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt. Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

jobs.title: Underviser i robotteknologi til Absalons ingeniør-uddannelser - genopslag
jobs.description:
Click for version in English Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi? Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift. På Absalon får du mulighed for at kombinere din erfaring fra robot-, automations- eller maskinområdet med undervisning. Samtidig sætter du dit faglige aftryk på uddannelsens indhold, laboratorier og samarbejde med industrien. Absalon etablerer i september 2027 en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi. Uddannelsen har fokus på integration af robot- og automationsløsninger og en forståelse for helheden i det produktionssystem, hvor løsningen skal indgå. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi indgår i tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og Drift. På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske automations-, maskin- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/ Din profil Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, produktionsstyring og maskinteknologi. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående: Dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende. Medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og du skal ligesom os, være drevet af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse. Du sparrer med din kolleger omkring din undervisning, og sammen finder vi løsninger på praktiske opgaver. Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne. Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelser, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Du får en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af den nye uddannelse i robotteknologi og automation. Du skal bl.a. være med til at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier. Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil når du skal undervise, vejlede og sparrer med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Industri 4.0
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Sikkerhedssystemer og cyber security
  • CE-mærkning og gældende standarder for fagområdet
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør, det kan f.eks. være robot-/automationsingeniør, produktionsingeniør, elektroingeniør, maskiningeniør eller lignende
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på engelsk og gerne også på dansk
  • gerne er lektorbedømt
  • har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet. Det er ikke et krav, men vil det være en fordel.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge. Opbygge en uddannelse. Du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi og eventuelt have en koordinerende rolle i beskrivelse af uddannelsen, udarbejdelse af studieordning, etablering af studenter-, og virksomhedsnetværk samt indkøb af udstyr og indretning af laboratorium. Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Undervise og projektvejlede studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede vores studerende både teoretisk og laboratorie- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen. Du skal også være med til løbende at udvikle vores undervisning. Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan der også være opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud. Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene. Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener. Dine kolleger Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion. Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesleder, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores ingeniøruddannelser i Kalundborg er vi ca. 20 ansatte undervisere. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland, samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver, samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning. Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Absalon er desuden med i Campus Kalundborginitiativet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med fem andre uddannelsesinstitutioner, og fra 2028 vil vi være en del af et nyt fælles Campus Kalundborg-byggeri. Der kan blive tale om ansættelse som lektor Du bedes tilkendegive i din ansøgning, hvilken type ansættelse du søger. Sådan ansøger du Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232,- kr. inkl. pension.For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537,- kr. inkl. pension.Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 15. november 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 47 og 48.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer. På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde. Ved ansættelse af lektorer, der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673 Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458 Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 25,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and now expanding across Asia Pacific. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role in APAC is office based 2–3 days per week, as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

Requirements

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Incident Response
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.

jobs.description:
Leverage Live Local prepares and manages Florida Live Local Act property tax exemptions for multifamily owners. We represent more than 90 properties and about 30,000 units. Demand is not our constraint. Operations is. This seat owns the operating system that lets us grow without breaking.

What's in it for you. A base of 180,000 dollars with upside tied to the numbers you own, full compensation likely 250,000 to 350,000 dollars when the role is performing. Direct weekly access to the founder. Twenty days of paid time off plus federal holidays. Fully remote.

  • Decision tracking by the statutory deadline, logged in the system of record
  • Denials and appeals, every one, with deadlines met
  • The annual recertification and compliance cadence
  • The operations team: SLAs, data hygiene, accountability

This is for you if you have walked into a messy, growing services business and made it run tight, you like being measured on real numbers, and you have managed a team of three or more. You must be able to work core hours overlapping 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern US time.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

 - You scope light and move fast. We plan in weeks, not quarters, and you build just enough process to keep a fast team aligned

 - You build trust quickly, from individual contributors to the C-suite

 - Bonus: you're comfortable building your own tools with AI. We use Replit to run Replit



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

 



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Global Head of Land Revenue, you’ll be the global owner for technical new-business strategy, pipeline, and conversion—a customer-facing, technical revenue leadership role, not a RevOps or sales operations role. You’ll own Notion’s Land number (net-new and upgrade iARR across regions), work closely with EPD and Product, and step into high-stakes technical conversations with customers and partners as Notion shifts from product-led to sales-led selling in an AI-native world.

This role is the global owner for new business standards, pipeline programs, and operating cadence. You’ll set the way for landing new business revenue globally, partner with Regional GMs who own regional P&L outcomes, and ensure consistent execution through scalable programs, playbooks, enablement, and governance.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, Sales leadership, and regional teams to improve pipeline quality, win rates, conversion, and time-to-productivity. You’ll also design operating standards that balance regional accountability with global program consistency.

You’ll be measured on qualified pipeline creation, coverage, conversion, program ROI, velocity, handoff quality, and BDR/SC ramp outcomes—requiring you to operate with strong systems thinking, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead the global net-new business motion: define strategy, program portfolio, operating cadence, governance, and performance standards across regions

 - Own the global net new business strategy for Land, including ICP and segmentation guardrails, plays, coverage model assumptions, annual and quarterly planning, sequencing, and investment trade-offs

 - Establish global definitions and standards for stages, qualification, handoffs, pipeline math assumptions, and reporting integrity

 - Build and run global pipeline generation programs in partnership with Marketing and regional leaders, including campaign-to-pipeline motions, partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account plays, and field event program standards

 - Define the measurement framework for new business programs, connecting inputs to outputs and outcomes across cost, pipeline, iARR, velocity, and win-rate lift

 - Own the Land-side technical selling motion and set the technical bar for sales: SC plays, discovery and demo standards, scalable demo environments, certification paths, and ramp mechanisms

 - Run the global new business operating cadence, including weekly program reviews, monthly pipeline health inspection, quarterly planning, escalation paths, and decision-rights models

 - Partner with Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Product, and Partnerships to align new business programs, systems, content, enablement, feedback loops, and change management


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Deeply technical SaaS background with meaningful customer-facing experience—solutions engineering, solutions consulting, field or customer engineering, or technical sales—plus ownership of a revenue, quota, pipeline, or conversion outcome

 - Deep understanding of pipeline mechanics and how to influence conversion levers end-to-end, including qualified pipeline creation, coverage ratios, lead response, handoff quality, stage progression, win-rate lift, and velocity

 - Strong program-building instincts: you can design scalable plays, instrument them with data, and run an inspection cadence that drives behavior change

 - Experience building operating systems for global teams, including cadences, dashboards, governance, playbooks, definitions, and change-management mechanisms

 - Executive presence and cross-functional leadership: able to align and influence Regional GMs, Marketing, RevOps, Enablement, EPD, Partnerships, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting lines for every dependency

 - Ability to balance regional autonomy with global craft excellence: you set the bar, create standards, and drive consistency while enabling local execution

 - Strong enablement and role-design instincts, with the ability to define expectations, onboarding paths, certification standards, and time-to-productivity mechanisms for BDR and SC motions

 - Builder orientation and comfort in ambiguity: you create the playbook while the org is executing, and you iterate quickly based on market, customer, and performance signals

 - Hands-on with AI tools, and able to credibly explain how AI and agents change workflows for technical teams


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with solution-led selling motions and technical or product-adjacent go-to-market

 - Track record building global programs that still allow regional adaptation

 - Experience partnering deeply with Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and Enablement to create measurable net new business impact

 - Experience designing partner-sourced pipeline programs, ABM or named-account motions, or field event program standards at scale
